jobs.title: Senior Manager-Digital Product Management
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Global Merchant & Network Services brings together American Express' merchant and network-related businesses, including relationships with merchants, issuers, acquirers, processors, and strategic partners globally.
  
  
The Network Product team develops and delivers secure, resilient, and scalable payment network capabilities. This includes Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations that support market expansion, regulatory requirements, and global interoperability.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Network Product professional to drive the development and delivery of strategic payment network capabilities. The role requires strong knowledge of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, transaction processing, and digital payments, along with the ability to translate business and partner needs into clear product requirements and executable delivery plans.
  
  
Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills are critical. The individual will coordinate cross-functional workstreams, manage risks and dependencies, drive governance, and communicate progress and decisions effectively to senior leaders, internal teams, and external partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute product roadmaps for payment network capabilities aligned with enterprise priorities, market needs, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of capabilities across Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations.
* Translate business, customer, partner, and regulatory needs into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery milestones.
* Apply strong understanding of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, processing, transaction flows, and network specifications to guide product decisions.
* Ensure solutions meet intended business outcomes and consider scalability, security, resilience, operational readiness, and interoperability.
* Partner with Engineering and Quality Assurance teams across solution design, development, testing, implementation, and post-launch readiness.
* Maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions.
* Coordinate execution across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and external partner teams.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and blockers, drive mitigation, and escalate matters requiring leadership attention.
* Prepare concise executive updates, dashboards, roadmaps, and governance materials, translating complex topics for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build trusted relationships and influence decisions across global, cross-functional, and highly matrixed teams.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Management, or related field.
* Relevant experience in payment network products, digital payments, product management, network delivery, or payment technology.
* Strong understanding of the payment's ecosystem, including networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, and digital payment providers.
* Knowledge of payment transaction flows and capabilities such as authorization, authentication, tokenization, clearing, and settlement.
* Experience delivering products or capabilities through requirements, development, testing, implementation, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated project or program management experience across multiple teams, workstreams, risks, and dependencies.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear product and technical deliverables.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, executive communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and highly matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience working with payment networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, digital wallet providers, or network capability modernization programs is strongly preferred.
* Experience with Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, SafeKey, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, or Network-to-Network integrations.
* Knowledge of card processing, payment message flows, network specifications, and payment operations.
* Experience delivering complex modernization, migration, regulatory, or market-enablement initiatives.
* Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience with Agile or SAFe delivery methodologies and knowledge of Rally, JIRA, Confluence, or similar tools.
* Experience engaging with external network partners, processors, vendors, or payment ecosystem participants.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Core Network
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Part Of**
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
  
  
****What you'll be responsible for****
You will own the product strategy and evolution of the CPN Payments Engine — the core infrastructure that powers payment creation, routing, settlement, and lifecycle management across the network. You’ll define the long-term vision and roadmap for the engine, identifying opportunities to expand its capabilities while improving reliability, performance, and scale. Working across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams, you’ll lead complex product decisions and investments that enable OFIs and BFIs to move money efficiently across an expanding set of corridors and rails, translating platform improvements into measurable network and business outcomes.
  
  
****What you'll work on****

* Set the Payments Engine strategy: Own the long-term product vision and roadmap for payment creation, processing, routing, and settlement, aligning investments with CPN and Circle priorities.
* Advance payment performance at scale: Establish the product strategy for improving success rates, latency, resilience, and processing efficiency, using data to identify systemic opportunities and prioritize investments.
* Evolve API and protocol capabilities: Define the direction for OFI Payments APIs and BFI quoting and settlement protocols, balancing developer experience, interoperability, compliance, scalability, and network reliability.
* Expand the capabilities of the network: Identify and lead investments that unlock new payment use cases, corridors, rails, and partner capabilities while building reusable infrastructure that scales across the network.
* Shape observability and operational control: Define product capabilities for monitoring, alerting, exception management, and operational tooling that improve visibility into payment health and enable faster resolution of network issues.
* Lead complex cross-functional decisions: Partner with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, BD, and other product leaders to navigate architectural and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and drive alignment on high-impact investments.
* Establish product leadership for payment infrastructure: Develop frameworks, metrics, and product practices that improve decision-making across CPN, mentor other product managers, and serve as a subject matter expert on payment infrastructure across Circle.

****What you'll bring to Circle****
****Core requirements****

* 10+ years of relevant experience, including significant Product Management experience building payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure products.
* Deep experience owning platform or infrastructure products such as APIs, payment processing systems, settlement platforms, routing systems, or developer-facing capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to define product strategy and lead highly complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering and cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical and technical fluency, with the ability to use payment performance, reliability, and operational data to identify systemic issues and guide product investment decisions.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements to large-scale systems, including reliability, success rates, latency, scalability, operational efficiency, or customer outcomes.
* Ability to evaluate complex technical and business trade-offs and translate them into clear product decisions, priorities, and long-term platform investments.
* Strong cross-functional influence and communication skills, including the ability to build alignment with senior leaders and stakeholders across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Deep knowledge of payment networks, cross-border payments, settlement systems, correspondent banking, stablecoins, or blockchain-based financial infrastructure.
* Experience with enterprise API products, two-sided networks, and compliance-forward payment systems, including concepts such as SLAs, payment lifecycle events, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or the Travel Rule.

**This role is based in our Bangalore office and requires employees to work from the office on a regular basis.**

*Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.*

. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: Principal, Partnerships Product
jobs.description:
**About Tala**
Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.
  
  
The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.
  
  
Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.
  
  
Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
**Role's Mission**
Own the product strategy and execution for Tala’s embedded lending partnerships in Africa, Asia and Europe. You will assess which opportunities are worth pursuing, design the right credit solution for each partner context, shape commercial deals from a product perspective, and lead launches end to end. Working in close collaboration with the GTM team, you are the product voice in partner conversations and the person responsible for what gets built, launched, and grown.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Evolve the framework for evaluating partner opportunities in your regions/markets and work with the Commercial team to prioritize the pipeline accordingly
* Lead product discussions with partners to define what Tala can build, shape data and integration terms, and ensure deal structure supports the right product outcomes
* Design the credit product configuration for each partnership and lead the end-to-end build and launch, from API and integration specs through pilot design, cross-functional execution, and first-cycle review
* Own post-launch performance across your portfolio and identify growth levers within live partnerships spanning across new products, deeper data integrations, and expanded customer segments
* Partner with various internal and external stakeholders on the partnerships capabilities roadmap, defining what Tala needs to build to support embedded lending at scale (APIs, partner-facing tooling, configurable credit modules, on-chain lending infrastructure) and and drive this in close collaboration with core product, engineering, and data science teams
* Contribute to Tala’s Partnerships product strategy: how the embedded lending product evolves, what partner-facing capabilities need to be built, and how risk signals compounds in value as the ecosystem grows

**What You'll Need**

* 8-12+ years in product management, with a strong track record in fintech or embedded finance in emerging markets; experience with externally-integrated or partnership-dependent products is essential
* Strong credit product instincts. Ability to assess whether a partner flow supports a specific product, design the right configuration, and write specs that engineering and risk can execute against
* Deep understanding of digital money flows in emerging markets and the credit products that map to them: BNPL, earned wage access, revenue-based advances, remittance bridges, and stablecoin-denominated credit
* Comfortable in commercial conversations. Ability to engage with partner counterparts on deal structure, data terms, and integration trade-offs, and shape outcomes alongside a Commercial counterpart without blurring ownership
* Fluency with crypto and stablecoin product structures, including on-chain lending mechanics, USDC-denominated credit flows, and stablecoin corridor dynamics

Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. We strongly believe that inclusion fosters innovation and we’re proud to have a diverse global team that represents a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and experience. We hire talented people regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Jupiter**

Jupiter is a money app for people who are building their lives in India. From one app you can open a savings account with our partner bank, pay on UPI, save towards goals in Pots, borrow, buy insurance, invest, and see where your money actually goes. Our Edge+ CSB Bank RuPay credit card works on UPI and earns Jewels, our rewards currency, on the brands people already shop with.

We are a product company at heart. We obsess over small details, we read what customers tell us, and we would rather do fewer things properly than many things badly.

**Why this role exists**

AI is already part of how Jupiter works. Our product team uses an in-house assistant that reads our Confluence, Figma, Amplitude, Databricks and support tickets to answer questions and draft PRDs, right inside Slack. Engineering has a bot that turns a Jira ticket into a draft pull request. Marketing has a creative studio that designs ads, critiques its own work against a checklist and tells us what every run cost.

Those started as tools for us. The next step is bigger: putting AI in front of customers in a product that handles their money, where a confident wrong answer is not a small bug. We are looking for a PM who wants to own that problem, with the judgement to know where AI helps and the discipline to prove it before it ships.

**What you will do**

* **Find the problems worth solving with AI.**
  Explaining a declined payment, making sense of a card bill, help that actually closes the ticket, a Money tab that answers questions in plain words. You will also say no to the ideas where a better screen would do the job.
* **Own products end to end.**
  Problem, PRD, evals, launch, and the numbers after launch. You stay with it until it works for customers, not until it is merged.
* **Write the evals before the feature.**
  Define what good looks like with real examples, build the test sets with engineering, and decide the score that is good enough to ship. When the model changes, you know within a day whether things got better or worse.
* **Design for the moments AI gets it wrong.**
  What the assistant says when it does not know, when it hands over to a person, and how a customer corrects it. These moments decide whether people trust us.
* **Keep it safe and compliant.**
  Work with compliance, risk and our partner banks so everything we build respects RBI guidelines, the DPDP Act and our partners' policies. Customer data stays where it belongs.
* **Treat cost and speed as product decisions.**
  Know what each conversation costs, pick the right model for each job, and cut what does not earn its keep.
* **Raise the bar for the whole team.**
  Help other PMs, designers and analysts use AI well in their own work, and keep improving the internal tools they already rely on.

**Your first 90 days**

* **By day 30:**
  you use Jupiter every day, have read a few hundred support conversations, have sat with ops and compliance, and know our internal AI tools by using them.
* **By day 60:**
  you have picked one customer problem, made the case for it with real data, and put a working prototype in front of colleagues.
* **By day 90:**
  you have an eval set, a launch plan with guardrails, and a small rollout to real customers with one clear success metric.

**You will do well here if you**

* Have 4 to 8 years in product, with at least one AI or ML product shipped to real users. A demo does not count; something people used does.
* Can explain in plain words how language models fail (making things up, prompt injection, behaviour shifting between model versions) and how you would design around each.
* Are comfortable writing prompts, reading a model's outputs in bulk and spotting the pattern in what went wrong.
* Use data without being asked. You can write SQL, build a funnel in Amplitude, and tell a real change from noise.
* Write clearly. Your PRDs are short, specific and something an engineer can build from.
* Care about the person on the other side of the screen, especially when the subject is their money.

**Good to have**

* Experience in fintech, payments, lending or another regulated space.
* You have built with the Claude or OpenAI APIs yourself, even on a side project.
* Hands-on time with retrieval (RAG), agents that use tools, or eval tooling.
* You can sketch a flow in Figma before a designer picks it up.

**What you will work with**

* Claude and other frontier models through our AI gateway, and MCP to connect agents to our systems.
* Amplitude, Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma and Sense UI, our design system.
* A React Native app, and engineers, designers and analysts who like to move quickly and measure what they ship.

**How we work**

* Small teams own outcomes, not tickets.
* Decisions are written down with the reasoning, so anyone can pick up the thread later.
* We are honest about results. If a launch did not work, we say so and fix it.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Aspora**
People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.
  
  
Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.
  
  
We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.
  
  
**About The Role**
People build lives across borders, and Aspora helps the Indian diaspora send money home and grow wealth in India. Growth here is won in a user’s first three months: a friend’s referral, a first transfer, a return next month. This role exists to turn that journey into a growth engine that compounds with every new cohort. You will own growth for our product, working closely with design, engineering, data and our CLM team.
  
  
You decide which bets to make, how big they should be, and when to stop one that isn’t working. What you build will shape how fast Aspora grows, and the growth playbook we take into every new market
  
  
Location
  
  
In Office || Bangalore
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* This is a role with full ownership of the journey at the heart of Aspora’s core business.
* Diagnose where growth leaks. Go deep into funnels on every launch and older bet, and publish insights the whole team acts on.
* Own the number and the path. Check the numbers daily, hold a clear view on opportunity areas, and open new growth threads.
* Grow referral and activation. Ship reward constructs and product bets that bring more users in and get them to a first transfer.
* Make new users stay. Lift retention in the first three months by turning a first transfer into a monthly habit.
* Size every bet to matter. Set the payback before launch, read the result honestly, and call it early when a bet isn’t working.
* Build trust after every transfer. Shape the post-transfer experience so customers feel informed and in control, even when timing slips.

What We’re Looking For
  
  
You’re not someone who measures a quarter by features shipped. You measure it by the number you moved, and you can show exactly how.
  
  

* You’ve moved a growth number. You owned an acquisition, activation or retention metric in a consumer app and can walk through what moved it.
* You live in the data. You write your own SQL or analytics queries and read an experiment properly: control groups, sample checks, significance.
* You’ve run rewards with a payback. You designed referral, cashback or incentive programmes with the unit economics worked out before launch.
* You ship experiments end to end. Hypothesis, launch, readout and the next iteration, more than once, on dates you agreed and kept.
* You go to the source. You’ve turned user calls, session replays or research into a product decision that changed what shipped.
* You know consumer products. You’ve built product or growth at a consumer app, and Indian consumer fintech experience is a strong plus.
* You own the goal, not the task. You hold the number, the path to it and the next thread to pull, without waiting to be asked.
* Most importantly, you want a number that is clearly yours, in a business where every cohort you keep compounds.

Why Aspora?
  
  

* Own growth end to end, the core of Aspora’s business, with a number that is clearly yours.
* Set the growth playbook Aspora carries into new markets and the products we build on top of remittance.
* Full ownership from day one, not a slice of someone else’s roadmap.
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora’s long-term vision.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Summary
  
  
Client Services provides a world-class service experience to Visa's clients that begins with pre-sales and continues through onboarding, implementation of new products and services, issue resolution and service optimization.
  
  
The Client Services Digital and AI organization is dedicated to transforming and automating business processes across the end-to-end client service journey, making client and employee interactions with Visa straightforward, intuitive, and rewarding through the design, development, and delivery of enhanced digital experiences. jobs.title: Senior Associate Finance
jobs.description:
**Senior Associate Finance****Who We Are?**

**We're GrowthSchool. And we built Outskill.**

GrowthSchool started with one belief: you learn a skill fastest from the person actually doing it. So we partnered with the top 1% of instructors to build high-impact, cohort-based courses in personal and professional growth for learners around the world, and used AI to make that learning personal at a scale a classroom never could.

Then AI changed what **upskilling** even means. Roles started getting rewritten faster than curriculums could keep up, and the real divide stopped being skilled versus unskilled. It became AI-ready versus not.

So, we built **Outskill**, our AI education arm, to close that gap practical, implementation-first AI training for professionals, teams and enterprises. Today, GrowthSchool and Outskill have reached **16M+ learners across 160+ countries**, with programs running everywhere from individual upskilling to enterprise AI transformation.

**Our mission: Make 100 million people AI-ready by 2028.**

**What that actually feels like day to day:** We're 300+ people, backed by Sequoia, moving at a speed that surprises most people who join us. Products ship in weeks, not quarters. There's no thick layer of process between an idea and it going live. You'll own things visibly bigger than your title. Some experiments will fail publicly, and we'll talk about them openly on Monday.

If you need a finished playbook before you start, this will be uncomfortable. If you'd rather write the playbook, you'll like it here.

**Why This Role Exists**

As GrowthSchool continues to scale, our finance function needs strong execution at the operational level to ensure that everyday accounting, payments, reconciliations and compliance activities run smoothly.

We're looking for a **Senior Associate Finance** who can independently manage day-to-day accounting and finance operations, maintain accurate financial records, support audits and ensure timely execution of recurring finance activities.

This is a hands-on role where you'll take ownership of the operational backbone of our finance function ensuring accuracy, discipline and reliability across financial transactions and administrative processes.

You'll work closely with the Finance team and internal stakeholders to build structured processes that can support the company's growing business operations.

**What You'll Do**Day-to-Day Accounting & Finance Operations

* Record and maintain daily financial transactions accurately in the accounting system.
* Manage accounts payable and receivable, including invoice processing, payment tracking and follow-ups.
* Perform regular bank, vendor and ledger reconciliations.
* Manage employee reimbursements, expense claims and related documentation.
* Support monthly and year-end book closure activities.
* Maintain organized financial records, vouchers, invoices and supporting documents.
* Identify discrepancies in financial transactions and ensure timely resolution.

Statutory Compliance & Audit Support

* Assist with GST, TDS and other applicable statutory filings and returns.
* Prepare and share financial data, reconciliations and schedules required for statutory, tax and internal audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, vendors and internal teams for audit-related requirements.
* Support the finance team in meeting regulatory and compliance deadlines.
* Maintain proper documentation and records for compliance and audit purposes.
* Ensure financial information and supporting documents are readily available whenever required.

Asset Management & Administrative Operations

* Conduct periodic physical verification of company assets.
* Maintain and update the fixed asset register.
* Track asset additions, transfers, disposals and related documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for day-to-day finance and operational requirements.
* Handle documentation, filing and record-keeping for the finance function.
* Support miscellaneous administrative activities required to keep finance operations running smoothly.

Process Discipline & Operational Excellence

* Follow established accounting processes and ensure accuracy in daily execution.
* Maintain timely updates across payments, receivables and reconciliations.
* Identify operational gaps and suggest improvements in existing finance workflows.
* Ensure recurring finance activities are completed within defined timelines.
* Maintain strong documentation and process discipline across all assigned responsibilities.

What Success Looks Like (First 612 Months)

* Daily accounting is accurate, timely and error-free.
* Payments, receivables and reconciliations are processed on schedule without backlogs.
* Statutory and compliance data is always ready ahead of deadlines.
* Audits are supported smoothly with well-organized documentation.
* Fixed asset records are accurate and physical verification is completed on time.
* Financial records, vouchers and supporting documents are properly maintained.
* Finance operations run reliably with strong process discipline and accountability.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a **detail-oriented and execution-focused finance professional** who takes ownership of day-to-day accounting operations and understands the importance of accuracy, consistency and timely execution.

The ideal candidate combines **strong accounting fundamentals, hands-on experience with accounting systems, compliance knowledge and operational discipline.**

Must-Have

* **B.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter** qualification.
* **Up to 3 years of experience** in accounting and finance operations, preferably in an industry environment.
* Hands-on experience managing daily accounting transactions and maintaining books of accounts.
* Working knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoice processing and payment management.
* Experience in bank, vendor and ledger reconciliations.
* Hands-on experience with accounting software such as **Tally, Zoho Books or similar platforms**.
* Strong working knowledge of **MS Excel**.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS and other applicable statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting statutory, tax and internal audits.
* Experience managing employee reimbursements, expense claims and financial documentation.
* Understanding of fixed asset management and asset register maintenance.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage recurring tasks independently and meet deadlines.
* Strong ownership, accountability and follow-through.

Good-to-Have

* Experience working in **startups or high-growth organizations**.
* Exposure to **AI, EdTech, SaaS or B2B technology companies**.
* Experience managing finance operations across multiple business entities.
* Familiarity with finance automation tools and digital accounting workflows.
* Knowledge of advanced Excel functions and financial reporting.
* Experience improving accounting processes and operational workflows.
* Ability to leverage technology to improve finance operations and reporting efficiency.

What We're Evaluating

We're less interested in how many years you've worked and more interested in how much ownership you've demonstrated.

We'll be looking for evidence of:

* Ownership of day-to-day accounting and operational accuracy.
* Strong understanding of core accounting principles and processes.
* Reliability in managing recurring tasks, reconciliations and compliance data.
* High attention to detail with strong process discipline.
* Ability to identify discrepancies and resolve issues independently.
* Bias toward execution, accountability and follow-through.
* Ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving environments.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build the finance foundations of one of India's fastest-growing learning companies.
* Direct exposure to Finance leadership and business operations.
* High ownership from Day 1 with real responsibility for finance oper

About Sylox

Sylox is a technology company specializing in enterprise data engineering, integration, analytics and data governance. We design and deliver data solutions for enterprises, including organizations operating in regulated industries.

We are working on a cloud-native
**Banking Data Lakehouse on Google Cloud**
, bringing together data from multiple enterprise systems to support analytics, regulatory reporting and fraud detection.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Business Analyst**
to work closely with banking stakeholders, the Program Manager and our data engineering team on an enterprise Banking Data Lakehouse project.

The role involves understanding complex banking requirements, translating them into functional and data specifications, supporting delivery activities and coordinating directly with client stakeholders.

This is a hands-on, client-facing position requiring strong business analysis, banking domain expertise, data understanding and excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering**

* Work with stakeholders to define banking data flows, business rules and reporting requirements.

* Gather requirements for data ingestion, transformation, APIs, dashboards and analytics.
* Capture regulatory reporting, fraud analytics, data security and governance requirements.
* Coordinate with data engineers to validate business rules, data quality and reporting outputs.

**3. Project Coordination & Delivery**

* Work closely with the Program Manager and engineering teams to manage requirements and delivery priorities.
* Support backlog refinement, sprint activities, issue tracking and project documentation.
* Track deliverables, dependencies, risks and stakeholder decisions.
* Maintain requirement-to-test-to-release traceability.
* Assess changes in requirements and their impact on project scope, timelines and deliverables.

**4. Client Engagement & UAT**

* Participate in regular client meetings and requirement discussions in Mumbai.
* Coordinate UAT planning, test scenarios, defect resolution and business sign-offs.
* Maintain clear communication with banking stakeholders and internal technical teams.
* Ensure requirements are validated against business expectations before release.

Required Skills & Experience

* **4–8 years**
  of relevant Business Analysis experience.

* Strong understanding of core banking, payments and banking data processes.
* Good working knowledge of SQL, data mapping, reconciliation and data validation.
* Experience in data lakehouse, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, analytics or BI projects.
* Strong documentation skills: BRD, FRD, user stories, acceptance criteria and UAT.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence or equivalent Agile delivery tools.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly BigQuery.
* Familiarity with modern data lakehouse architecture and cloud-native data processing.
* Exposure to fraud analytics, banking regulatory reporting or data governance.
* Experience working directly with enterprise banking clients.
* Knowledge of data quality, metadata management and data security principles.

**Job Title:** Senior SEO Executive Real Estate

**Department:** Marketing

**Experience:** 35 Years

**Industry:** Real Estate / Infrastructure / Digital Marketing

**Location:** Pune

**Reporting To:** Digital Marketing Manager / Marketing Head

**1. Job Purpose**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior SEO Executive to manage and execute SEO strategies for our real estate projects. The candidate will be responsible for improving website rankings, driving organic traffic, generating quality leads, and strengthening the company's online presence across search engines.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. SEO Strategy & Execution**

* Develop and implement SEO strategies for company websites and individual real estate projects.
* Improve organic search rankings for targeted real estate keywords.
* Conduct keyword research based on property types, locations, project names and buyer search intent.
* Perform competitor analysis and identify opportunities to improve search visibility.
* Optimize website content, landing pages and project pages.

**B. On-Page SEO**

* Optimize meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs and internal linking.
* Ensure proper keyword placement and content optimization.
* Improve website structure, navigation and user experience.
* Implement image optimization and SEO -friendly content practices.

**C. Off-Page SEO**

* Plan and execute quality link-building strategies.
* Manage back link generation and monitor back link profiles.
* Identify guest posting, business listing and relevant directory submission opportunities.
* Improve domain authority through ethical SEO practices.

**D. Technical SEO**

* Monitor website health, crawlability and indexing.
* Identify and resolve technical SEO issues.
* Optimize website speed, mobile responsiveness and Core Web Vitals.
* Manage XML sitemaps, robots. txt, canonical tags and redirects.
* Coordinate with the website development team for technical improvements.

**E. Local SEO & Real Estate Marketing**

* Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles.
* Improve local search visibility for real estate projects and locations.
* Optimize project-specific landing pages targeting locations such as Pune, Kharadi, Hinjewadi, Hadapsar and other relevant micro-markets.
* Focus on location-based keywords to generate relevant property enquiries.

**F. Analytics & Reporting**

* Monitor website performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Search Console.
* Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, website engagement and conversions.
* Prepare monthly SEO performance reports.
* Analyse organic lead generation and recommend improvement strategies.

**3. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of SEO techniques and search engine algorithms.
* Expertise in keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
* Knowledge of SEO tools such as SEM rush, Ahrefs, Moz or Screaming Frog.
* Understanding of WordPress and website content management systems.
* Knowledge of technical, on-page and off-page SEO.
* Understanding of lead generation and digital marketing funnels.
* Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.

\* Stay updated on digital marketing trends, platform updates, and industry best practices.

\* Plan and maintain a monthly digital marketing calendar.

\* Create engaging content including social media posts, reels, stories, videos, blogs, captions, campaign copy, and other marketing collaterals.

\* Develop content that is relevant to the target audience and aligned with the brands positioning and tone of voice.

**4. Social Media Management & Community Management**

  

\* Manage the brands social media platforms and ensure regular, consistent communication.

\* Monitor and respond to comments, messages, mentions, and customer queries.

\* Build meaningful engagement and foster a strong online community.

\* Handle customer feedback and complaints professionally, coordinating with relevant teams where required.

  

**5. Campaign Management Brand Awareness**

\* Manage paid social media campaigns across platforms such as Meta.

\* Execute influencer collaborations, brand partnerships, contests, and other digital initiatives.

**6. Performance Tracking & Analytics**

  

\* Track key digital marketing metrics, including reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, website traffic, and campaign performance.

jobs.description:
**Company:** Qualcomm India Private Limited

**Job Area:** Sales, Business Development Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development Marketing Group > Marketing

**Job Summary**

The Digital Analytics Manager will support enterprise digital analytics operations by translating Business Measurement Requirements (BRDs) into Solution Design Reference (SDRs) including data-layer design, web tagging, validation, governance, and reporting solutions. The role partners with marketing, legal privacy, IT, development teams, platform owners, and external agencies to implement and sustain reliable analytics across websites and digital experiences. The position combines hands-on Adobe Analytics and Adobe Data Collection expertise with structured project follow-through, quality assurance, issue triage, documentation, and stakeholder coordination

**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and enhance website and application analytics using Adobe Analytics, Adobe Data Collection/Launch, Adobe Data Layer patterns, events, variables, report suites, segments, and calculated metrics.
* Translate business requirements into measurement specifications, data-layer requirements, solution design references, pixel intake requirements, test plans, and acceptance criteria.
* Perform stage and production QA/UAT for page views, search interactions, downloads, login events, campaign pixels, consent signals, URL-based behaviors, and other digital interactions.
* Maintain analytics privacy and data-minimization requirements by identifying unintended user-data collection, defining remediation requirements, validating changes, and escalating unresolved risks.
* Support consent-management integrations and validation, including alignment between consent signals, Adobe Web SDK/Data Collection, analytics behavior, and regional privacy requirements.
* Conduct analytics environment governance activities, including audits and cleanup of unused segments and calculated metrics, documentation maintenance, naming standards, and configuration hygiene.
* Monitor analytics health through alerts, anomaly review, website scans, tag validation, and investigation of broken or inconsistent tracking.
* Coordinate work through Workfront, Jira, ServiceNow, email, and recurring backlog reviews; create and follow up on tickets, track dependencies, communicate blockers, and confirm production completion.
* Prepare recurring project status updates and supporting documentation for analytics operations, including in-flight work, backlog, risks, completion status, and next steps.
* Provide tool support, access administration, knowledge transfer, and technical guidance for Adobe Analytics and related MarTech platforms.
* Collaborate across time zones with internal teams, consultants, agencies, and vendors, serving as a technical point of contact for analytics implementation and validation work.
* Maintain the platform roadmap and backlog; prioritize enhancements with stakeholders
* Build and maintain operational dashboards for usage, adoption, and operational metrics

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years administering enterprise Adobe Analytics and Adobe Data Collections
* Demonstrated experience implementing and validating digital analytics for websites or web applications.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics, Adobe Data Collection/Launch, browser debugging, data layers, events, variables, segments, calculated metrics, and report-suite validation.
* Ability to read technical requirements, inspect browser behavior, test across stage and production environments, and clearly document defects and expected outcomes.
* Experience coordinating work with software developers, IT teams, product owners, analytics stakeholders, privacy partners, agencies, and vendors.
* Working knowledge of digital privacy, consent signals, data minimization, and responsible collection of user-related information.
* Experience using work-management and incident-tracking systems such as Workfront, Jira, and ServiceNow.
* Strong written communication, follow-through, documentation, prioritization, and cross-time-zone collaboration skills.
* Knowledge of analytics governance practices, naming conventions, solution design documentation, dashboard delivery, and operational reporting.
* Adobe Analytics or related digital analytics certification is beneficial.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.
* OR Associate's degree or equivalent degree and 5+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.
* OR High school Diploma or equivalent and 7+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.

jobs.title: Senior Manager-Enterprise Digital Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Digital Deployment Strategy**

* Define the overall deployment and rollout strategy for enterprise digital products, platforms, and services.
* Develop deployment roadmaps covering **PoC, Pilot, MVP, Production, Phased Rollout, and Enterprise Scale**.
* Determine rollout sequencing across business units, locations, channels, customer segments, or operating environments.
* Identify deployment dependencies, constraints, risks, assumptions, and readiness requirements early in the lifecycle.
* Define repeatable deployment frameworks, playbooks, and patterns that can be used across multiple digital initiatives.
* Align deployment strategy with business priorities, technology strategy, enterprise architecture, security requirements, and operational capabilities.

**2. Solutioning & Deployment Architecture**

* Translate business and product requirements into **deployable enterprise solutions**.
* Lead solutioning discussions across application, API, integration, cloud, data, AI, security, infrastructure, and operations.
* Work with Enterprise and Solution Architects to determine the appropriate technical approach and deployment model.
* Assess **build, buy, partner, reuse, and platform-based** options.
* Identify gaps in existing enterprise capabilities that could prevent successful deployment.
* Ensure solutions are designed with production deployment, scalability, resilience, security, observability, and supportability in mind.

**3. Cross-functional Program Orchestration**

* Drive execution across multiple product, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, operations, business, and partner teams.
* Establish a common deployment plan with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and decision points.
* Track cross-team dependencies and actively drive closure of blockers.
* Manage deployment risks, issues, assumptions, and escalations.
* Establish governance and operating cadence for large or strategically important rollout programs.
* Ensure all participating teams remain aligned to the deployment objective, timelines, and production outcomes.
* Facilitate executive-level reviews and decision-making where cross-functional intervention is required.

**4. Deployment Readiness**

* Define and manage **deployment readiness criteria** across technology and business dimensions.
* Ensure readiness of environments, infrastructure, integrations, data, security controls, observability, support processes, documentation, and operational teams.
* Coordinate UAT, pilot readiness, production readiness, cutover, and go-live activities.
* Identify gaps that may create operational or business risk after launch.
* Establish readiness checkpoints and ensure exceptions are explicitly assessed and managed.

**5. Product Rollout & Enterprise Scale**

* Drive successful production deployment and phased rollout of digital products and services.
* Coordinate launch activities across technology and business teams.
* Monitor deployment progress, adoption, operational issues, and business readiness during rollout.
* Lead resolution of issues that prevent or delay deployment and scale.
* Define expansion strategies for successful pilots and early deployments.
* Standardize successful deployment approaches for reuse across other products, business units, and markets.

**6. Business & Stakeholder Alignment**

* Work closely with business leaders and product teams to understand deployment objectives, constraints, and expected outcomes.
* Translate business priorities into actionable deployment strategies and execution plans.
* Communicate complex technical dependencies and risks in a clear business context.
* Build alignment across stakeholders with potentially conflicting priorities.
* Drive timely decisions on scope, sequencing, dependencies, investment, and deployment approach.
* Act as a key interface between business leadership and technology execution teams.

**7. Technology & Platform Readiness**

* Assess whether existing enterprise platforms and technology capabilities are sufficient to support large-scale deployment.
* Drive reuse of enterprise capabilities such as identity, integration, data, cloud, AI, observability, security, and common platforms.
* Identify platform capabilities that need to be enhanced to enable product rollout.
* Promote standardization of deployment and integration approaches across digital initiatives.
* Ensure new deployments do not create unnecessary technology duplication or fragmented architectures.

**8. Partner & Vendor Orchestration**

* Work with system integrators, technology vendors, cloud providers, startups, and strategic partners involved in deployment.
* Define technical and delivery boundaries between internal and external teams.
* Review partner solution approaches and deployment plans.
* Ensure partner dependencies and deliverables are aligned with enterprise rollout milestones.
* Drive resolution of cross-partner integration and deployment issues.

**9. Post-deployment Scale & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure structured transition from implementation into stable business-as-usual operations.
* Track deployment outcomes, adoption, operational performance, and user feedback.
* Identify recurring deployment bottlenecks and opportunities for process or platform improvement.
* Capture lessons learned and convert them into reusable deployment patterns.
* Continuously improve the enterprise approach to digital rollout and scale.

**Key Deliverables**

The role will own or contribute to:

* Enterprise deployment and rollout strategies
* Deployment roadmaps and rollout plans
* Solutioning and deployment approaches
* Pilot-to-production plans
* Cross-functional execution plans
* Deployment readiness frameworks and checklists
* Dependency, risk, issue, and escalation management
* Cutover and go-live plans
* Deployment playbooks and reusable rollout patterns
* Production-readiness assessments
* Scale-up and enterprise adoption strategies
* Executive deployment reviews and decision papers

**Success Measures**

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

* Successful and timely **deployment of digital products and services**
* Reduction in **time from pilot to production**
* Successful enterprise rollout and coverage
* Reduction in deployment-related blockers and delays
* Effectiveness of cross-functional execution across multiple teams
* Production readiness and operational stability after launch
* Adoption and utilization of deployed capabilities
* Reuse of enterprise platforms and deployment patterns
* Reduction in duplicated technology and implementation effort
* Ability to scale successful pilots across the enterprise

**Required Experience & Skills**

* **5+ years of experience** in digital transformation, enterprise technology, solutioning, technology strategy, product deployment, program delivery, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience in **large-scale deployment or rollout of digital products, platforms, or technology services**.
* Strong experience coordinating multiple technology and business teams toward a common production outcome.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technology and solution architecture.
* Experience working across:

+ Cloud and hybrid-cloud environments
+ APIs and enterprise integration

**Job Title:**
Principal UX Designer

**About Backbase**

Backbase is a leading provider of digital banking solutions. Our mission is to help banks create seamless and engaging customer experiences. We are a global company with a strong presence across the globe in Europe, Asia, Africa, Middle East and the Americas. We value innovation, collaboration, and customer focus. Our team is passionate about making a difference in the financial industry.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Senior UX Designer to join our Services Middle East team in our Hyderabad office. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping the user experience for our innovative digital banking products. You will be involved in the entire design process, from ideation to prototyping and testing. You will work closely with cross-functional client-facing teams, including Backbase team members: project managers, business analysts, solution architects and engineers. Externally, you will work closely with senior and leadership-level client stakeholders to deliver user-centered design solutions that meet their business goals. This is a hybrid position, requiring a mix of in-office and remote work, while being flexible for client travel.

As a client-facing UX Designer, you will be a key point of contact for our clients, leading workshops, gathering requirements, and presenting design solutions. This requires excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build rapport and work effectively with clients from diverse backgrounds.

**Responsibilities:**

* Create user flows, wireframes, and prototypes to communicate design concepts.
* Design high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes.
* Conduct usability testing to validate design decisions and iterate on designs.

* Confidently present and explain design decisions to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of design systems.
* Stay up-to-date on the latest UX design trends and best practices.
* Support development and QA teams regarding designs.

**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience as a UX Designer, with experience in a client-facing role.
* A strong portfolio showcasing user-centered design solutions.
* Proficiency in Figma.
* Solid understanding of UX research methodologies and usability testing principles.
* Experience working with design systems.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Experience leading and facilitating workshops.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
* Fluency in English.
* Ability to effectively convey design specifications and rationale to the technical members of the team.

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience working in the financial, consultancy or technology industry.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies.

**Please note:**

* We are looking for someone who is passionate about user-centered design and has a strong understanding of UX principles.
* Your portfolio should showcase your design process and demonstrate your ability to solve real-world problems.
* We are particularly interested in seeing examples of your work that demonstrate your skills in interaction design.
* We are looking for someone who is a team player and has excellent communication skills.

**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
****Process Overview****
ARQ supports global businesses of the Bank with solutions requiring judgment application, sound business understanding and analytical perspective. The domain experience in the areas of Financial Research & Analysis, Quantitative Modeling, Risk Management and Prospecting Support provide solutions for revenue enhancement, risk mitigation and cost optimization. The division comprising of highly qualified associates operates from three locations i.e. Mumbai, GIFT City, Gurugram, Chennai and Hyderabad.
  
  
****Job Description****
As the Platform Product Manager, you will own the platform strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for GRM wide risk data aggregation and reporting solutions. You will work cross-functionally with risk, compliance, data governance, technology, and business leadership to ensure the platform meets both regulatory requirements and internal risk management needs. You will champion data quality, lineage, aggregation, controls, and automation while embedding sustainability, scalability, and auditability into platform capabilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Define and maintain the platform vision, roadmap, and success criteria aligned to BCBS 239 principles.
* Translate regulatory expectations into actionable platform features and capabilities.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Technology, Data Governance, and Reporting teams to prioritize and deliver high-impact initiatives.
* Define and drive metadata management, lineage transparency, data quality monitoring, and report automation capabilities.
* Ensure the platform supports accuracy, completeness, adaptability, timeliness, and integrity of risk data.
* Collaborate with internal audit, compliance testing, and regulators on periodic reviews and assessments.
* Lead cross-functional agile squads prioritizing product backlogs, refining requirements, and overseeing product delivery.
* Develop KPI’s, platform health metrics, and risk data quality dashboards to monitor platform performance and compliance.
* Serve as the SME for BCBS 239 regulatory expectations related to data aggregation and risk reporting.

**Desired Skills:**

* 10 + years of experience in risk data management, regulatory risk reporting, or data platform product management within a bank or financial services environment.
* Deep understanding of BCBS 239 principles and their practical implementation in a large organization.
* Strong experience working with risk reporting systems, data warehouses, reporting tools, and governance frameworks.
* Familiarity with data quality frameworks, metadata management, data lineage tools, and control monitoring.
* Proven track record of defining and delivering product roadmaps for complex data management or reporting platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Proficiency in Agile delivery methodologies (e.g. Scrum, SAFe).
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal and presentation) with the ability to translate regulatory language into actionable technical requirements.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

**Requirements :**

* Education : graduate
* Experience :Minimum 8+ years

 PRESALES LEAD / MIDDLE EAST RECRUITMENT & IT STAFFING

 Track proposal turnaround, bid-to-award conversion, quality, pricing accuracy and lost-bid reasons.

 On-time, compliant submissions; bid-to-award conversion; proposal quality and accuracy.

jobs.title: Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. jobs.title: Client Consulting Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.
* Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

What You Will Need to Be Successful:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and work with large data sets.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**Job #:**

req39473

IFC
