Relevant local language required (French, Spanish, German, Cantonese/Mandarin, Japanese, Portuguese, Hindi)

  

**Closing Date:**

11/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
Role: Senior Accountant   
 Experience: 5+ years   
 Location: Bengaluru

**Job Overview:** We are seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Senior Accountant to join our Finance team.   
 The Senior Accountant will manage end-to-end accounting operations, statutory compliance, project-wise Profitability reporting, and management information systems (MIS). The role requires strong ownership of monthly financial closing, project P&L analysis, dashboards, and automated reporting using Power BI and AI-enabled tools.

**Primary Roles & Responsibilities:**   
 **A. Accounting and Financial Operations**   
  
 Manage the general ledger, journal entries, accruals, provisions, depreciation, fixed assets, and intercompany   
 accounting.

Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, vendor reconciliations, customer reconciliations, and bank   
 reconciliation statements.   
  
 Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.   
 Prepare accurate financial statements, including Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement, and supporting schedules.   
  
 Review ledger balances, investigate exceptions, and ensure proper accounting classification.   
 Support budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow planning, and variance analysis.

**B. Project-wise P&L Management**   
  
 Maintain project-wise cost centres and ensure accurate allocation of direct and indirect expenses.

Prepare and monitor project-wise P&L, revenue recognition, gross margin, budget-versus-actual analysis, and   
 profitability reports.   
   
 Track project costs, unbilled revenue, advances, receivables, payables, and work-in-progress where applicable.   
 Work closely with project managers and business teams to validate costs, revenue, project budgets, and forecast   
 margins.   
  
 Identify cost overruns, revenue leakages, margin risks, and recommend corrective actions.

**C. Statutory Compliance**   
   
 Ensure timely and accurate compliance with GST, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, annual returns, input tax credit reconciliation, e-invoicing, and e-way bill requirements.

Manage TDS/TCS calculation, deduction, payment, quarterly returns, Form 16/16A, and reconciliation with the income-tax portal.

Coordinate compliance relating to Professional Tax, PF, ESI, Labour Welfare Fund, and other applicable statutory requirements.

Support income-tax assessments, notices, GST audits, and regulatory queries in coordination with tax consultants.

Maintain statutory registers, compliance calendars, challans, returns, and supporting documentation.

Liaise with internal auditors, statutory auditors, tax auditors, banks, and external consultants. Senior-accountant roles in India commonly include GST/TDS filings, audit support, reconciliations, and financial statement   
 preparation.

**D. Reporting, MIS, and Dashboards**   
  
Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly MIS reports for management.

Develop dashboards for revenue, project profitability, budget versus actuals, cash flow, receivables ageing, payables ageing, collections, and expense trends.   
   
 Build interactive Power BI reports using accounting, ERP, CRM, payroll, and project-management data.

Create data models, refresh schedules, report templates, and validation controls to ensure dashboard accuracy.

Use advanced Excel tools such as Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, formulas, and charts for analysis and reporting.

Present key financial insights, trends, variances, and risks clearly to senior management. Management dashboards often focus on receivables, revenue analysis, ageing, DSO, and variance reporting.

**E. AI and Process Automation**    
  
Use AI-enabled reporting tools responsibly to accelerate data cleaning, report drafting, variance analysis, and management commentary.

Identify opportunities to automate routine reconciliations, report generation, invoice processing, and compliance   
 trackers.

Ensure that all AI-generated outputs are reviewed, reconciled to source records, and handled in line with company data-security and confidentiality requirements.

Partner with IT, ERP, and business teams to improve data quality and reporting workflows.

**F. Controls and Audit**   
   
 Strengthen internal controls across accounting, payments, approvals, revenue recognition, and expense booking.

Maintain complete supporting documents and audit trails for financial transactions.

Assist with statutory audit, internal audit, tax audit, and management audit requirements.

Recommend process improvements to reduce errors, improve turnaround time, and enhance compliance.

**Qualifications & Skills:**   
   
 Bachelors degree in commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CA Inter, CMA Inter, or equivalent qualification is preferred.   
  
 Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in accounting, statutory compliance, financial reporting, and MIS.

Strong practical knowledge of Indian statutory requirements: GST, TDS/TCS, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Companies Act requirements, and income-tax compliance.   
   
 Experience with ERP/accounting systems such as Odoo, Tally, SAP, Oracle, Zoho Books, or similar.

Strong Power BI capability, including dashboards, data modelling, Power Query, DAX, and scheduled refreshes.

Advanced Microsoft Excel and strong analytical skills.

  

Experience with project accounting, cost-centre accounting, budget control, and project-wise P&L analysis.

High attention to detail, ownership, confidentiality, and ability to meet statutory deadlines.

jobs.title: Collections Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Assistant Manager / Manager Collections & Billing  
**Company:** Emversity  
**Work Location:** Marathahalli, Bengaluru (Work from Office)  
**Experience:** 4–8 years  
**Salary:** Up to 18,00,000 PA, depending on relevant experience and right fit  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Role Category:** Accounts Receivable / Credit Control / Collections  
**Employment Type:** Full Time, Permanent  
**Education:** Finance or Accounting graduate, M.Com/ CA/ CMA / MBA

**About Emversity**  
Emversity is an employability-led higher education and skill-development platform that turns learning outcomes into meaningful careers. We partner with universities and industry to deliver industry-integrated degree programmes and job-linked training across healthcare, allied health, hospitality and other emerging sectors, through a growing network of centres across India.

**Role Overview**  
We are looking for a hands-on, target-driven Assistant Manager / Manager – Collections & Billing to own the full cycle of converting billed revenue into cash, from data collection and proforma invoicing to final billing, follow-up and recovery, across university partnerships, student fees and operational centres. University billing involves coordinating with multiple internal teams and external university stakeholders, so this role demands strong working relationships, attention to detail and persistence. You will build a structured billing and collections process, drive daily follow-ups, track ageing, resolve reconciliation issues and make cash flows predictable. The role reports into senior Finance leadership and carries clear accountability for billing and collection performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

*University Billing & Proforma Invoicing*

* Own the end-to-end university billing process, from data collection to proforma invoice (PI) to final bill to payment follow-up.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect student, admission, enrolment and batch data sourced from universities.
* Validate data for accuracy and completeness against agreed commercial terms before raising invoices.
* Raise proforma invoices and manage multiple revisions based on university inputs and internal validations.
* Raise final invoices and bills with supporting documents once the PI is agreed and closed.
* Maintain a billing tracker showing PI status, revision history, approval status, invoice dates and pending inputs.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with university finance and administrative teams and internal stakeholders to keep the billing cycle smooth and timely.

*University & Institutional Collections*

* Own collections from partner universities against contractual commitments, revenue-share arrangements and admission-related services.
* Prepare and submit statements of accounts and payment claims with supporting documents on time.
* Maintain university-wise trackers covering invoice dates, payment terms, due dates and outstanding balances.
* Follow up regularly with university finance and accounts teams to secure timely payments.
* Reconcile billed amounts against university records, admissions, enrolments and batch details.
* Resolve discrepancies on TDS, deductions, debit/credit notes and revenue-share calculations.

*Student Fee Collections*

* Drive student fee recovery across programmes, universities, batches and centres.
* Maintain student-wise and semester-wise dues, payment schedules and overdue records.
* Follow up with students and parents through calls, emails, WhatsApp and other approved channels.
* Track payment commitments, identify chronic defaulters and loan-related delays, and escalate long-pending cases.

*Centre-Level Collections & Monitoring*

* Monitor daily collections across centres, regions and businesses against targets.
* Reconcile centre collections with bank credits, payment gateway settlements (UPI, online, bank transfer) and student records.
* Ensure timely deposit and accounting of collections, and investigate discrepancies.
* Work with Centre Heads and Regional Managers to improve performance at underperforming locations.

*Collections Planning, MIS & Reporting*

* Prepare monthly collection budgets, targets and weekly/daily collection plans.
* Forecast collections based on commitments, historical trends and ageing.
* Publish daily and weekly/monthly MIS: billing status, collections vs targets, university-wise and centre-wise performance, ageing, expected collections, disputed receivables and recovery trends.

*Process, Controls & Team*

* Set up SOPs for billing, follow-ups, escalations and reconciliation, including an ageing-based escalation matrix.
* Resolve unidentified receipts, short payments and pending bank reconciliations.
* Recommend settlements, waivers and write-offs only through the approved process.
* Support Legal and business teams in recovering disputed receivables.
* Lead and review collection and billing executives, and coordinate with Finance, University Partnerships, Admissions, Centre Operations and Legal.

**KPIs**  
Timely and accurate PI and invoice generation; reduction in PI-to-final-invoice cycle time and revision cycles; monthly collection target achievement; collection efficiency; reduction in overdue and ageing buckets; timely university receivable recovery; student fee recovery; centre-wise target achievement; forecast accuracy; timely reconciliation; reduction in unidentified receipts; MIS timeliness and accuracy.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 4–8 years in collections, billing, accounts receivable or credit control, with experience calibrated to the level (Assistant Manager / Manager).
* Hands-on experience in invoicing and billing, including proforma invoices, revisions and reconciliation with the client or institution.
* Hands-on B2B, institutional, education or multi-location collections experience.
* Exposure to universities, educational institutions or large corporates is an advantage.
* Experience with student fee collections and batch-wise outstanding tracking is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of receivables ageing, invoicing, reconciliation, TDS and payment follow-ups.
* Proficient in MS Excel and MIS reporting, with exposure to ERP/accounting software and payment gateways.
* Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the patience and persistence to coordinate across internal and external stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel to centres and institutional stakeholders as required.

**Key Skills:** Collections, Billing, Proforma Invoice, Invoicing, Accounts Receivable, Credit Control, Receivables Ageing, Reconciliation, TDS, Student Fee Collection, MIS Reporting, Advanced Excel, Stakeholder Management, Negotiation, Team Management

**Why Join Us**

* Build and own a critical function in a fast-growing organisation.
* Direct impact on cash flow and working capital.
* Exposure to university partnerships and multi-location operations.
* Work closely with senior Finance and business leadership.

**How to Apply**  
Apply on Naukri, or share your CV with **Sophia** at **sofiya.saifi@emversity.com**, with the subject line "Application – Collections & Billing Manager".

.

* Strong technical knowledge of SQL, Python, BigQuery and GCP (Google Cloud Platform), with experience overseeing data extraction, transformation, integration and cloud-based data platforms.
* Proven Agile Project Management and leading geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior stakeholders and delivering measurable value at pace within a regulated environment.
* Experience delivering data analysis, data mining, data wrangling and data delivery, producing trusted, reusable and scalable data products for business, operational, risk and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

**You’ll achieve more at HSBC.**

**Job Title:** **Senior AI Platform Engineer**

  

**Overview**

We are looking for a Senior AI Platform Engineer to help design, develop, and expand our internal AI platform, supporting cybersecurity analysts through intelligent workflows, automation, integrations, and AI-assisted capabilities.

The role involves building scalable AI-driven services, integrating with enterprise security technologies, and contributing to the evolution of a modern platform that combines software engineering, cloud services, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity.

The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex technical problems, can work across multiple technologies, and is comfortable learning new tools and frameworks as the platform evolves.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain AI-driven platform capabilities.
* Build scalable backend services and APIs.
* Develop workflow orchestration and automation capabilities.
* Design integrations with enterprise security and operational platforms.
* Build connectors to third-party products and cloud services.
* Develop reusable components and SDKs that can be shared across multiple applications.
* Contribute to platform architecture, design discussions, and technical direction.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine how they can be incorporated into the platform.
* Work closely with security analysts to understand operational challenges and translate them into technical solutions.
* Produce maintainable, well-tested, and well-documented code.
* Participate in technical reviews and architectural discussions.

**Required Skills**

**Software Engineering**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Experience designing modular, maintainable systems.
* Experience building REST APIs and backend services.
* Experience developing reusable libraries or frameworks.
* Experience working with asynchronous and event-driven systems.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

**Development**

Strong experience in one or more modern software development technologies, such as:

* Python
* TypeScript
* Go

Experience learning new languages, frameworks, and technologies quickly is considered equally valuable.

**Artificial Intelligence**

Experience working with modern AI technologies, including some of the following:

* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* AI agents
* Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Prompt engineering
* Structured outputs
* AI workflow orchestration
* Model evaluation
* AI governance and safety

Experience with multiple AI providers is desirable.

**Cloud & Platform Engineering**

Experience with cloud-native development, such as Azure or AWS, including:

* Storage services
* Authentication and identity
* Queues or messaging
* Serverless or container-based workloads
* Monitoring and observability
* Secure application development

**API & Integration Development**

Experience integrating with third-party platforms using REST APIs, SDKs, or webhooks.

Experience building integrations with enterprise systems is highly desirable.

**Security**

Good understanding of cybersecurity concepts, such as:

* SIEM
* SOAR
* Identity and Access Management
* Threat Detection
* Incident Response
* Authentication and Authorization

Experience with offensive security techniques, adversary emulation, or penetration testing is beneficial but not required.

**Desirable Experience**

* ServiceNow
* SOAR platforms
* MITRE ATT&CK
* Detection Engineering

* Experience building AI platforms rather than standalone AI applications.
* Experience designing workflow engines or orchestration systems.
* Experience developing SDKs or internal developer platforms.
* Experience with vector search or semantic search.
* Experience working with structured data pipelines.
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures.
* Experience contributing to technical strategy and architecture.

* Is naturally curious and enjoys learning new technologies.
* Can work independently while collaborating effectively with others.
* Takes ownership of technical problems from concept through implementation.
* Thinks beyond individual features and considers long-term platform design.
* Is pragmatic and balances innovation with maintainability.
* Communicates technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Designing robust, reusable platform capabilities.

* Contributing to the long-term architecture and technical direction of the platform.
* Helping establish engineering standards and best practices as the platform grows.

jobs.title: Finance & Accounts -  Internal Audit
jobs.description:
**Job Description Internal Auditor**

  

**Position:** Internal Auditor

**Department:** Finance & Accounts (Internal Audit )

**Reporting to:** CFO / Board of Directors

**Location:** Pune

**Experience:** 4 - 6 years in internal audit

  

**Education:** Semi qualified CA or any Commerce Graduate

  
  

**1. Job Purpose**

To independently evaluate the company's **internal controls, processes, risk management, compliance and financial/operational activities**, identify control weaknesses and process inefficiencies, and recommend corrective actions to improve governance, cost effectiveness and operational performance.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Internal Audit Planning & Execution**

* Prepare and execute the annual and quarterly internal audit plan based on risk assessment.
* Conduct audits of Finance, Purchase, Sales, Stores, Inventory, Production, HR, Payroll, Projects, Logistics and other functions.
* Perform process reviews and transaction testing to assess adequacy and effectiveness of controls.
* Identify gaps, irregularities, leakages, fraud risks and process inefficiencies.
* Maintain proper audit working papers and supporting documentation.

**B. Internal Controls & Risk Management**

* Review existing **SOPs, policies, delegation of authority and internal controls**.
* Identify control deficiencies and assess their financial and operational impact.
* Recommend practical measures to strengthen internal controls.
* Evaluate implementation of management controls and monitor recurring weaknesses.
* Participate in risk assessment and maintain a risk-based audit approach.

**C. Financial & Transaction Audit**

Review, among others:

* Purchase-to-Pay cycle
* Order-to-Cash cycle
* Inventory and stores
* Fixed assets
* Cash and bank transactions
* Expenses and employee claims
* Vendor payments
* Customer collections
* Journal entries and provisions
* Capital expenditure
* Payroll and employee-related payments

**D. Operational Audit**

* Review operational efficiency and utilization of company resources.
* Identify opportunities for **cost reduction and productivity improvement**.
* Review wastage, scrap, rejections, production losses and abnormal consumption.
* Examine inventory ageing, slow-moving and obsolete items.
* Review procurement practices, vendor selection and purchase price variations.

**E. Compliance Audit**

* Check compliance with applicable **Companies Act, GST, Income Tax, labour laws, accounting standards and other applicable statutory requirements**.
* Review compliance with company policies and management approvals.
* Track statutory and regulatory non-compliances and report significant issues.

**F. Fraud Risk & Investigation**

* Identify potential fraud indicators and unusual transactions.
* Conduct special audits/investigations as assigned by management or the Audit Committee.
* Analyse suspicious transactions and identify control failures contributing to fraud.
* Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive investigations.

**G. ERP / SAP & Data Analytics**

* Review controls within SAP/ERP systems.
* Check user access, authorization levels and segregation of duties.
* Use Excel, Power BI, SQL or other analytical tools for transaction testing and exception reporting.
* Develop analytical reports to identify unusual transactions, duplicate payments, unusual vendor/customer activity and other exceptions.

**H. Audit Reporting**

* Prepare clear and concise internal audit reports.
* Classify observations based on risk/priority.
* Discuss findings with process owners and obtain management responses.
* Clearly highlight:
* Audit observation
* Risk/impact
* Root cause
* Recommendation
* Management response
* Responsible person
* Target implementation date

**I. Follow-up & Corrective Actions**

* Monitor implementation of agreed audit recommendations.
* Conduct periodic follow-up audits.
* Report overdue corrective actions to senior management.
* Highlight repeated or unresolved control deficiencies.

**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The Internal Auditor can be evaluated on:

**KPI**

  

**Measurement**

Audit Plan Completion

  

% of planned audits completed

Quality of Audit

  

Significant and relevant observations identified

Control Improvement

  

Reduction in recurring audit observations

Cost Savings

  

Savings/leakages identified through audits

Recovery

  

Amount recovered due to audit findings

Fraud Prevention

  

Fraud/control weaknesses identified

Compliance

  

Reduction in statutory/process violations

Timeliness

  

Audit reports issued within agreed timelines

Corrective Action

  

% of recommendations implemented

Risk Coverage

  

Coverage of high-risk processes

**4. Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of accounting and auditing.
* Good understanding of internal controls and risk management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent Excel/SAP/ERP skills.
* Knowledge of statutory and regulatory compliance.
* Ability to identify fraud indicators.
* Good report-writing and communication skills.
* Ability to independently interact with senior management and functional heads.
* Professional skepticism and high level of integrity/confidentiality.

jobs.title: Global AML Center, Vice President
jobs.description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced leader with a strong track record in AML/KYC operations and transformation to provide senior leadership within the Global AML Center (GAC) in Hyderabad.
  
  
As part of the GAC leadership team, you will own delivery & transformation across AML/KYC portfolios - onboarding, event-driven reviews, periodic reviews, screening and quality assurance. You will also help shape and drive GAC’s strategic agenda. That means leading technology-enabled change, automation and AI adoption to build a scalable, standardized and data-led operating model. You will also take on Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) responsibilities for GAC: overseeing business management, budget and headcount planning, governance, and the site and people agenda in Hyderabad. You will balance strong day-to-day delivery with a clear view of where the function needs to be in the future.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The Global AML Center carries out AML/KYC activities as part of State Street’s global AML operating model. This includes Customer Identification Program (CIP), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), customer verification and customer risk rating across all business areas. Hyderabad is a key part of GAC’s global footprint.
  
  
Volumes, regulatory expectations and methodology changes keep growing, and adding capacity alone is not a sustainable answer. This role is central to changing how GAC operates: cutting manual effort, strengthening controls through technology and data, and positioning GAC as a strategic partner to the business rather than a purely operational function. As GAC grows, it also needs strong business management discipline: clear financial and headcount oversight, consistent governance, and a well-run site and people agenda.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As Vice President you will:
  
  
***Operational Leadership***

* Provide senior leadership for GAC operations in Hyderabad and act as a key point of contact for local India management and global stakeholders
* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned AML/KYC portfolios against agreed service, quality, risk and productivity standards
* Keep active oversight of volumes, pipeline, ageing and capacity, and raise emerging pressure before it affects delivery or compliance
* Set clear priorities across BAU, new business, remediation and regulatory commitments, and move resources as demand changes

***Strategy & Technology Change***

* Help shape GAC’s strategic direction and multi-year transformation roadmap, in line with business growth, regulatory change and the target operating model
* Lead strategic change initiatives from idea through to delivery and adoption, with clear business cases, measurable outcomes and benefits tracking
* Act as the business lead for technology change, working with Technology, product and change teams on enhancements to KYC platforms, workflow tools and data capability
* Identify and drive opportunities for automation, AI, digitization and workflow integration that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and strengthen controls
* Champion data-led decision making through better MI, dashboards and real-time visibility of pipeline, risk and performance
* Make sure process, policy and methodology changes are turned into sustainable system and operational changes, reducing reliance on manual workarounds
* Prioritize the change portfolio and balance investment, capacity and risk to deliver the greatest business value
* Build a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and grow change and digital capability within the team

***Business Management & CAO***

* Act as CAO for GAC, partnering with the GAC Head on business management, planning and execution of the leadership agenda
* Lead annual budget, headcount and workforce planning, including capacity models, run-rate tracking, attrition and backfill planning
* Track expenses, productivity and cost efficiency, and support business cases for investment and location strategy
* Run the GAC management operating rhythm, including leadership meetings, governance forums, management reporting and executive or board materials
* Coordinate senior stakeholder and regulatory reporting, ensuring information is accurate, consistent and on time
* Track key initiatives, decisions and actions across the leadership team, making sure commitments are followed through
* Oversee administrative controls, including policies and procedures, entitlements and access, business continuity and resilience planning
* Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Real Estate and Technology on hiring, onboarding, workforce management, space and infrastructure
* Lead the Hyderabad site and culture agenda, including employee engagement, communications, town halls, recognition and talent programs

***Risk, Control & Governance***

* Maintain a strong control environment in line with AML/KYC policies, procedures and regulatory requirements
* Identify and address emerging operational and regulatory risks before they affect the business, and escalate where needed
* Ensure new technology, automation and AI solutions are put in place with appropriate controls, governance and risk oversight
* Support audit, regulatory and governance requirements

***Stakeholder Leadership***

* Work with Business Units, Compliance, Technology and Risk teams to resolve dependencies, close control gaps and drive accountability
* Represent GAC in senior forums with clear, fact-based views on delivery, strategy, risk, capacity and the decisions required
* Influence senior stakeholders to secure support and investment for strategic and technology initiatives

***People Leadership***

* Attract, develop and retain strong talent, and build leadership depth and succession across the Hyderabad organization
* Hold managers and teams accountable for outcomes while empowering them to make decisions, and create opportunities for them to realize their full potential
* Lead teams through change, building adoption and new ways of working

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD, client onboarding, periodic reviews, screening and financial crime controls
* Strategic thinking: the ability to set direction and turn a long-term vision into executable plans
* A proven track record of leading technology-enabled transformation, automation or digital change in a regulated environment
* An understanding of how workflow platforms, data, automation and AI can redesign operating models
* Proven ability to lead large, complex teams, including managing other managers
* A forward-looking approach to risk, with the ability to anticipate issues rather than react to them
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using MI, KPIs and capacity data to drive decisions
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively
* Strong business management and financial acumen, including budgeting, headcount and workforce planning
* Ability to run a disciplined management rhythm and produce clear executive and board-level materials
* A collaborative leadership style that balances empowerment with accountability

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of relevant experience in AML/KYC, financial crime or operations within a large global financial institution
* Demonstrated experience leading strategic transformation and technology change programs, from business case to adoption
* Significant senior people leadership experience, including leading leaders
* Experience in business management role, including budget, headcount and governance ownership, is strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Strong knowledge of global AML/KYC regulatory requirements
* Experience with KYC workflow platforms (e.g., Fenergo/FenX), automation tools or AI solutions is an advantage
* Change or pro

jobs.title: Manager, IT Delivery
jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Manager, IT Delivery is responsible for leading high-performing data and technology teams and delivering strategic data initiatives that generate measurable business value.
  
  
This role combines people leadership, product delivery, stakeholder management, and operational oversight. The manager will lead teams operating across data engineering, data platforms, data warehousing, data lakes, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
  
  
The manager will have end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership and communication capabilities, experience managing product-oriented teams, and a sound understanding of modern data ecosystems. The role requires the ability to translate business priorities into executable delivery plans, develop engineering talent, manage delivery commitments, and ensure the scalability, quality, security, and reliability of data solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop high-performing data and technology teams, including hiring, performance management, workforce planning, and talent development.
* Drive delivery of strategic initiatives across data engineering, data warehousing, data lakes / lakehouses, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, and business intelligence.
* Partner with business, product, architecture, and engineering stakeholders to translate priorities into product roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead product-oriented teams with end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products.
* Drive Agile practices, including intake management, backlog prioritization, estimation, sprint and release planning, and delivery governance.
* Manage capacity planning, resource forecasting, delivery commitments, risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies to enable predictable execution.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, reusable, and compliant with applicable technology, risk, privacy, and information security standards.
* Promote effective data governance, data quality, metadata management, lineage, ownership, and stewardship practices.
* Monitor delivery, quality, and operational health through relevant metrics, and provide clear, concise updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Foster strong stakeholder relationships and communicate complex data and technology topics effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Promote automation, standardization, engineering excellence, cost optimization, and modern data practices, including cloud and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and business-outcome ownership.
* Provide leadership during major incidents and critical production events, partnering with support and engineering teams to drive timely resolution, stakeholder communication, and service recovery while ensuring operational continuity.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 10+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, data platforms, or IT services, including people leadership experience.
* Proven experience leading teams in a product-based environment with responsibility for delivery execution and stakeholder management.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, backlog management, sprint planning, and Jira.
* Experience leading data-focused technology initiatives, including data engineering, analytics, data quality, governance, or modern data platforms.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution, manage ambiguity, solve complex problems, and lead organisational change.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and effectively partner with engineering teams to deliver business outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries.
* Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and AI-enabled technology initiatives.
* Agile, Scrum, PMP, SAFe, or related certifications preferred.
* Experience leading cloud data platform, data modernization, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing geographically distributed or cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with industry-standard cloud, data engineering, analytics, governance, and data quality technologies.

**Key Success Factors**

* Experience in data-centric technology environments.
* Ability to build, scale, and lead high-performing teams.
* Sound understanding of data engineering, data platforms, governance, quality, and analytics.
* Strong product and Agile delivery leadership.
* Effective capacity planning, forecasting, and execution management.
* Ownership and accountability for delivery and operational outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication.
* Ability to connect data and technology investments to business outcomes.
* Ability to operate effectively in a complex, cross-functional environment.
* Commitment to engineering quality, operational excellence, risk management, and continuous improvement.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Director of Product Management is a managerial position that supports the global growth of USP’s material products including Reference Standards, Analytical Reference Materials, Pharmaceutical Analytical Impurities, Certified Reference Materials and the Materials Strategy Program across the USP Novel Medicines, Generics, and Consumer Health business units.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. jobs.description:

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Head of Technology – Operations and Risk Technology, India**

Corporate Line of Business Technology enables the bank's core operational, risk management, compliance, and enterprise shared service functions. These organizations are responsible for ensuring operational excellence, regulatory compliance, risk management, and the efficient execution of critical business processes across the enterprise.

The technology organization supporting Operational & Risk Line of Business provides strategic platforms, digital capabilities, automation solutions, data and analytics, AI-enabled services, and operational resiliency capabilities that power the bank's internal functions and support enterprise-wide transformation initiatives.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an accomplished and visionary technology executive to serve as Head of Technology – Operations and Risk Technology, India. This executive will lead the India-based engineering and technology organization supporting the bank's Operations, Risk, Fraud, Compliance, and Corporate Functions technology platforms.

As a key member of the global Operations & Risk Technology leadership team and the India GCC leadership team, this leader will be responsible for building and scaling world-class engineering capabilities, accelerating digital transformation, modernizing enterprise platforms, driving operational excellence, and establishing India as a strategic innovation, engineering, and delivery hub.

* Build organizational capabilities to support enterprise-wide transformation, regulatory initiatives, and operational efficiency programs.

**Talent Strategy & Organizational Development**

* Develop a multi-year workforce strategy to build sustainable technology capabilities within the GCC.
* Lead talent acquisition, workforce planning, succession planning, and leadership development programs.

* Build a culture centered on learning, innovation, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous professional development.

**GCC and Executive Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary technology leader for India supporting global Operations Technology executives and business stakeholders.
* Play a key role in the continued expansion and maturation of the GCC as a strategic technology and innovation center.
* Build trusted relationships with CIOs, Operations leaders, Risk Office leadership, Compliance leaders, and Corporate Functions stakeholders.
* Influence strategic decisions through technology insights, data-driven recommendations, and strong business partnerships.
* Communicate effectively with executive leadership regarding technology strategy, operational performance, transformation initiatives, technology risk, and organizational progress.
* Drive outcomes through collaboration and influence across highly matrixed global organizations.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related quantitative discipline.
* 20+ years of experience in software engineering, technology delivery, platform modernization, and digital transformation.
* 15+ years of leadership experience managing large technology organizations
* Demonstrated success leading complex global technology organizations, preferably within large financial institutions and GCC environments.
* Proven experience leading senior technology leaders, engineering managers, architects, and enterprise technology teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Technology, Engineering and Banking Services**

* Strong understanding of AI-enabled software development, enterprise automation, and engineering productivity tools.
* Deep expertise in software engineering, platform engineering, cloud technologies, DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering, and technology operations.
* Experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation and modernization programs.
* Strong understanding of banking operations, enterprise risk management, regulatory compliance, and corporate services functions.

* Experience operating in highly regulated and globally distributed environments.

**Leadership**

* Proven track record of building and scaling engineering organizations comprising 400+ technology professionals.
* Ability to influence senior executives and drive enterprise-wide outcomes.
* Demonstrated success in organizational transformation, talent development, succession planning, and leadership coaching.
* Strong executive presence with excellent communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership capabilities.
* Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple geographies and business functions.

This role represents a unique opportunity to shape the future of the Bank's Operations Technology landscape while building one of the industry's most impactful technology organizations supporting Operations, Risk, Compliance, and enterprise corporate functions in India.

--------------------

**Job Title**
=============

**Zonal Sales Manager (South) - IndusInd Bank Affluent & NRI Channel**

South India (Chennai) handles all four states of South.

National Sales Head - IndusInd Bank Relationship

**Role Purpose**

Lead the South India region for ABSLI's strategic partnership with IndusInd Bank's Affluent, HNI, and NRI Banking segments. The incumbent will be responsible for driving life insurance penetration across the bank's affluent customer base by building strong engagement with banking leadership, enhancing frontline capability, driving sales productivity, and ensuring sustainable business growth.

The role requires deep expertise in bancassurance, wealth management, relationship selling, and team leadership to establish ABSLI as the preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's affluent banking ecosystem.

### **Business Development & Revenue Growth**

### **Relationship Management**

* Manage relationships with Zonal Heads, Regional Heads, Cluster Heads, and Wealth Leaders of IndusInd Bank.
* Position ABSLI as a strategic partner within the bank's affluent business model.
* Conduct regular business reviews with banking stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment of branch priorities with insurance business objectives.

### **Team Leadership**

* Lead a team of Regional Managers and Relationship Managers across South India.
* Drive productivity and capability building.
* Coach teams on HNI sales conversations and financial planning discussions.
* Build a high-performance sales culture.

### **Capability Development**

* Upskill bank relationship managers on:
  + Financial protection planning
  + Estate planning solutions
  + Retirement planning
  + Wealth transfer concepts
  + NRI insurance solutions
  Tax-efficient insurance products

### **Sales Governance**

* Ensure compliance with IRDAI regulations.
* Monitor suitability and quality parameters.
* Drive persistency and customer retention.
* Maintain healthy business mix and reduce concentration risks.

### **Customer Engagement**

* Conduct HNI customer meets, wealth seminars, and investment forums.
* Participate in client acquisition and portfolio review events.
* Engage with key customers for large-ticket closures.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**
===========================

New Business Premium (APE/FYP) Achievement

  
  

Affluent & HNI Customer Acquisition

  
  

Product Mix & Protection Penetration

  
  

Active Branch Productivity

  
  

Banker Activation & Engagement

  
  

Team Productivity & Retention

  
  

Persistency & Quality Metrics

  
  

Stakeholder Relationship

  
  

**Critical Challenges of the Role**

* Building mindshare and trust for ABSLI within an existing banking ecosystem.
Competing with legacy bancassurance relationships and established insurers.  

### **2. Affluent Customer Expectations**

* HNI and NRI customers demand advisory-led conversations rather than transactional selling.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Our Business Management team acts as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and optimizes business performance by helping to drive key initiatives. We act as a counterweight to business and group heads and are responsible for identifying, escalating, and mitigating business risks. The role is dynamic and can vary from business to business, in line with the priorities of different lines of business. This is a time-pressured and high-profile position, instrumental in assisting and advising senior management. You will help coordinate the deployment of corporate resources to address strategic and tactical objectives.

Job summary

As a **Business Management** professional within the **Business Management team**, you will help drive strategic and tactical objectives by coordinating corporate resources and advising senior management. You will implement new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms by aligning partners across Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, and Compliance. You will optimize bottom-line performance by driving key initiatives related to fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization. You will identify, escalate, and mitigate business risks that could impair the ability to do business, including legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, and extraordinary transaction costs. jobs.description:
**Company** | Hybon Technologies Private Limited  
**Location** | The Executive Centre, 7th Floor, Worldmark 4, Aerocity, New Delhi  
**Employment Type** | Full-time  
**Reporting To** | Chief Financial Officer

Role Overview

Hybon Technologies is looking for a **Head of Accounts** to lead the accounting function for its domestic trading and export business in mobile phones, electronics and IT products. The role owns the books of accounts, financial close, statutory compliance, audit coordination and internal controls. The successful candidate will lead the accounts team and work closely with sales, procurement, logistics and banking teams to keep financial records accurate and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Key Responsibilities

* **Accounting and financial close** — Oversee the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, fixed assets and intercompany balances. Lead monthly and year-end closing and prepare financial statements and supporting schedules.
* **GST and tax compliance** — Oversee GST returns, GSTR-2B reconciliations, input tax credit, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Manage TDS deductions, deposits and returns, and coordinate with tax advisors on statutory filings and notices.
* **Import and export accounting** — Review invoices, bills of entry, shipping bills, customs duties, freight and landed costs. Monitor foreign currency receivables and payables, exchange differences and export realisations. Coordinate with banks and internal teams on remittance documentation and support GST refund claims where applicable.
* **Inventory and cost controls** — Reconcile inventory records with the books and physical stock counts. Investigate stock discrepancies, review valuation and landed costs, and oversee IMEI or serial-number reconciliation where applicable.
* **Receivables, payables and cash flow** — Monitor customer and vendor ageing, advances and credit balances. Drive account confirmations and dispute resolution, review payment schedules and prepare cash flow forecasts for management.
* **Management reporting** — Prepare monthly reports on profitability, gross margins, inventory, overdue receivables and working capital. Explain material variances and flag issues that require management action.
* **Audits and internal controls** — Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits. Maintain supporting documentation, close audit observations and strengthen review controls for invoicing, payments, credit notes and journal entries.
* **Team leadership** — Supervise and develop the accounts team, set clear responsibilities and review deadlines, and improve accounting processes and ERP workflows.

Qualifications and Experience

* CA preferred. CMA, M.Com or B.Com candidates with relevant senior accounting experience may also be considered.
* 8–12 years of accounting experience, including at least 3 years leading an accounts team.
* Experience in trading, distribution or import/export is preferred. Exposure to mobile phones, electronics or IT hardware is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience in financial closing, GST, TDS, inventory accounting, reconciliations and audit coordination.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or a comparable ERP, along with strong Excel skills for reconciliations and management reporting.
* Ability to lead a team, meet statutory and reporting deadlines, and communicate clearly with management, auditors, banks and business teams.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About This Role**

You'll help us build a platform that works for One — the individual, whether that's a business owner, an artist, or a freelancer, not a segment or a balance. We focus on individuals, not numbers. You'll take ownership of our global product ecosystem from zero to one: first the minimal licensable product, then the agentic financial platform we build on top of it. You'll partner directly with the founders on strategic direction, operate with full autonomy, and build shared understanding across the organization.

**You'll Take Ownership Of**

* **Zero-to-One Product Delivery:**
  Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for regulated financial products, from initial concept to launch, prioritizing value delivery over premature optimization.
* **Product & People Leadership:**
  Build and lead the product organization — hire, mentor, and grow product talent, and establish a culture of high performance, data literacy, and low ego. This is core to the role, not an adjunct to it.
* **Agentic Banking Architecture:**
  Architect a financial ecosystem built for autonomous agents from the ground up, treating AI as an operating model for the organization rather than a bolt-on feature.
* **Scope Discipline:**
  Maintain control over delivery timelines under pressure. Cut scope deliberately rather than sacrifice quality, keeping focus on the minimal licensable product.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Architecture:**
  Treat regulatory, compliance, and audit obligations as first-class product inputs, turning friction into intuitive product features.
* **Cross-Functional Feasibility:**
  Partner with the CTO to co-own technical feasibility and organizational commitments, separating what the product does from how it's engineered.
* **Context & Alignment:**
  Act as the primary bridge for shared understanding across the company — communicating product vision, customer needs, and strategic rationale through multiple channels.

**About You**

* **Regulated Startup Background:**
  You've built and shipped regulated financial products from zero to one within a fintech, crypto exchange, custodian, or digital banking environment, with proven exposure to compliance frameworks such as VARA, MiCA, EMI, or PI, and to strict licensing processes.
* **Comfort with Shifting Landscapes:**
  You thrive in continuous-delivery setups with agile teams, staying resilient and decisive under regulatory, investor, and shifting deadline pressures.
* **Agentic Framework Literacy:**
  You have practical understanding of agentic capabilities, architectural pitfalls, and the agentic-deterministic bridge, so deterministic safety holds on the money path.
* **Cross-Domain Fluency:**
  You're comfortable across crypto systems, traditional banking, and modern neobank infrastructure, rather than specialized in a single domain.
* **Outcome Ownership:**
  You own outcomes end-to-end rather than running a feature factory. You commit to measurable results and core OKRs, and you value autonomy while building a collaborative, non-siloed organization.
* **Clarity & Conviction:**
  You reduce ambiguity across teams and argue from data with conviction, but disagree and commit when it's time to align the organization.
* **Language Skills:**
  You speak and write English at a professional level, to support clean communication across global offices.

**This Is Not For You If**

* You're looking for a mature product to optimize. We're building from zero — there's no existing user base to A/B-test against.
* You're a product manager from a large bank who needs six committees to change a button. We move fast, fail fast on wrong calls, and decide from data.
* You know crypto well but see banking regulation as an outdated formality. For us, regulation is part of the product architecture, not an obstacle.
* You want to run a feature factory and just execute roadmaps. We need someone who will fight for the right scope, even if that means shipping less.
* You need the founders to make every product call. You'll have real autonomy here — and the responsibility that comes with it, including owning your own mistakes.

**Can Get You a Few Bonus Points**

* **Founder Roots:**
  Prior experience as a founder or early product leader of a regulated fintech startup, building the organization from the ground up.
* **Agentic Shipping History:**
  Direct experience bringing a live, agentic-first product to market.
* **Augmented Operations:**
  Active daily use of AI agents, personal documentation systems, or a "second brain" to streamline your own operational delivery.

**The UMO Standard**

* **Mandate & Ownership:**
  Full ownership of the product organization and roadmap, reporting directly to the founders.
* **Equity:**
  A meaningful equity stake in a venture built from zero to one.
* **Location & Flexibility:**
  Base yourself in Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, or Lviv, with openness to remote for the right fit.
* **Impact & Ownership:**
  Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

jobs.title: Head of India
jobs.description:
**The Role**
India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.
  
  
You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.
  
  
As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.
  
  
Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.
* Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.
* Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.
* The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.
* Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.
* The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.
* The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

**Who You Are**

* 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.
* Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.
* Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.
* A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.
* A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.
* Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.
  
  
**Why This Role**
India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.
  
  
**About Us**
We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.
  
  
Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.
  
  
We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends
**real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation**
.
  
  
**Here’s a Little More**

* Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)
* Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more
* Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission
* Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages
* Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

Taptap Values
  
  
Impact first
  
  
Team next
  
  
Accept reality
  
  
Propose solutions
  
  
Win with grit
  
  
Be proactively candid, with yourself and others
  
  
Love the particular
  
  
Own it
  
  
Create positive energy
  
  
Maybe, even have fun
  
  
Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.
  
  
If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.
  
  
*Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.*
