jobs.description:
**Location:** Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** 7–12 Years  
**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Reporting To:** Director / CEO

Job Summary

We are hiring an experienced Accounts & Finance Manager to oversee financial operations across multiple Indian and international entities within our cross-border e-commerce business.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in accounting and financial reporting, marketplace reconciliations, international taxation, inventory accounting, cash flow management, statutory compliance and team management.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Manage accounting operations across multiple Indian and international entities.
* Ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures.
* Prepare and review P&L, Balance Sheets, Trial Balance and financial statements.
* Finalize monthly P&L by the 10th of every month.
* Review ledgers, bank accounts, credit cards, sales, purchases, creditors, debtors and intercompany transactions.
* Manage accruals, provisions, depreciation, prepaid expenses and forex adjustments.

**E-commerce Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Handle marketplace reconciliations across Amazon, Noon, eBay, Walmart, Lazada, Shopee, Shopify and other platforms.
* Reconcile marketplace sales, settlements, commissions, refunds, returns, chargebacks and deductions.
* Monitor marketplace receivables, delayed settlements and stuck payouts.
* Reconcile marketplace reports with bank statements and accounting records.
* Coordinate with operations and account management teams to resolve discrepancies.

**Financial MIS & Profitability Analysis**

* Prepare monthly financial MIS and consolidated financial reports.
* Analyse revenue, margins, expenses and business profitability.
* Conduct product, brand and marketplace-level profitability analysis.
* Prepare landed-cost calculations, logistics cost comparisons and breakeven analysis.
* Identify cost leakages and opportunities for cost optimization.
* Present financial performance and variance analysis to management.

**Inventory & Procurement Accounting**

* Reconcile inventory across books, warehouses, marketplace reports and operational trackers.
* Monitor inventory movements, stock ageing, purchases, returns and damaged stock.
* Conduct inventory verification and investigate stock discrepancies.
* Review purchase and procurement reconciliations.

**Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Manage GST, TDS, Income Tax, Tax Audit, Advance Tax, PT, PF and ESIC coordination.
* Handle export-related GST compliance, LUT renewals and refund applications.
* Coordinate international taxation, including UAE VAT and Corporate Tax, Saudi VAT and Zakat, USA tax compliance, Singapore GST and UK VAT.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants, auditors and external tax consultants.
* Manage transfer pricing, related-party compliance and applicable international tax documentation.

**Banking & Treasury**

* Manage banking operations across domestic and international entities.
* Monitor bank reconciliations, cash balances and fund movements.
* Manage Payoneer and other international payment accounts.
* Track foreign remittances, export proceeds and import payments.
* Coordinate with AD banks for EDPMS, IDPMS and remittance documentation.
* Monitor cash flow, forex exposure and intercompany fund transfers.

**Audit, Cost Control & Team Management**

* Coordinate internal, statutory, tax and international audits.
* Maintain financial controls, SOPs, documentation and compliance trackers.
* Review logistics and vendor invoices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Lead and supervise the Accounts & Finance team.
* Allocate responsibilities, review performance and train team members.
* Work closely with management on budgets, financial projections and business planning.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* CA / CA Inter / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com.
* 7–12 years of experience in Accounts & Finance.
* Minimum 3–5 years of managerial or team supervisory experience.
* Experience in e-commerce, retail, export-import, cross-border trade or multi-entity accounting preferred.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting and taxation.
* Experience in international entities, marketplace reconciliation and foreign currency transactions.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or other ERP/accounting software.
* Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookup functions and financial modelling.
* Strong analytical skills, leadership, ownership and attention to detail.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Financial Controller – Entrance Control Middle East is responsible for leading the finance function, ensuring financial integrity, regulatory compliance, effective financial planning, and sustainable business performance. jobs.title: Gen AI Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us as a Gen AI Product Engineer
  
  

* In this key role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and scaling Generative AI (GenAI)-powered products and features that deliver tangible business value
* We’ll look to you to bridge product thinking and engineering execution, translating user needs into robust, production-ready AI solutions while driving innovation in the application of GenAI capabilities
* This is an opportunity to design and deliver production-grade GenAI solutions, including AI agents, conversational AI, and automation, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance
* We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do
  
  
As a Gen AI Product Engineer, you'll design, build, and deploy production-grade GenAI products and systems that turn user and business needs into secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. You'll also translate product and user requirements into scalable technical solutions, balancing model quality, latency, system complexity, and long-term maintainability, while building and integrating large language model (LLM) capabilities using modern frameworks and application programming interfaces (APIs).
  
  
This will include working across orchestration layers, retrieval pipelines, system integrations, prompt and context engineering, and model evaluation.
  
  
**You'll Also Be**

* Converting ambiguous product requirements and research concepts into robust technical architectures, balancing model capability, latency, cost, complexity, and maintainability
* Ensuring all GenAI solutions meet enterprise security, governance, responsible AI, and risk management standards, with appropriate controls, escalation, and mitigation built into delivery
* Developing and operating LLM solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, agent workflows, orchestration, prompt and content engineering, and model integration patterns
* Integrating GenAI capabilities into existing platforms through internal APIs, services, event flows, and data pipelines, ensuring resilience, observability, and maintainability in production environments
* Defining and applying approaches to model evaluation, benchmarking, monitoring, and continuous optimisation to improve quality, accuracy, reliability, and user outcomes
* Identifying and managing real-world AI system failure modes, including hallucinations, retrieval failures, tool-call errors, degraded model performance, and unsafe or non-compliant outputs
* Supporting production operations, including service monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and on-call responsibilities where required for business-critical GenAI systems

The skills you'll need
  
  
We're looking for someone with proven experience designing, building, and operating production-grade GenAI software systems, with strong capabilities in Python, front-end design frameworks, distributed systems, API design, cloud-native engineering, observability, and performance-critical workloads. You should also bring experience translating ambiguous research concepts, emerging AI capabilities, user needs, and product requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable production systems within fast-moving product or research-led environments.
  
  
To succeed in this role, you'll need experience delivering GenAI or LLM-powered products beyond the prototype stage, including self-hosted model inference with frameworks such as vLLM, OpenAI-compatible serving patterns, orchestration layers, software development kit integration, and production systems. You must also bring a practical understanding of LLM application architecture, including prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, agent workflows, tool-calling patterns, memory and context management, and the mitigation of real-world AI system failure modes.
  
  
**You'll Also Demonstrate**

* An understanding of model training, fine-tuning, adaptation, inference, and serving pipelines, including trade-offs in model selection, performance, cost, reliability, scalability, and operational complexity
* Experience evaluating, monitoring, and optimising AI systems, with working knowledge of responsible AI, model risk, security, governance, and operational controls in enterprise or regulated environments
* Hands-on experience deploying small language models for latency-, cost-, privacy-, or domain-specific use cases

The Product Control GBS is accountable for delivery of the end-to-end product & valuation control functions in GBS and lead different strategic initiatives for Treasury Product Control (PC) and Valuation Control (VC) including Balance Sheet Substantiation controllership. The successful candidate will act as lead running the Treasury Product and Valuation Control, working closely with Technical Accounting, Treasury, Markets, IRRBB, Liquidity, Capital, and other key stakeholders to deliver best-in-class accounting solutions across the Group.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Processes**

* Manage a team covering treasury product categories and regions. (Asset classes: Securities and MM products, Funding, Funds Transfer Pricing, Capital, Hedge Accounting etc.)
* Monitor and implement business model assessments and hedge accounting processes based on IAS 39 and IFRS 9 for new and existing strategies
* Ensure appropriate controls and reviews are maintained for Daily P&L production, core reconciliations, month end close and balance sheet substantiation.
* Ensure the teams are performing timely lockdown of daily and monthly P&L.
* Should be able to substantiate daily and monthly adjustments held in P&L and control accounts.
* Review monthly balance sheet, with substantiation and potential financial exposure.
* Review various reconciliation reports, management packs and adhoc reports.
* Review of month end journals for accrual, provision and true up.
* Take responsibility for the quality of work submitted and ensure that the highest standards are maintained.
* Ensure adherence to SLA's, KPI's , Internal metrics & Finance wide policies.
* Identify/ manage risk and control breakdowns.
* Develop & maintain effective and standard processes. Maintain KOP's/DI's.
* Support change project initiatives and conduct User Acceptance Testing for enhancements to current systems or migration to new system.

**Risk Management**

jobs.title: Business Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.

  
  

The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. These include computation of optimal Margin Allocation for Portfolios and Trades, Haircut for Security and Cash Collateral, Trade and Collateral Liquidity, Collateral Concentration Levels and Wrong Way Risk, amongst others.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

* Liaise with stakeholders across the Risk and Front Office Technology, Counterparty Risk Management, Finance and Front Office business organizations, and external Market Regulators to assemble business requirements for Counterparty Risk Technology projects.

* Manage expectations of various stakeholder groups and help negotiate solutions to complex problems.

* Project manage complex Counterparty Credit Risk projects end to end. Accurately record, maintain, and report Program/Project management tracking data such as milestones via Citi’s internal project tracking systems.

* Help assemble/manage detailed documentation covering Counterparty Risk calculations and other processing, to be used to discuss technology implementation details with the Business users and Market Regulators in various countries/regions. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.

* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.

* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.

* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.

* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.

* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.
  

  

**Knowledge/Experience:**

  
  

* 8-12 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.

* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.

* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.

* Excellent understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk

* Potential Future Exposure, Margin (ISDA MNA and CSA), Collateral Haircut, Liquidity and Period of Risk, Settlement Risk.

* Understanding of Basel III/IV and any other relevant Risk Regulations and measures including PSE, RWA, EAD.

* Knowledge of Market Risk an advantage including Credit Value Adjustment (CVA).

* Extensive project management experience, including co-ordination across remote global teams.

* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.

* Data Analysis capabilities (Database or Spreadsheet), with extensive experience using Excel required.
  

  

**Education:**

  
  

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree an advantage.

* Graduate in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) or Finance disciplines.

* FRM/CFA or other Financial mathematics degree or certification is an advantage.

*Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered for the role provided they have the necessary skills and experience.*

  
  

**Competencies:**

  
  

* Excellent verbal and written English.

* Ability to collaborate effectively in a large global team.

* Ability to take ownership and proactively follow up on issues.

* Ability to work well under pressure, to agreed and often challenging deadlines.

* Strong organization skills.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. **Job Summary:**

The **Assistant Vice President (IC) - Specialized Analytics** is a developing professional role within the QATV team. This role applies specialized expertise in machine learning, statistical modeling, data science, and advanced AI technologies (including Generative AI and Agentic AI) to revolutionize how regulatory testing is executed, analyzed, and governed.

The Data Science Analyst will partner with QATV testing and reporting teams to identify high-impact opportunities for automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent reporting. Key responsibilities include applying AI/ML techniques to detect complex data anomalies, automating test narrative generation, predicting testing cycle risks, and optimizing testing sprint capacity and resource allocation.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* **Predictive Defect & Risk Modeling:** Build predictive analytics and forecasting models to project test execution cycle times, identify recurring defect patterns, and anticipate regulatory reporting risks before filing deadlines.
* **Testing Intelligence & Metrics:** Analyze historical test execution data to uncover systemic data quality trends, derive actionable quality scores, and provide data-driven recommendations to strengthen internal control frameworks.

* **Automated Narrative Generation:** Design, build, and deploy Generative AI solutions (using LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG architectures) to automate the drafting of complex, audit-ready narrative test summaries and executive readouts.
* **Agentic AI & Workflow Automation:** Experiment with and develop Agentic AI workflows (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph) to automate multi-step validation checks, intelligent test result consolidation, and autonomous exception routing.
* **AI Evaluation & Guardrails:** Establish robust benchmarking tools, validation frameworks, and guardrails to evaluate the accuracy, hallucination risks, consistency, and performance of deployed AI/GenAI models.

* **Resource & Capacity Modeling:** Develop quantitative models and optimization algorithms to enhance sprint capacity planning, workload balancing, and skill-to-task allocation across multi-phase testing cycles.
* **Sprint Analytics & Tracking:** Build automated intelligence pipelines and interactive dashboards (Power BI / Tableau) to track sprint velocity, defect burn-down rates, and milestone adherence in real time.
* **Automated Test Script Generation:** Leverage Generative AI and LLM-powered pipelines to automate the creation, synthesis, and maintenance of standardized regulatory test scripts, validation rules.

* **Control, Risk & Governance:** Ensure all data science and AI applications comply with Citi Model Risk Management (MRM), Responsible AI guidelines, and data governance policies. Appropriately assess risk when developing solutions, ensuring transparent escalation and adherence to all supervisory standards.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in QATV by managing expectations and ensuring alignment on project goals and deliverables. Communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders timely manner
* **Team Player & Mentor:** Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior team members. Mentor and coach team members on best practices in data analysis, reporting, and data infrastructure management

* Work experience: 8+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Programming & ML Frameworks: Strong programming skills in Python with proficiency in data science and ML libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers).

* Generative AI & LLMs: Hands-on experience developing GenAI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Chroma, Milvus), and API integration.

* Agentic Frameworks & MLOps: Practical exposure to agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or AutoGen, along with foundational knowledge of MLOps and model deployment pipelines.

* Data Engineering & SQL: Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, manipulating, and transforming large datasets from relational databases and testing data marts (e.g., Oracle, Snowflake, PostgreSQL).

* Data Visualization & BI: Experience building interactive analytics dashboards using Tableau or Power BI.

* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise.

Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

* Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos, and senior approval forums

* Detailed review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources

* Review and approval of Credit Approval Memos (CAM) packages

* Facilitate relationships with key clients in Banking and Risk and with key Regulators, Internal Audit, and control functions

  + Oversee daily, weekly and monthly reconciliations of client holdings, DP balances, suspense accounts and control accounts; investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

  
  

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise. Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

  
  

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

The successful candidate will join the Commodities Underwriting team and will manage a group of junior analysts based in Mumbai who support Underwriters in London. The Commodities Underwriting team is responsible for the coverage of commodity traders as well as clients from other commodity related industries globally.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

  
  

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

  
  

* Maintains underwriting coverage of an existing portfolio of clients while supporting the underwriting of prospective commodities managed clients (CMC); the geographical coverage will include companies from Europe and Asia.
* Manage a team of 4/5 junior analysts in Mumbai by focusing on talent development, workflow management, and performance evaluations.
* Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos, and senior approval forums.
* Detailed review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources.
* Review and approval of Credit Approval Memos (CAM) packages for monitoring or transaction purposes.
* Partner with Front Office on structuring and production of term sheets for new transactions.
* Partners with Legal in the negotiation of credit terms related to trading documentation (such as ISDA, EFET and other trading documents).
* Facilitate relationships with key clients in Banking and Risk and other control functions.
* Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives / projects as required.

**Risk Management Experience:**

  
  

* Senior credit approval authority covering large and complex underwritings, capital commitments, derivatives with multi-industry experience.
* Ability to work independently, demonstrated credit judgement and experience navigating risk policies.
* Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards.
* Ability to understand capital markets products and complex financing and product structures including derivatives.
* Ability to provide strategic insights and strong sensitivity to macro and regulatory issues.
* Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with banking and product organizations.

**Client Relationships / Business Partnership:**

  
  

* Proven ability to understand nuances of local markets, local regulation, and the capabilities and practices of competitors
* Navigates organizational complexity and breaks silos
* Creates and sustains a network of strong partnerships with the business in all segments, geographies and other risk functions
* Provides well-reasoned, balanced assessments of risk/return trade-offs associated with transactions and client relationships
* Proven track record of partnering with global peers in leveraging and implementation of best practices

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

  
  

* Around 13+ years risk/risk-related credit work experience in banking/financial institutions or a commodity trader.
* Proven ability to effectively engage with Senior Credit Officers.
* Prior experience in managing a small team is preferred.
* Demonstrates strong ethics and integrity.
* Ability to see the ‘big picture’ in a complex environment.
* Can make decisions under pressure and short timeline.
* Excellent verbal & written communication skills. Active listening skills.
* Excellent presentation skills – adept at presenting effectively to audiences of various sizes and various constituencies.
  

  

**Education:**

jobs.title: Associate Director - Credit Card Sales
jobs.description:
**About WeRize**

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).

This customer segment is not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health/life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans, savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit.

While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions.

Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t work for this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a high-impact, business-driven
**Chief Manager / Associate Director – Credit Card Sales**
to lead and scale our Credit Card vertical. In this role, you will be responsible for building end-to-end sales strategies, managing banking and co-branded card partnerships, and scaling credit card distribution across our social freelance partner network in 5,000+ small towns.

You will act as the single point of contact between bank partners, internal product/tech teams, and our freelancer channel to drive high-volume, cost-effective, and compliant credit card issuance tailored to India’s middle-income segment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Sales Execution**

* Own the P&L, sales targets, and portfolio growth for the Credit Cards vertical across 5,000+ towns.
* Formulate and execute scalable sales strategies to drive credit card adoption through our unique tech-enabled freelancer distribution platform (
  **‘Finance ki Online Dukaan’**
  ).
* Analyze regional performance, conversion funnels, and customer approval rates to continuously optimize sales pipelines.

**Partnership & Ecosystem Management**

* Onboard, manage, and scale partnerships with leading banks, card issuers, and fintech partners.
* Collaborate with partner institutions to design customer journeys, credit policies, and product variants tailored to Tier 2/3/4 customer profiles.
* Serve as the key liaison for day-to-day operations, SLA management, and approval rate optimizations with partner banks.

**Partner Enablement & Channel Engagement**

* Work alongside channel and marketing teams to design training modules, sales enablement toolkits, and commission/incentive structures for local freelancers.
* Drive engagement, active sourcing, and product cross-selling across the freelancer network to maximize card issuance.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with internal Product, Tech, and Analytics teams to enhance digital application flows, minimize friction, and automate approval pipelines.
* Ensure strict adherence to RBI guidelines, partner bank compliance, data privacy, and ethical selling practices across the freelance network.

**Qualifications & Skill Set**

* **Experience:**
  8 to 15 years of core experience in Credit Card sales, partner management, or unsecured lending within Banks, NBFCs, or Fintechs.
* **Distribution Expertise:**
  Proven track record in scaling financial products through indirect channels, agency networks, DSAs, or tech-enabled social/freelancer distribution.
* **Banking Partnerships:**
  Prior experience managing relationships, integrations, and SLAs with major credit card issuing banks.
* **Data-Driven Approach:**
  Deep understanding of approval funnels, customer acquisition metrics (CAC, LTV), and credit underwriting basics for middle-income segments.
* **Entrepreneurial Mindset:**
  Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, solve unstructured problems, and take complete ownership of product-line growth.

**FedNow**
and

We are a fast-growing engineering organization with deep roots in AWS, microservices, and payment compliance. We are looking for a seasoned Engineering Manager to join our leadership team at our
**India development center**
.

**Role Overview**

**Engineering Manager**
based in India who is as comfortable reviewing a system design as they are running a sprint planning session. You will lead one of our core engineering teams, take full ownership of feature delivery, and work closely with Product, QA, and DevOps — as well as our US-based leadership, client teams, and financial institution partners.

This is a
**hands-on leadership role**
. You will operate through 2–3 tech leads and senior engineers while personally engaging in architecture reviews, critical-path technical decisions, and AI-SDLC adoption — not just managing timelines. You will be expected to drive autonomous decision-making during India business hours and maintain proactive communication across a 10–15 hour time zone gap.

**People & Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 10–15 engineers across Java, Node.js, and React.js stacks, operating through 2–3 tech leads
* Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations
* Drive hiring — own technical interviews and build a high-quality engineering pipeline

* Manage and coordinate with QA team, and external contractors

  ,

  ,

  **PCI-DSS, SOC 2**

You will serve as a key decision-making leader, shaping business strategy and delivering solutions that fuel critical functions—from lending and collections to UPI and personalized recommendations. * Lead quarterly and annual planning processes, ensuring project prioritization maximizes business impact.
* Identify and pursue high-value opportunities that leverage cutting-edge ML/GenAI techniques to drive innovation and competitive advantage.
* Champion engineering best practices, including rigorous documentation and scalable code management.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
* At least 9+ years of experience in data science or advanced analytics with a strong research-oriented mindset.
* Proven track record of directly managing and developing high-performing teams of data scientists.
* Deep expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Statistics, and Optimization algorithms.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and PySpark; experience with Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, SQL, and Scala.
* Hands-on experience building data pipelines, feature engineering, and deploying production-grade systems using Docker, Databricks, and Kubernetes.
* Experience developing and monitoring large-scale, automated ML workflows.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for Business, Product, and Engineering teams.
* Demonstrated success in implementing data science solutions that drive significant measurable business impact at scale.
* Proven ability to design and execute A/B experiments to optimize solutions across diverse business contexts.
* Experience in strategic planning, project management, and enforcing technical best practices.

* Own the Outcome

jobs.title: Senior Manager – Technology Delivery & Digital Platforms (AEM)
jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Senior Manager, IT Delivery leads globally distributed technology teams responsible for delivering and operating business-critical platforms, products, and digital experiences supporting Financial Advisor Services. The role partners with Product, Business, Architecture, Operations, and Technology leaders to shape demand, establish priorities, and translate strategy into reliable, scalable business outcomes.
  
  
This leader is accountable for end-to-end software delivery, engineering excellence, operational resilience, security, talent development, and vendor performance. The role will support the continued evolution of advisor and model-portfolio capabilities while preparing teams to adopt modern cloud, automation, data, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
  
  
As the organization evolves, the role is expected to expand its leadership scope across advisor-facing digital experiences, including modern front-end technologies and Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Experience in this area is preferred and strongly recommended.
  
  
**Leadership opportunity:**
Build high-performing teams, modernize advisor-facing technology, and help shape the next generation of scalable digital and AI-enabled capabilities within FAST.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and inspire high-performing engineering and technology teams responsible for delivering business-critical platforms, products, and services supporting advisor and investment solutions.
* Drive execution of strategic technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities, modernization objectives, client outcomes, and long-term platform roadmaps.
* Oversee end-to-end delivery across the software development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are delivered with quality, reliability, scalability, accessibility, and strong operational readiness.
* Partner with Product, Business, Architecture, User Experience, Operations, Risk, and Technology leaders to shape demand, establish priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver measurable business value.
* Establish and monitor delivery, service-health, reliability, security, and engineering-effectiveness measures while driving continuous improvement across teams.
* Build and manage globally distributed teams by hiring, coaching, mentoring, and developing technology professionals while fostering accountability, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Lead platform and digital-experience modernization focused on cloud adoption, APIs, automation, observability, resiliency, simplified architecture, and reusable engineering patterns.
* Guide the evolution of modern front-end and content-management capabilities, including future expansion into Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), in partnership with architecture, product, design, and engineering leaders.
* Drive operational excellence by improving controls, reducing technology risk, strengthening release readiness, managing vulnerabilities, and ensuring compliance with security, privacy, risk, and governance expectations.
* Provide oversight for incident response, production health, root-cause analysis, and sustainable corrective actions for business-critical services.
* Manage vendor and third-party relationships, ensuring clear accountability, effective capacity planning, quality execution, knowledge transfer, and delivery against contractual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to apply Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven capabilities to improve engineering productivity, operations, and business outcomes.
* Communicate strategy, delivery progress, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior technology and business leaders.

**Must Have Qualifications**

* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
* Progressive technology leadership experience, including responsibility for engineering teams, software delivery, production operations, and complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading globally distributed teams and developing technical talent across multiple roles and experience levels.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, cloud platforms, APIs, distributed systems, DevSecOps, observability, resiliency, and secure development practices.
* Experience partnering with product and business leaders to shape technology strategy, manage priorities, and deliver measurable outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk, cross-team dependencies, organizational change, and vendor or third-party relationships.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders at multiple levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading modern front-end and digital-experience technology teams, with exposure to Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with modern web frameworks, content-management platforms, design systems, accessibility standards, and scalable digital-experience architectures. This capability is strongly recommended because the role is expected to expand into the AEM and front-end technology space within FAST.
* Experience delivering client- or advisor-facing digital products in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with AWS or comparable cloud platforms, serverless architecture, API-led integration, data platforms, and modern CI/CD practices.
* Experience applying AI, Generative AI, or intelligent automation within software engineering, operations, or digital product delivery.
* Experience leading platform modernization, operating-model evolution, or transformation across multiple products and teams.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**

**Company Description**
Opus Bloc Pvt. Ltd. is a fractional real estate platform in India that enables individuals to invest in premium properties through fractional ownership units called blocs, starting at ₹10,000. Each property is held via a dedicated Special Purpose Vehicle registered as an LLP, ensuring ownership is housed in a legally independent entity with details verifiable through Ministry of Corporate Affairs records. The Opus Bloc app streamlines the entire ownership journey, including onboarding, KYC, documentation, portfolio monitoring, and voting, while professional teams manage the properties. A secondary market for reselling holdings is under development, reinforcing liquidity and investor flexibility. Guided by the principles of Accessibility, Control, Transparency, and Ease (ACTE), the company focuses on making premium property ownership structured and accessible to a wider investor base in India.
  
**Role Description**
The Head of Growth is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for driving user and revenue growth across the Opus Bloc platform. This role involves designing and executing growth strategies, leading customer acquisition initiatives, and optimizing the end-to-end funnel from awareness to conversion and retention. The Head of Growth will collaborate with product, marketing, and business development teams to test and scale growth experiments, analyze performance metrics, and refine campaigns for maximum impact. Daily responsibilities include overseeing growth marketing campaigns, coordinating sales and partnership efforts, managing budgets, and presenting growth insights and forecasts to leadership. The role also requires staying current with market trends and competitor activity in fractional real estate and fintech to identify new opportunities.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **Head Forging** to lead and manage forging operations within our Steel Division at Hyderabad. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in forging operations, production planning, process optimization, quality management, and team leadership within a steel or heavy manufacturing environment.

The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end forging operations, ensuring production efficiency, product quality, workplace safety, cost optimization, and on-time delivery while driving continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Forging Operations & Production Management**

* Lead and manage end-to-end forging operations, ensuring efficient utilization of manpower, machinery, and resources.
* Develop and execute production plans to meet business targets, quality standards, and delivery schedules.
* Oversee forging processes, including heating, billet preparation, hot forging, trimming, heat treatment coordination, and associated operations, as applicable.
* Monitor production output, cycle time, rejection rates, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Ensure optimum utilization of forging presses, hammers, furnaces, and related equipment.

**2. Process Optimization & Operational Excellence**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce cycle time, and minimize material wastage.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, energy conservation, and cost reduction.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other operational excellence practices.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for forging operations.

**3. Quality Management**

* Ensure compliance with established quality standards, customer specifications, and applicable industry requirements.
* Reduce rejection, rework, and scrap through root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions.
* Work closely with Quality and Engineering teams to resolve process-related quality issues.
* Ensure proper process control, traceability, and documentation throughout production.

**4. Maintenance & Equipment Management**

* Coordinate with the Maintenance team to ensure equipment reliability and minimum downtime.
* Drive preventive and predictive maintenance practices for forging equipment and furnaces.
* Support equipment upgrades, capacity expansion, tooling improvements, and new process implementation.

**5. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to industrial safety standards, particularly for hot forging, furnace operations, material handling, and heavy equipment.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with applicable statutory and environmental requirements.
* Conduct regular safety reviews, risk assessments, and corrective action follow-ups.

**6. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop production managers, engineers, supervisors, and shop-floor teams.
* Establish clear performance objectives and accountability across the department.
* Identify training needs and improve technical competencies and workforce productivity.
* Foster collaboration across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Supply Chain functions.

**7. Cost Control & Business Performance**

* Prepare and monitor departmental budgets, production costs, and resource utilization.
* Drive initiatives to reduce conversion costs, consumable costs, energy consumption, and manufacturing losses.
* Review daily, weekly, and monthly production performance and present operational reports to senior management.

**Educational Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Minimum **15+ years of experience** in manufacturing, preferably in the steel, forging, automotive components, heavy engineering, or allied industries.
* Significant hands-on experience in forging operations and production management, preferably in a steel manufacturing environment.
* Proven experience in managing large-scale manufacturing operations, production teams, and shop-floor activities.
* Strong understanding of forging processes, tooling, metallurgy, heat treatment, quality systems, and manufacturing technologies, as applicable.
* Experience in production planning, capacity utilization, cost control, process improvement, and productivity enhancement.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, 5S, Kaizen, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and deliver operational targets.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Production output and achievement of production targets.
* Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and machine utilization.
* Rejection, rework, and scrap reduction.
* Manufacturing cost and energy consumption per unit.
* On-time delivery and adherence to production schedules.
* Workplace safety performance and compliance.
* Implementation of productivity and continuous improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is responsible for establishing, implementing, operating, monitoring, and continuously enhancing OneFin’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) across all product lines and enterprise infrastructure.

This leader will own end-to-end information security strategy, cloud security governance (AWS), regulatory compliance (RBI guidelines for digital lending and IT governance), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standards, and client-facing security assessments for institutional banking partners. Implement zero trust security architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Information Security Governance & Strategy**

* Define, maintain, and enforce OneFin's Level-1 ISMS policies, standards, and guidelines in alignment with business goals.
* Report security posture, risk profiles, and incident metrics directly to the CEO, C-suite, and Board of Directors.
* Lead the annual risk assessment framework across all business units, maintaining the enterprise Risk Register and tracking remediation strategies.
* Establish annual security objectives, measurable parameters, and operational security targets.

**2. Regulatory, Compliance & Client Audit Management**

* Direct compliance for ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications, surveillance audits, and internal security audits.
* Ensure strict adherence to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines regarding digital lending, data localization, outsourcing, and cloud management.
* Act as the executive point of contact for financial institution (FI) client audits, managing Information Security Group (ISG) checklists, VAPT review points, and security questionnaires.
* Oversee Data Protection and Privacy compliance, protecting Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Sensitive Personal Data or Information (SPDI).
* Oversee source code audits, and conduct internal security audits of codebase.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & Product Security**

* Oversee security configuration across AWS environments, ensuring AES-256 encryption at rest (S3, RDS, ECR) and enforced TLS/HTTPS in transit.
* Enforce secure architecture models for single-tenant / dedicated client deployments on Financial Institution AWS infrastructure.
* Direct Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies, IP/URL whitelisting, geo-blocking, and network perimeter controls.
* Maintain DevSecOps rigor within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), ensuring automated peer reviews, static analysis, code coverage thresholds, and container image vulnerability management.

**4. Threat Management & Security Operations (SecOps)**

* Lead the Incident Response Team; ensure end-to-end management, SLA tracking, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for all P1/Critical incidents.
* Oversee centralized logging, Database Activity Monitoring (DAM), and integration capabilities with Bank SIEM systems.
* Mandate periodic Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) across applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
* Enforce robust Access Control & Identity Management (IAM), including mandatory multi-factor authentication (MFA) across email, code repositories, and cloud portals.

**5. Third-Party Risk & Business Continuity**

* Enforce Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) guidelines, ensuring mandatory MSAs and NDAs across all vendors.
* Manage annual Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) drills, validating Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Conduct annual enterprise-wide security awareness training programs and specialized DevSecOps workshops.

**Candidate Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related engineering fields.
* **Experience:** 12+ years in Information Security and Technology Risk, with at least 4+ years in a leadership role (CISO, Head of Security, or Director of InfoSec).
* **Domain Background:** Prior experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, Banking, or Financial Services ecosystems is strictly required.

**Technical & Professional Competencies**

**Cloud Security**- Deep expertise in AWS Security Hub, WAF, KMS, CloudTrail, IAM, RDS/S3 encryption, and containerized deployments (ECS/ECR).

**Frameworks**- Hands-on mastery of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST CSF, OWASP Top 10, and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

**Regulatory Knowledge**- In depth knowledge of RBI Cybersecurity Framework, RBI Digital Lending Directions, and Indian Data Protection laws.

**Application Security**- Expertise in DevSecOps, API security, automated code scanners, tesseract/OCR pipeline security, and LLM/AI model deployment governance.

**Leadership**- Exceptional stakeholder management, board-level reporting, and experience negotiating security requirements with Tier-1 Bank CISOs.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Global Process Owner Support (GPOS) role exists to strengthen first-line-of-defence risk management and governance across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes within Client Coverage. It supports Global Process Owners in embedding applicable policies, standards and controls into day-to-day business activities, helping the business manage operational and process risks consistently across markets. The role delivers oversight of control effectiveness, coordinated remediation of control gaps and exceptions, and clear reporting and escalation of material risks to support informed governance decisions. Working with business, country teams and second-line stakeholders, it also supports process simplification and the implementation of change with appropriate risk assessments and controls. Its primary focus is to maintain effective, consistent and efficient credit processes that support business delivery while operating within established risk tolerances.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

The role holder is an individual contributor with no formal people-management accountability. The role leads and coordinates assigned risk, control and process-improvement activities through stakeholder collaboration, supporting the Global Process Owner / delegate and GPOS Lead across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes. The role holder is accountable for the quality and timely delivery of assigned assessments, assurance oversight, reporting and remediation coordination; designated action owners remain responsible for completing their actions.
  
**Risk assessment and control implementation**  
• Implement applicable control requirements and procedures, and support each stage of the RCSA, from process and risk identification to monitoring implemented controls, at least annually and when trigger events occur, to maintain a current view of process and residual risks.
  
**Timely risk treatment**  
• Coordinate and track agreed elevated residual-risk actions and treatment plans with designated action owners, maintain records in the Group operational risk management system, and escalate delays to support timely completion.
  
**Learning from risk events**  
• Initiate Root Cause Reviews for in-scope material risk events and, where required, aggregate smaller events with similar root causes to identify recurring weaknesses and support corrective action.
  
**Controlled change delivery**  
• Identify delivery risks and dependencies, assess impacts on critical processes and residual risk, and review and support Operational and Change Risk Assessments and process-impact assessments before go-live, including minor changes where required.

**Broad Accountabilities**  
**Strategy**  
• Targeted Improvements: Work with internal stakeholders to identify gaps and improvement opportunities in credit processes, and lead assigned change and remediation activities to make processes more effective and streamlined.
  
• Support the GPO’s credit transformation agenda by translating agreed priorities into implementation activities and delivering assigned work within agreed timelines.
  
• Automation and Streamlining: Review operational efficiency, effectiveness and quality against changing business and customer needs, and identify actions to improve process performance.
  
• Drive continuous improvement and automation, and remove or simplify unnecessary process steps to improve efficiency and consistency across systems and processes.
  
• Support CPA Team Heads, including the CPA Hub, in improving process efficiency, simplifying processes and increasing capacity.
  
**Business**  
• Assess the process and operational-risk implications of business strategies, projects and programmes, and provide remediation guidance to support informed decisions.
  
• Support global adoption of Credit COE initiatives and work with management to implement agreed process improvements and strategic credit transformation initiatives.
  
• Maintain effective relationships with Business, Finance, Risk, Technology and Operations to resolve process issues and coordinate delivery across markets.
  
• Coordinate stakeholder inputs and supporting information for regulatory and audit requests to enable timely responses.

**Processes**  
• Support the Process Owner in delivering BAU operational-risk requirements on time and in designing and maintaining the Control Assessment Standards framework for front-office processes globally.
  
• Monitor CST/KCI exception trends and agree practical improvement actions with countries to strengthen processes and controls.
  
• Guide QC teams in GBS and countries in understanding and consistently applying checks, particularly those involving qualitative or subjective assessments.
  
• Support process governance by streamlining existing processes, rolling out new processes and resolving Credit and Credit Monitoring queries with the relevant GPOS Lead.
  
• Work with CPAs, Client Management, CPOs, R&C, Business Heads and other regional and country stakeholders to share developments, lessons and best practices, and deliver agreed requirements on time.
  
• Assess change impacts through CCIA, evaluate change readiness and perform GRAM assessments. Provide subject-matter expertise to help mitigate identified process risks.
  
• Support the resolution of Group-specific process issues and related actions identified by GIA.
  
• Support the Process Owner in promptly escalating significant risks and issues to Process Universe Owners, relevant RFOs or Policy Owners. Maintain effective relationships with 2LOD across applicable risk types to support management of the Bank’s risk profile.
  
**Risk Management**  
• Identify process risks and support implementation of the Operational Risk Framework and appropriate controls. Help operations manage risk within established tolerance thresholds and minimise risks and losses in Credit Origination.

* Identify non-standard processes and agree appropriate controls with the GPOS Lead. Review proposed process and system changes for material impacts, and keep DOIs and process documentation up to date.

• Support implementation of applicable Credit, Fraud, Climate, Reputational and Sustainability Risk policies and standards within CC COE, embedding their requirements in managed processes.
  
• Prepare updates on risk initiatives for CC Governance Committee packs, and provide subject-matter expertise for Root Cause Reviews and boundary events to support oversight and corrective action.
  
• Support the design and delivery of relevant Credit Transformation initiatives and partner with TB, FM and Lending to improve the operating model and execution through existing CC credit processes.
  
• Provide ongoing learning and guidance on policies, process risks, controls and governance. Work with 2LOD and Product partners to develop and implement a roadmap for improving the control framework.
  
• Support implementation and closure of Group-level audit Management Action Plans, and delivery of actions arising from PRA Dear CEO Letters and specific reviews relating to owned processes.
  
**Governance**  
• Ensure risks are clearly identified, quantified and reported to the appropriate governance forums, with timely visibility and escalation of material issues.
  
• Assess how effectively the control framework addresses key risks and initiate treatment plans where required. Coordinate remediation of capability, process, data and documentation gaps.
  
• Provide central oversight of CST/KCI assurance checks performed by GBS, including ongoing training and guidance, to maintain standardised and consistent assessments.

jobs.description:
Designation: Associate

Location: India Karnataka Bangalore,Karnataka

Organization: Digital Platforms

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**About Us :-**

*In a short span of 2.5 years since inception, Birla Pivot has evolved into a comprehensive B2B e-commerce platform offering integrated procurement and financial solutions that help businesses become efficient and grow. We offer products across 35 categories, 40,000+SKUs from 300+ brands across* ***Building Material, Chemicals & Metals****. We launched private labels in 3 categories : Tiles, Ply and Bath ware. With a robust network of suppliers and transporters, we have delivered to 4,000+ pin codes across 375 cities. Our customer base now spans top-tier EPC companies, civil contractors, real estate developers, OEMs, fabricators, manufacturing companies, dealers, and retailers. We connect Sellers, Buyers, Logistics service providers, Lending partners, Payment solution providers on a unified digital backbone thereby creating end to end visibility and providing a B2C like fulfilment experience for the B2B ecosystem.*

*The evolution of B2B ecommerce is expected to mirror the B2C ecommerce journey, where technology transformed discovery, pricing, fulfilment, and customer experience at scale. Digital penetration today in B2B ecommerce is still under* ***2%****, indicating massive headroom for scalable digital-first platforms. As the Aditya Birla Group, we are uniquely positioned to transform and shape the way commerce is done across these verticals by leveraging our deep industry expertise and scale. We have built a unique Quote based, Credit linked commerce journey that solves for the needs of B2B commerce with a diverse team that is a mix of deep industry expertise and experience of building complex technology platforms from the ground up. Our goal is to drive this digital adoption and create a distribution platform that can become* ***the most trusted B2B ecommerce platform in the country.***
  
  
***Why is this role exciting?***
  
  
***As our Security Engineer, you are the single hands-on owner of security operations and governance for Birla Pivot's cloud native B2B commerce platform —keeping every security KRI Green and closing audits with no major findings. In this role you get to:***
  
***?Own both sides of security —vulnerability, cloud posture, detection and access controls, and the policies, evidence and cadence that audits and the DPDP Act require.***
  
***?Shape how a high-growth business adopts AI securely, from the AI usage policy to reviews of every AI use case.***
  
***?Work closely with the Head of Cybersecurity, InfoSec & Cloud, the ABG central security team, legal and our vendors.***
  
  
***What will you do?***
  
  
***Security Operations & Incident Response***
  
  
***?Triage SIEM and EDR alerts daily; act as first responder for security incidents.***
  
***?Run incident response playbooks; prepare CERT-In reports within 6 hours of a reportable incident.***
  
***?Run tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.***
  
  
***Vulnerability & Exposure Management***
  
***?Run vulnerability scanning across cloud, containers, code and endpoints; track remediation against SLA (Critical 7 days, High 30 days).***
  
***?Coordinate VAPT and red team engagements and drive findings to closure.***
  
***?Maintain WAF rules and virtual patching for internet-facing apps.***
  
  
***Endpoint, Patching & Resilience***
  
  
***?Keep EDR healthy on all endpoints and servers; validate patch compliance monthly.***
  
***?Verify backup restore tests and support DR drills.***
  
  
***Cloud Security (AWS)***
  
  
***?Monitor posture with Prisma Cloud, Security Hub and Prowler; fix critical misconfigurations within 72 hours.***
  
***?Review IAM, security groups, network ACLs and firewall rules weekly.***
  
***?Enforce encryption, logging, key rotation, MFA and least privilege.***
  
  
***Identity & Privileged Access***
  
  
***?Integrate IAM with the HR system for joiner-mover-leaver; disable leaver accounts within 24 hours.***
  
***?Run the monthly manager certification of off-role and contractor IDs, and quarterly access reviews.***
  
***?Onboard servers, databases and admin accounts to PAM; deploy LAPS and domain-only login.***
  
  
***ISO 27001, Policies & Audits***

***?Maintain the ISMS document set: policies, procedures, risk register, Statement of Applicability.***
  
***?Draft policy amendments for approval; keep the policy register current.***
  
***?Collect audit evidence for internal, external and ISO audits; track findings to closure.***
  
  
***Data Privacy & Vendor Risk***

***?Maintain the personal-data inventory and DPDP records with legal; implement technical controls (encryption, logging, erasure).***
  
***?Run vendor risk assessments and keep all vendor contracts in the central repository***
  
  
***Cadence, Reporting & Awareness***

***?Run the Friday SPOC and vendor ticket review; issue and close monthly, quarterly and half-yearly checklists.***
  
***?Prepare the monthly KRI pack and feed the central security dashboard (SIEM, VAPT, patching, DPDP, change, PAM).***
  
***?Publish the weekly infosec mailer; run trainings and phishing simulations.***
  
  
***AI Security & Governance***

***?Maintain the AI usage policy and the approved AI tools list —enterprise or ABG central accounts only, and no new AI initiative live without review.***
  
***?Run a security and privacy review for every AI use case: data shared, model and vendor, prompt injection, output handling, access rights.***
  
***?Detect and block unapproved AI tools through Zscaler logs; apply DLP so confidential and personal data stays out of public AI tools.***
  
***?Secure AI integrations against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications: least-privilege API keys, guardrails, logging, human approval for high-impact actions.***
  
***?Keep an AI use-case register for audit.***
  
  
***What success looks like in your first 6 months***

***?EDR coverage 98%; leaver accounts disabled within 24 hours, 100% of the time.***
  
***?No Critical vulnerability past its 7-day SLA. ?Critical log sources in SIEM with 180-day retention ( 95%).***
  
***? 95% of privileged accounts in PAM. ?Internal audit for ISO 27001 closed with no major technical findings.***
  
***?All monthly and quarterly checklists closed on time; weekly mailer running every week.***
  
***?AI usage policy published; every AI use case in the register with a completed risk review; no unapproved AI tools in use.***

***A Day In Life of a Security Engineer at Birla Pivot***

***Your day moves fast —from triaging the morning's SIEM and EDR alerts and chasing a Critical finding to closure, to fixing a cloud misconfiguration, reviewing a new AI use case with the product team, and pulling audit evidence together. At Birla Pivot, you operate at the pace of a high-growth business where every control counts.***

**What makes you a great fit?**

?3–5 years in security operations, vulnerability management or cloud security (at least 2 in cloud, AWS preferred).
  
?Hands-on AWS security: IAM, VPC, security groups, CloudTrail, GuardDuty or Security Hub, KMS.
  
?Working knowledge of SIEM, EDR, WAF and vulnerability scanners (e.g. Qualys, Prisma Cloud, Snyk).
  
?Understanding of ISO 27001 controls and audit evidence.
  
?Scripting in Python or Bash for automation.
  
?Experience preparing audit evidence, writing policies and running review cadences.
  
?Clear written communication for incident reports and audit responses

**Good to have**

?Certifications: AWS Certified Security –Specialty, CompTIA Security+, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor.
  
?Exposure to PAM (BeyondTrust, Arcon), Zscaler, Kubernetes security, DevSecOps pipelines (SAST, SCA, DAST).
  
?Knowledge of the DPDP Act 2023 and CERT-In directions.
  
?AI security: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, securing LLM APIs and AI agents.

**AVP/VP – US Enterprise Business**

**About Decimal Point Analytics**

Decimal Point Analytics (DPA) is a global Data, AI, Analytics and Technology solutions company helping enterprises turn complex business and data challenges into measurable outcomes.

With 23+ years of experience, around 500 professionals, 350+ successful projects and offices across New York, London and India, DPA works with clients across financial services and other enterprise sectors to solve high-impact problems using advanced analytics, AI, automation, research and technology.

Our capabilities span Data & AI, investment and financial intelligence, risk and regulatory analytics, lending and insurance solutions, digital transformation, automation, data engineering and client-specific strategic solutions.

As we accelerate our growth in the United States, we are looking for an accomplished, energetic and highly driven enterprise salesperson who can build relationships, create opportunities and convert them into long-term strategic client partnerships.

**The Role**

**We are looking for a AVP/VP – US Enterprise Business to drive new client acquisition and revenue growth in the United States.**

This is not a desk-based sales management role.

**We are looking for a hands-on enterprise hunter and relationship builder who is comfortable opening doors, meeting senior decision-makers, understanding complex business problems and working with DPA's solution and delivery teams to convert those problems into high-value engagements.**

**The successful candidate will be based in India but should be willing and able to travel extensively across the United States for client meetings, conferences, industry events and deal progression.**

**The person will own the sales journey from target-account identification and first conversation through discovery, solutioning, proposal, negotiation and closure.**

**What You Will Own**

* Position DPA as a long-term strategic and execution partner rather than a transactional vendor.

**Account Expansion**
