jobs.description:
**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Customer Service & Operations  
**Designation:** Customer Service Executive  
**Location:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Office-based  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Reporting To:** Customer Service Manager / Head of Operations  
**Salary:** As per experience and suitability (Fixed + Performance Incentive)

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financial services company focused on providing responsible, accessible and technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved customer segments.

The company offers financing solutions across multiple customer categories and is expanding its digital lending and financial services operations.

At Loan2grow, we believe that a good customer experience is central to responsible lending. We aim to make financial services accessible, transparent and convenient through technology-enabled platforms and responsive customer support.

2. About the Role

We are looking for customer-oriented and proactive professionals to join our Customer Service & Operations team as Customer Service Executives.

The selected candidates will be responsible for handling customer queries, providing assistance throughout the loan application and servicing journey, resolving customer complaints and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

F. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.
* Work with Credit teams to obtain updates on loan applications and pending verifications.
* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.
* Work with Collections teams on repayment-related customer queries and payment confirmation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation and account-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, queries, complaints and service requests.
* Update customer interactions and service request status in the CRM or designated systems.
* Maintain daily customer service reports covering:
* Total inbound and outbound calls.
* Customer queries received.
* Customer requests registered.
* Complaints received and resolved.
* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.
* Escalated complaints.
* Customer follow-up status.
* Share daily and weekly performance updates with the reporting manager.
* Identify recurring customer issues and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, telecalling, contact centres or customer relationship management.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable handling inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to handle multiple customer queries and service requests simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, digital lending, microfinance or other financial services organisations.
* Experience handling loan-related customer queries and servicing requests.
* Familiarity with loan application processes, KYC documentation and digital onboarding.
* Experience resolving EMI, repayment and payment-related queries.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Exposure to complaint management and customer grievance resolution.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and query resolution.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Patience and empathy in customer interactions.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations.

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

**Role Overview**

As City Manager – Sales & Operations, Bengaluru, you will own our business in the city end to end. You will bring in new NBFC and bank customers, and you will make sure that every customer we sign is onboarded smoothly, served well and keeps growing with us. You will run the city like a business unit: pipeline, revenue, delivery quality and client satisfaction are all yours.

This role suits someone who enjoys being in front of credit, legal and collections leaders at lending institutions, and who also likes making operations run cleanly behind the scenes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development (approx. 60%)**

•Find, prospect and acquire new NBFCs, banks (private, small finance, cooperative), HFCs and MFIs headquartered or with major operations in Bengaluru and Karnataka.

•Build and manage a healthy pipeline: research target accounts, map decision-makers (Heads of Collections, Legal, Credit Operations, Risk, IT/Digital) and run multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

**B. City Operations & Client Delivery (approx. 40%)**

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

* Coordinate with internal product, tech, legal and support teams to resolve client issues and escalations quickly.

* Make sure clients receive timely MIS and delivery reports, and review account health with them regularly (monthly reviews and QBRs).

* Track usage, wallet/billing status and collections on invoices for city accounts, and follow up on receivables.

* Manage local vendors and partners (printing, dispatch, courier and field partners) where needed.

* Capture client feedback and feature requests and pass them to the product team in a structured way.

* As the city grows, hire, train and lead a small team of sales and operations executives.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New NBFC and bank customers signed per quarter

* Revenue and pipeline value against target

* Time from signature to go-live for new clients

* SLA adherence for notice dispatch, eSign and ODR delivery

* Client retention, expansion revenue and cross-sell across products

* Receivables collected on time

**Requirements Must have**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B / enterprise sales, account management or operations in BFSI, fintech, legal-tech or SaaS.

* A proven record of selling to NBFCs and/or banks, with an existing network among collections, legal, credit or operations leaders.

* Understanding of the lending lifecycle in India — loan origination, documentation, collections, NPA recovery and legal/recovery processes (SARFAESI, Section 138 NI Act, arbitration).

* Comfort managing operational processes, SLAs and client escalations.

* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets and preparing MIS reports.

* Willing to travel within Bengaluru and Karnataka for client meetings. Good to have

* Experience selling eSign, eStamp, legal notice, collections or ODR solutions.

* Exposure to RBI digital lending guidelines and outsourcing norms for regulated entities.

* Experience setting up or scaling a city or regional business from an early stage.

* Experience hiring and leading a small team.

**What We Offer**

* A chance to build and own a city business at an early-stage, fast-growing legal-tech company.

* Direct work with the founding team and real influence on product and go-to-market.

* Competitive fixed pay plus a performance-linked incentive plan.

* A clear growth path to Regional / Zonal Head as we expand to more cities.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Head – SAP PaPM Centre of Excellence | India
jobs.company: The Edge Partnership - The Edge in Asia
jobs.description:
A leading global bank is making SAP PaPM its strategic platform for profitability, cost allocation and performance management, and needs a leader to build the Centre of Excellence that makes it happen. This is a full end-to-end ownership role covering PaPM strategy, delivery, architecture and platform operations across Finance, Treasury, Risk, Sustainability and Performance Management. You'll be the senior point of contact for the CFO organisation, Finance Transformation, Treasury, Risk, Technology and Operations, and you'll shape the team, the standards and the roadmap from the ground up.

**Some of the key responsibilities will include:**

* **Owning the CoE vision, operating model and strategic roadmap**
  , aligned with the bank's Finance Transformation, Enterprise Architecture, Data and AI strategies.
* **Owning the annual PaPM Book of Work**
  , including demand prioritisation, capacity planning and delivery on scope, budget and quality.
* **Setting PaPM design standards and architecture principles**
  , chairing Solution Design Reviews and approving which new use cases come onto the platform.
* **Owning platform health, stability and resilience**
  , covering release and incident management, technical debt reduction and operational KPIs.
* **Building and leading a multi-disciplinary team**
  of Solution Leads, Architects, Analysts, Modelers and Platform Specialists.
* **Presenting delivery status, investment cases and recommendations**
  to senior governance forums and steering committees.
* **Managing vendor partnerships**
  and overseeing external delivery teams.
* **Embedding risk, audit and control compliance**
  across all PaPM initiatives.

**To be eligible for this role you will require:**

* 12+ years in Finance Technology, Enterprise Applications or Finance Transformation.
* 7+ years of SAP, with significant hands-on SAP PaPM experience.
* Strong understanding of BW/4HANA and S/4HANA.
* Solid grounding in controllership, profitability and cost management, transfer pricing, and allocations and recharges.
* A proven record of building and scaling a Centre of Excellence and leading global delivery teams.
* Experience engaging senior business stakeholders and executive governance forums.
* Banking or financial services experience, and exposure to FP&A, Treasury, Risk or Regulatory Reporting, are a strong advantage.

**CANDIDATES WHO ARE INTERESTED, SHARE YOUR UPDATED CV TO guy@theedgepartnership.com**

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that your personal information may be processed using secure recruitment technologies, including AI-assisted tools, for recruitment, assessment, interview documentation, candidate representation, and related business purposes. Further information is available in our Privacy Policy.

Please note that due to the high number of applications only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If you do not hear from us in the next 7 business days, we regret to inform you that your application for this position was unsuccessful.

jobs.title: Head – Wealth Advisory & Business Growth
jobs.description:
**About The Opportunity**

* Fintoo is a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser and fee-based financial planning firm offering holistic financial planning, investment advisory, global investing, and tax advisory services. The company’s philosophy prioritizes planning before execution and places client interests first, combining professional advice with technology to help individuals make informed financial decisions.
* The company is expanding its advisory footprint and seeks a leader to build and scale its Wealth Advisory business in Bengaluru, translating its strong foundation (₹5,000+ Cr Assets Under Tracking, ₹1,000+ Cr Assets Under Advisory, 2,300+ Paid Customers) into a scalable, sustainable, and profitable business.

Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the Bengaluru business plan, revenue targets, growth strategy, and profitability.
* Develop and execute a go-to-market strategy targeting affluent professionals, HNI clients, and other relevant segments through referrals, professional networks, chartered accountants, corporate relationships, and strategic alliances.
* Personally lead key client conversations, business negotiations, and high-value conversions; manage the full customer journey from prospecting to long-term advisory.
* Identify growth opportunities, improve conversion ratios, and strengthen revenue productivity; present forecasts and quarterly plans to senior management.
* Champion a planning-led, fiduciary, and client-first advisory approach; understand clients’ goals, income, liabilities, risk profiles, liquidity needs, and investment horizons to support comprehensive financial planning.
* Ensure recommendations are appropriate to clients’ circumstances, supported by suitable documentation and disclosures; drive holistic financial planning over transactional, product-led selling.
* Lead periodic portfolio reviews, goal tracking, and proactive client engagement in collaboration with research, investment, product, and technology teams.
* Grow AUA sustainably through appropriate client acquisition, retention, and deeper advisory engagement; convert paid financial planning customers into ongoing advisory relationships.
* Improve renewals, referrals, customer lifetime value, and relationship longevity through consistent service and demonstrable advisory value.
* Establish client segmentation, engagement frequency, review, and escalation frameworks; personally manage key relationships and strategic prospects.
* Lead an initial team of six professionals across advisory, relationship management, and business development; set clear KRAs, revenue goals, productivity benchmarks, and accountability mechanisms.
* Recruit, coach, and develop professionals with financial planning capabilities, client orientation, and commercial acumen; build a high-performance culture based on ownership, collaboration, integrity, and continuous learning.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline reviews, and capability-building initiatives; identify and develop future leaders; scale the team in line with approved budgets and performance.
* Translate annual objectives into actionable quarterly and monthly plans; track revenue, conversion ratios, paid customer acquisition, AUA growth, client retention, and individual productivity.
* Identify performance gaps early and implement corrective actions; balance growth investment, acquisition costs, team capacity, and profitability; build dashboards and repeatable processes for scale.
* Partner with product and technology teams to improve advisory workflows, customer experience, and advisor productivity; use digital tools, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to make financial advice scalable and accessible.
* Collaborate with marketing on targeted campaigns, financial education, and lead generation; work with operations, finance, and compliance teams for efficient execution and robust governance.
* Share market and customer insights to inform advisory products and business strategy.
* Uphold Fintoo’s fiduciary, fee-based, and client-first advisory philosophy; ensure compliance with SEBI requirements, internal policies, and ethical standards; maintain high standards of client suitability, documentation, disclosures, and transparency.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in BFSI / Wealth Management, including at least 4 years in business development and team leadership.
* Proven track record of building a business, acquiring clients, and achieving revenue targets.
* Strong understanding of comprehensive financial planning, investment advisory, asset allocation, and relationship management.
* Experience working with affluent professionals and HNI clients, with the ability to build credibility and long-term relationships.
* Commercial judgment, analytical ability, and ownership of business performance.
* Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate, and scale teams in a growth-oriented environment.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Both NISM Series X-A and Series X-B certifications are mandatory.

**Preferred**

* Experience in building and scaling advisory businesses in competitive markets.
* Deep understanding of digital tools and technology-enabled advisory workflows.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing, and operations teams.

Benefits & Culture Highlights
  
  

* Opportunity to build a trusted, high-performing, and profitable advisory business in Bengaluru.
* Focus on establishing a strong local presence, creating a consistent acquisition engine, growing AUA and long-term advisory relationships.
* Culture that values ownership, ethical advice, and measurable outcomes.
* Support to develop a capable team and build operating systems that support the next stage of expansion.

* Drive workforce planning and succession planning for niche PaPM skills.
* Foster innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across global teams.

* Ensure robust support, maintenance, release management, and incident management processes.
* Drive continuous optimization and technical debt reduction initiatives.
* Establish operational KPIs and service management standards.
* Ensure business continuity and resilience of critical PaPM processes

* Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, security, and enterprise control requirements.
* Maintain transparent governance and reporting across all PaPM initiatives.
* Drive proactive identification and mitigation of delivery, platform, and resource risks

* Time-to-market improvement for new use cases.
* Platform availability and stability.

* Audit and control compliance.
* Team capability and certification growth.
* Reuse of standard components and design patterns.

**Required Experience**

* 7+ years of SAP experience with significant exposure to SAP PaPM.
* Proven leadership experience managing global delivery teams and complex transformation programs.
* Strong understanding of:
* SAP PaPM

* SAP S/4HANA
* Finance and Controllership processes
* Profitability and Cost Management
* Transfer Pricing
* Allocations and Recharges
* Performance Management

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager – India Lead, CTF & BSRA**
At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.
  
  
Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.
  
  
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of
**Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager**
to join our
**Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) & Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA)**
team within Finance. This role is located in
**Pune, India**
.
  
  
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
  
  

* Functional leadership: Lead Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) and Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) from India, with full accountability for the quality, timeliness, control and continuous improvement of all deliverables.
* Plan & forecast: Own the end-to-end Balance Sheet and Net Interest Income (NII) plan and forecast process (plan rounds, rest-of-year and multi-year outlooks) for supported Lines of Business, ensuring a consistent methodology and timely submission into planning systems.
* Deposit forecast governance: Lead the deposit forecast and challenger process with Treasury Finance, GLS and LOB CFOs – framing assumptions, sensitivities, beta/pricing expectations and decision asks.
* NII & balance sheet narrative: Own the NII and balance sheet story for senior management, explaining drivers of variance versus plan, forecast and prior periods (rate, volume and mix) along with forward-looking risks and opportunities.
* Subject-matter expertise: Provide leadership on Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), liquidity metrics (LCR and liquidity stress testing), interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing balance dynamics, and assess the impact of central bank rate changes, client flows and product/currency mix on deposits and NII.
* Reporting & analytics: Oversee daily, weekly, month-end and quarterly reporting – including month-to-date NII estimates, earnings support, management memos and client-, LOB- and firm-level analytics such as deposit pricing cohorts, client movers and beta analysis.
* Stakeholder partnership: Serve as trusted advisor and senior point of contact for Corporate Treasury, CIO, Treasury Finance, LOB CFOs, GLS, Interest Rate Risk, International Treasury, Controllers and Technology; represent India in senior forums and build durable partnerships through clear service models, SLAs and governance cadences.
* Scope expansion: Identify and lead the transition of new LOBs, platforms and processes into the India hub, partnering with Finance Data Strategy, Technology and other Centers of Excellence on firm-wide initiatives.
* Transformation & AI: Drive process simplification, report rationalization and adoption of Power BI, self-serve dashboards, automation and AI agents, tracking measurable efficiency gains aligned to Finance objectives.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
  
  

* Education: Master’s degree in a financial discipline such as accounting, finance, economics or statistics, or local country equivalent, is required; MBA preferred. Professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, FRM or CPA are a strong advantage.
* Experience: 15+ years of progressive experience in finance, FP&A, treasury finance or balance sheet management within banking or financial services.
* Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of Asset and Liability Management (ALM), deposits, NII, FTP, liquidity (LCR/LST), interest rate risk and the bank balance sheet, with a sound understanding of financial controls and governance.
* Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.
* Communication & tools: Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills; advanced MS Office; proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and ERP tools (e.g., Planning Analytics/TM1, Cognos, HFM, Oracle) and Power BI – exposure to Python/SQL, automation and AI tools is a plus.
* People leadership: 7+ years leading multi-layered teams (VPs, AVPs, Specialists and Analysts), with demonstrated strength in organization design, workforce and succession planning, coaching and performance management, and in building an inclusive, high-performance culture.

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at:
  
  
BNY Newsroom
  
  
BNY LinkedIn
  
  
**Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards**

* America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
* World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
* “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

**Our Benefits And Rewards**
BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

**Role Purpose**
The Head of Engineering for Revenue Accounting India will provide senior technology and engineering leadership for the Revenue Accounting organization in India, building a world-class engineering capability and driving modernization, engineering excellence and predictable delivery across the Revenue Accounting technology estate.
  
  
The role will establish India as a
**strategic engineering centre supporting end-to-end delivery**
, partnering with global Technology and Finance leadership to deliver critical Revenue Accounting capabilities and strategic transformation.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong engineering and technology leadership with the ability to lead a large, complex organization, develop exceptional talent, modernize the technology estate and deliver consistently in a highly regulated environment.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Engineering Leadership & Strategy**

* Lead the Revenue Accounting engineering organization in India, with accountability for engineering excellence, talent, technology and delivery outcomes.
* Define and execute the India engineering strategy, aligned to the global Revenue Accounting technology strategy and broader Finance transformation agenda.
* Provide strong technical leadership across the engineering organization, ensuring strategic technology decisions balance business outcomes, architecture, resilience, risk and long-term sustainability.
* Establish clear engineering standards across software design, architecture, development, testing, DevSecOps, observability, resilience and production engineering.
* Champion a culture of engineering ownership where teams are accountable for solutions throughout the technology lifecycle, from design and build through deployment and production.

**Technology Modernization**

* Drive modernization of the Revenue Accounting technology estate, including MOTIF and the broader subledger ecosystem, simplifying legacy architecture and moving toward strategic target-state capabilities.
* Actively manage technical debt and drive simplification of applications, infrastructure, data flows and engineering processes.
* Promote modern architecture and engineering patterns including cloud, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, automation and modern data capabilities where appropriate.
* Ensure technology investment balances immediate business and regulatory requirements with the long-term strategic health of the platform.

**Delivery & Transformation**

* Drive predictable execution of the Revenue Accounting engineering roadmap, aligning engineering capacity to the highest-value business, regulatory and strategic outcomes.
* Provide senior engineering leadership to major Finance transformation initiatives, ensuring Revenue Accounting capabilities integrate effectively with the target front-to-back accounting architecture.
* Establish transparent measures of engineering health, delivery effectiveness, quality, risk and productivity.
* Identify and proactively manage material technology dependencies, delivery risks and capacity constraints.

**Talent & Organizational Leadership**

* Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization across India, strengthening both engineering leadership and deep technical capability.
* Attract, retain and develop outstanding engineering talent while creating clear career paths for technical specialists and engineering leaders.
* Build a strong succession pipeline across Director, VP, technical leadership and senior engineering roles.
* Strengthen institutional knowledge and reduce key-person or third-party dependencies through targeted insourcing, mobility, cross-training and capability development.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative and high-performance engineering culture where teams are empowered to challenge, innovate and continuously improve.

**Innovation & AI**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-enabled software engineering, intelligent automation and modern developer tooling across the engineering lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, test automation, software quality and speed to market through AI and automation.
* Create an environment that encourages experimentation while ensuring innovation is governed appropriately for a regulated technology environment.

**Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as a senior member of the global Revenue Accounting technology leadership team, ensuring India is fully integrated into global strategy and decision-making.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Product, Architecture, Operations, Risk, Controls and Technology.
* Influence enterprise technology and engineering decisions beyond the immediate Revenue Accounting organization.
* Represent Revenue Accounting within the broader India technology leadership community and strengthen India's position as a strategic engineering hub.

****Desirable Skills****
The following would be advantageous:
  
  
  

* Experience within financial accounting technology, including subledger, general ledger, financial control or regulatory reporting platforms.
* Understanding of front-to-back accounting flows, including transaction capture, accounting event generation, subledger processing, reconciliation, financial controls and general-ledger integration.
* Experience delivering large-scale Finance or enterprise transformation within a global financial institution.
* Experience with large-scale platform or cloud modernization.
* Knowledge of modern technologies and patterns including Java, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, AWS/cloud technologies, DevSecOps and modern data platforms.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted software engineering, developer productivity tooling or intelligent test automation at enterprise scale.
* Experience developing product-oriented and Agile engineering organizations.
* Experience implementing insourcing strategies and transferring critical technology or domain capability from third-party providers into permanent engineering teams.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations, particularly across India, the UK and US.
* Understanding of technology economics and experience optimizing engineering investment, infrastructure costs and third-party expenditure.

****Accountabilities****
The Head of Engineering will have clear accountability across the following areas:
  
  
**Technology & Architecture**

* Technical health and strategic evolution of the Revenue Accounting technology estate within the role's remit.
* Alignment to enterprise architecture, engineering and technology standards.
* Reduction of legacy complexity and technical debt.
* Creation of sustainable, resilient and scalable technology solutions.

**Engineering & Delivery**

* Quality, predictability and effectiveness of engineering delivery.
* Engineering standards and controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Effective management of engineering capacity, dependencies and technology risks.
* Continuous improvement of engineering productivity, quality and time to market.

**Service, Resilience & Controls**

* Stability, resilience, security and maintainability of technology platforms.
* Effective management of production risk, recurring incidents and systemic technology issues.
* Compliance with applicable technology, cyber, data, resilience and regulatory requirements.
* Timely identification, escalation and remediation of material technology risks and control weaknesses.

**People & Organization**

* Organizational health and effectiveness of the India Revenue Accounting engineering function.
* Workforce strategy, organizational design and location strategy.
* Attraction, retention, development and succession of engineering talent.
* Development of strong engineering and technology leadership capability.
* Reduction of key-person risk and inappropriate dependency on external providers.

jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.company: ARCELORMITTAL GLOBAL CAPABILITY CENTER PRIVATE LIMITED
jobs.description:
ArcelorMittal is one of the world's leading steel and mining companies, with operations across multiple countries and a strong focus on innovation, sustainability and technological advancement. The company is committed to developing smarter, safer and more sustainable steel solutions to support customers and industries worldwide.

Technology and digital transformation play an important role in enabling ArcelorMittal's global operations. Corporate IT supports this journey by strengthening enterprise platforms, modernizing data capabilities, improving operational efficiency and enabling data-driven business decisions.

Join ArcelorMittal's Corporate IT team and contribute to the evolution of its enterprise data landscape, supporting both established platforms and modern data technologies.

Role Purpose

Design, govern and evolve the enterprise data architecture so that data remains reliable, consistent, scalable and understandable from source systems through transformation, semantic and reporting layers. The role bridges the existing SQL Server and SSAS estate with modern data platforms.

**Primary Accountability:** Architecture direction, technical standards, cross-layer integrity and modernization roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

**Operations and Run**

* Define and maintain architecture standards for Microsoft SQL Server environments from 2017 to 2022 in the on-premise estate.
* Ensure consistency and integrity across staging, transformation, computation, semantic and reporting layers.
* Validate the design of SQL Agent scheduled jobs, including orchestration, dependencies, recoverability and operational maintainability.
* Guide complex incident resolution and root-cause analysis across the full data lineage.
* Ensure alignment between data-warehouse structures and SSAS Multidimensional or Tabular semantic models.
* Safeguard scalability, performance, reliability and supportability of the data platform across legacy and new environments.

**Development and Evolution**

* Maintain an inventory of legacy components, dependencies, owners, support constraints, technical debt and end-of-support dates.
* Classify components as retain, stabilize, replace or retire, linking retirement decisions to validated migration milestones and business cutover approval.
* Define migration and decommissioning controls, including source-to-target mappings, automated reconciliation, performance and recoverability evidence, business acceptance, approved cutover plans and rollback procedures.
* Define the target architecture for migrated data, integrating a newly designed target data model, Databricks pipelines in Python or PySpark, modern Microsoft storage and a rebuilt logical querying layer.
* Lead migration from the existing SQL Server and SSAS estate into the new target data model, without treating existing application or ETL code as migration assets.
* Define modeling standards, selecting dimensional, Data Vault or hybrid approaches according to context.
* Establish best practices for pipeline design, batch processing, orchestration, partitioning and reusable data services.
* Drive modularity, maintainability and source-agnostic design across the new target data model, pipelines and logical querying layer.
* Shape improvements to automation, monitoring and data-quality frameworks.

**Collaboration and Governance**

* Collaborate with Data Engineers on pipeline implementation and with Data Analysts on semantic consistency and validation requirements.
* Translate business and operational constraints into sustainable architecture decisions.
* Maintain architecture principles, decision records, lineage expectations and transition roadmaps.

Key Competencies

* Security and continuity responsibilities, including access governance, secrets and credential management, vulnerability and patch tracking, backup and restore validation, disaster-recovery testing, audit evidence and periodic review of privileged access across legacy and target platforms.
* Expertise in data warehousing, dimensional modeling and performance optimization.
* Advanced SQL Server, T-SQL, SSAS Multidimensional, MDX and Tabular modeling.
* Experience with Databricks, Python, PySpark, Data Lake and Lakehouse patterns.
* Deep understanding of ETL and ELT, batch processing, orchestration and data partitioning.
* Ability to bridge legacy and modern environments.
* Technical leadership, governance and complex problem-solving.
* Working knowledge of adjacent roles' core responsibilities to provide backup coverage for critical legacy operations, incident response and migration activities.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Modernization & AI-Assisted Development
jobs.description:
TechGrove is the **Centre of Excellence** for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.

**About the role**
------------------

TDMS is a post-trade reconciliation and settlement platform used by institutional asset managers, and it is entering a significant modernization. This role leads the engineering of it: an AI-first effort to re-architect how the platform is built, deployed, and scaled, on a system that real money settles through every day.

That is also what sets the bar. Settlement accuracy is the product, and a single mis-settled trade is a client-loss event, so the engineering judgment we expect here is high.

This is a build-heavy, high-ownership role at the technical center of the platform. You will own the cloud architecture, the delivery automation, the engineering standards, and the technical execution of the modernization that carries TDMS through its next phase of growth. You will work agentic-coding-first from day one. That is table stakes here, not a bonus: you use agentic tools to deliver well beyond traditional hand-coding throughput, and you read, validate, and stand behind everything that ships. You do not need to be a lifelong C# / .NET expert, but you do need to read C# / .NET fluently, reason about it, and guarantee its quality.

The role carries both sides of the work. You keep the current application healthy in hands-on, day-to-day operations, including the unglamorous parts, while steadily applying modern engineering to it. The migration runs over the coming months, so expect what you do day to day to evolve: the agentic-coding way of working is constant from the start, while the architecture, deployment model, and tooling change as the migration progresses.

You report to the Chief Product and Technology Officer and partner closely with the Head of Development. You will also work with and level up a small, distributed team of engineers across India and the US.

**What you will do**
--------------------

**Architecture and scale**

* **Own the platform architecture.** Set and drive the target architecture for a cloud-native platform: a load-balanced, stateless application tier over a managed data tier, evolved through coexistence and monitored cutover rather than a single rewrite. New capabilities run in parallel with the paths they replace, and legacy paths are retired only once monitoring confirms traffic has moved.
* **Drive a clean service-oriented design.** Lead the application architecture toward services that are testable, independently deployable, and independently scalable.
* **Own the data platform.** Lead schema design, data architecture, performance, and any migration work on PostgreSQL (Aurora), protecting data integrity at every step.

**Cloud and infrastructure**

* **Own the cloud architecture.** Lead the platform's architecture on AWS, including managed PostgreSQL (Aurora), load balancing, networking, and managed services.
* **Treat infrastructure as code.** Stand up reproducible, version-controlled environments rather than hand-built servers.

**CI/CD and delivery engineering**

* **Own CI/CD and delivery automation.** Build and own automated build, test, and zero-downtime, progressive deployment (canary, blue/green, rolling) end to end, with feature flags as the default way to decouple deploy from release.
* **Set the source-control standard.** Establish trunk-based development on GitHub with short-lived branches, squash-merge, and mandatory peer review.

**AI-assisted (agentic) development**

* **Work agentic-coding-first.** Agentic coding (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and similar) is your default development methodology, not an occasional assist. You set the standard for what strong agentic-assisted engineering looks like here.
* **Bring the team up the curve.** The rest of the team is still learning these tools and will lean on you. Coach them, pair with them, and establish the patterns that make agentic coding productive and safe.
* **Set the guardrails.** Define how AI-assisted code is reviewed, tested, and trusted on a mission-critical settlement codebase, so speed never comes at the cost of correctness.

**Quality, observability, and reliability**

* **Own end-to-end observability.** Lead application performance monitoring, error tracking, and product analytics across the stack, so the team builds and operates on real signal rather than guesswork.
* **Support the live platform.** Take part in day-to-day operations, support, and incident response for the production system, and fold modern practices into it as you go rather than waiting for a finished rebuild.
* **Own production confidence.** Lead automated testing, root-cause analysis, and durable fixes for complex production issues.
* **Design for resilience.** Build fault tolerance and self-healing into the platform so it degrades gracefully and recovers without manual intervention.
* **Roll out carefully.** Stage and guard every change that expands the surface area for settlement error.

**Technical leadership**

* **Set the technical direction.** Own the architecture and the engineering standards for the platform: the coding, review, branching, testing, and quality practices the team works to, and hold the bar.
* **Raise the team.** Mentor the engineers across our India and US teams and deepen their strength in modern cloud, delivery, and AI-assisted practices, so platform knowledge is shared across the team rather than concentrated in any one person.
* **Solution with the team.** Work closely with the CPTO and the wider team to turn product and platform direction into technical execution, contributing to shared solutioning while the overall vision is set at the CPTO level.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* Typically ten or more years building and operating production software, though we weight demonstrated skill over years on a resume. You read C# / .NET fluently and can review, validate, and reason about it, since agentic tools will generate much of the code and you are accountable for its correctness. Lifelong .NET specialization is not required.
* A track record architecting and scaling complex production systems, including incremental modernization of established codebases through coexistence and parallel-run patterns, with data-driven deprecation of legacy paths once traffic has moved over. Service decomposition and cloud-native design experience expected.
* Hands-on experience designing microservices and building and deploying containers, with a strong grasp of architecture patterns and scalability tradeoffs.
* Strong distributed-systems fundamentals: event-driven architecture with pub/sub and message queues, API gateways, and designing for fault tolerance and self-healing.
* Strong hands-on AWS and/or Azure: managed databases, load balancing, networking, and managed services, with infrastructure as code.
* You have built CI/CD pipelines from scratch, including automated testing and zero-downtime, progressive deployment (canary, blue/green, or rolling), and you have used feature flags in production.

**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility.

* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.

* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

**Technical Skills**

* Understands the Input Zone's data and technical architecture — publisher drop zones, ingestion validation, and the downstream handoff — well enough to liaise credibly with engineering.

* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).

* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.

* Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints.

**Competencies**

**Personal Capability**

**Practices Self-Development**

* Is curious and keen to learn and develop new ideas, skills, and knowledge.

* Acts on feedback to improve him/herself.

* Looks for developmental opportunities in day-to-day work.

* Invests time and energy in self-development (professional qualifications, relevant reading, networking, keeping up with AI-assisted product and development practices).

**Solves Problems and Analyses Issues**

* Is able to ask effective questions and collect facts from multiple sources in order to solve problems.

**Innovates**

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.

Andersen is hiring an Enterprise PMO Lead in Abu Dhabi for a transformation program focused on governance, operations improvement, and business process optimization.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Description:**

This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. The Post Execution Quality process is a key risk indicator that is reported to the regulators monthly. The PEQ process is reviewed numerous times a year by Regulators, Internal Audit and Compliance Testing to ensure adherence to regulatory and Citi-wide policies and standards. This role is responsible to test the Post Execution Quality accuracy to ensure all KYC Quality reporting is in line with our regulatory commitments to the OCC. This role is responsible for independently testing each PEQ analyst and report all findings to the Head of Wealth KYC Quality for effective oversight of personnel.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

This role is critical in identifying any quality deficiencies immediately, raise self-identified issues for proper oversight and execution on the correction action plans in a timely manner. Without this role and process, KYC could introduce significant risks related to regulatory and internal audit findings for insufficient KYC program and controls. These results would lead to significant remediation population, remediation populations, procedures changes or even MRA (Matters Requiring Attention) if identified by a regulator.

Partner with internal units to ensure adequate due diligence process is carried out for customer accounts and documentation reviews.

Strong understanding of wealth holding vehicles which includes the various structures, legality, and documentation for each type of entity.

If you are looking for a game-changing career, working for one of the world's leading financial institutions, you've come to the right place.
  
  
As a Director of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within Corporate Technology, you lead multiple technical areas, manage the activities of multiple teams, and collaborate across technical domains. Your expertise is applied cross-functionally to drive the adoption and implementation of technical methods within various teams and aid the firm in remaining at the forefront of industry trends, best practices, and technological advances.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Owns the end-to-end technology strategy, roadmap and target architecture, aligning business priorities, regulatory requirements and broader firm technology strategy.
* Builds trusted relationships with senior Risk, Business, Data and Technology stakeholders and represent Technology in senior governance, planning and investment discussions.
* Takes accountability for delivery across the portfolio, establishing clear outcomes, ownership, milestones and success measures while balancing strategic transformation with critical business and regulatory commitments.
* Drives adoption of strategic platforms and modern engineering practices, while reducing legacy complexity, manual processes and technical debt.
* Ensures technology solutions meet high standards for controls, security, operational resilience, production readiness and regulatory compliance.
* Builds, lead and develop a high-performing technology organisation, creating clear accountability and empowering leaders with end-to-end ownership.
* Leads significant modernisation and automation initiatives across applications, data, workflows and risk processes, including the appropriate use of cloud, data and AI capabilities.
* Manages competing priorities, capacity and investment decisions, ensuring technology spend is connected to measurable business outcomes.

**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**

* Must have a total of 18+ years experience and strong in people management, stakeholder management and technical leadership
* 15+ years applied experience in large scale data processing, using micro services, API design, Kafka, Redis, MemCached, Observability (Dynatrace , Splunk, Grafana or similar), Orchestration (Airflow, Temporal)
* Significant experience leading a large or complex technology portfolio within financial services, ideally within Risk, Finance or another highly regulated domain
* Advanced working knowledge of databases, data lake architectures, data mesh concepts, and data governance
* Practical experience with cloud-native data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Advanced knowledge of software application development and technical processes
* Ability to present and effectively communicate with senior leaders and executives
* Proven leadership at Executive Director or equivalent senior leadership level
* Sets direction and governance for agentic AI-enabled engineering and SDLC/TLM automation within a technical area to drive measurable improvements in speed, quality, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-orchestrated delivery workflows, release readiness controls, automated test modernisation, and incident triage acceleration), while establishing guardrails for validation, security, resiliency, traceability, and reuse across teams
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorised AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realised by automation and support capacity unlock initiatives at scale

**ABOUT US**

jobs.title: Treasury  Programme Manager
jobs.description:
**Director, Treasury Program Management**

**Shift Timing : 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM**

**Location- India – Bangalore**

**Job Summary**

- We are seeking a Director, Treasury Program Management, to lead large treasury programs across the global organization.

- This role drives execution across treasury systems, bank connectivity, payments modernization, settlement workflows, controls, reporting, exception-based processing, automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, and process improvement.

- The Director will lead programs across payments, capital markets, middle office workflows, credit facility administration, loan seasoning, investing, management reporting, and forecasting.

**What You’ll Do**

Program Delivery & Governance

- Lead treasury programs end-to-end: Manage planning, execution, implementation, adoption, and post-go-live stabilization while overseeing milestones, risks, dependencies, governance, and issue management.

- Own program delivery & governance: Maintain program plans, stakeholder updates, and reporting while translating business objectives into workstreams, requirements, testing plans, controls, and implementation roadmaps.

- Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders: Partner with Treasury, Capital Markets, Middle Office, Finance, Accounting, Operations, Technology, banks, vendors, and service providers.

- Drive automation & exception-based processing: Reduce manual effort, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and expand automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, and operational transparency.

- Improve payments, settlements & bank connectivity: Enhance payment initiation, approval workflows, settlement instructions, reconciliations, and bank connectivity including SWIFT and ISO 20022.

- Standardize treasury payment workflows: Streamline processes across regions, funds, entities, currencies, and banking partners while reducing breaks and manual intervention.

**What You’ll Bring**

Required Experience

**- 15+ years of experience in treasury, treasury operations, middle office, capital markets operations, finance transformation, program management, or related financial services roles.**

**- Experience leading large treasury, finance, or operations programs across multiple stakeholders.**

**- Strong understanding of payments, settlements, bank connectivity, controls, reporting, treasury workflows, and operational risk.**

**- Experience with requirements gathering, process design, testing, implementation, and change management.**

**Must-Have Technical / Tools Criteria**

**- Must-have technical skills for this role include reporting, visualization, workflow, automation, and testing capabilities across the treasury ecosystem, including automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, SWIFT payment format testing automation, and treasury platform testing automation.**

**- Hands-on experience using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Sigma, Alteryx, SQL, Python, workflow tools, test automation frameworks, or low-code automation platforms to support treasury process improvement, reporting, and automation, with examples including Power Automate, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, KNIME, dbt, Apache Airflow, pytest, Robot Framework, and Selenium-based testing approaches.**

- Strong proficiency building dashboards, operational KPI views, variance analysis, issue trackers, reconciliations, and executive reporting materials.

**- Ability to define dashboard requirements, data models, business rules, workflow metrics, and reporting packs that support treasury oversight and exception-based processing.**

- Experience working with large data sets, control evidence, exception reports, process flows, testing evidence, and controls documentation.

**- Must have experience supporting or driving automation for SWIFT payment format testing, including payment message validation, formatting rule checks, bank-specific requirements, and regression testing across bank connectivity and treasury payment workflows.**

- Must have experience coordinating or executing automated testing across the treasury ecosystem, including payments, settlements, reporting, controls, interfaces, and related system integrations.

- Strong familiarity with SIT, UAT, regression testing, parallel runs, defect triage, test evidence management, and implementation readiness.

**- Ability to partner effectively with Technology teams, data teams, and operations stakeholders without being a pure technology role.**

- Exposure to AI-enabled automation or agentic workflow capabilities in treasury, finance, or operations is a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**- Experience in asset management, private equity, banking, capital markets, fintech, treasury operations, or global capability centers.**

**- Exposure to Treasury Management Systems, payment platforms, banking portals, ERP tools, reporting platforms, or workflow tools.**

**- Familiarity with SWIFT messaging, ISO 20022, bank connectivity, settlement processes, and treasury controls.**

**- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.**

**- CTP, PMP, CPA, CFA, or process improvement certification preferred.**

jobs.title: EPM (Enterprise Performance Management) - Director
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an EPM Director you will lead Oracle Enterprise Performance Management client work, shaping budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, and reporting solutions that help organizations improve financial planning and analysis processes. As a Director you will set strategic direction, guide business development efforts, oversee multiple work streams, and inspire teams while upholding quality, integrity, inclusion, and a commercial mindset within our Technology Consulting practice. In this role at PwC, you will assess client needs, design and implement Oracle-based solutions, provide training and support, and use your leadership to cultivate opportunities for growth across engagements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leading Oracle enterprise performance management client engagements from strategy through implementation and ongoing support
* Shaping budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and reporting solutions that align finance processes with business objectives
* Driving business development efforts by identifying client needs, defining solution approaches, and advancing growth opportunities
* Overseeing multiple project workstreams, resource allocation, timelines, and delivery milestones across complex engagements
* Developing executive-level client relationships and advising finance leaders on performance management priorities and transformation paths
* Translating business process requirements into Oracle-based designs, configuration decisions, and integration approaches
* Guiding teams in financial planning and analysis, operational performance management, and reporting optimization
* Applying analytical thinking to evaluate current-state processes, diagnose gaps, and develop practical improvement recommendations
* Mentoring emerging leaders and promoting a collaborative environment that supports professional growth and knowledge sharing
* Validating compliance with professional standards, independence requirements, and firm policies across client delivery activities

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 17+ years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Accounting & Finance, Finance, Management Information Systems, Economics, Business Administration/Management
* At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Enterprise Performance Management or related Oracle EPM Cloud applications
* Demonstrating Oracle EPM Cloud delivery across planning and reporting
* Leading client-facing finance transformation and executive discussions
* Developing market-facing ideas for performance management solutions
* Translating financial data into actionable business insights
* Mentoring teams while balancing multiple client priorities

Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Lead multi-tower Oracle Cloud ERP & EPM programs end-to-end — from mobilization through stabilization.
* Establish program governance, delivery frameworks, and reporting cadence with PwC Global Engagement teams (Onshore teams).
* Ensure on-time, on-budget delivery with measurable quality and business outcomes.
* Drive delivery predictability using PwC methodologies, accelerators, and delivery standards.

Client & Engagement Management
  
  

* Partner with US and other regional engagement teams and client stakeholders to shape and deliver Oracle Cloud transformation roadmaps.
* Serve as escalation and quality assurance lead for offshore delivery, ensuring seamless client experience.
* Support business development through pre-sales, estimation, orals, and client presentations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with global counterparts and client stakeholders to ensure a seamless and high-quality client experience.

Solution Architecture & Process Excellence
  
  

* Architect, design and review complex end to end solutions across Oracle Cloud EPM (Planning, Consolidation, Allocation, Account Reconciliation, Master Data management & Reporting Analytics).
* Drive business process re-engineering efforts by leveraging out-of-the-box Oracle functionalities to minimize customizations and maximize value.
* Leverage PwC accelerators, automation, and analytics to enhance delivery speed and value realization.
* Promote innovation in delivery through automation, GenAI, and advanced analytics adoption to enhance delivery speed and client value realization.

People & Practice Leadership
  
  

* Build, coach, mentor and grow large multidisciplinary Oracle teams within the AC.
* Drive practice-wide goals for utilization, capability development, and professional certifications across both functional and technical tracks.
* Lead internal practice initiatives, including the creation of reusable assets, accelerators, thought leadership, and the industrialization of delivery processes.
* Foster a culture of inclusion, care, collaboration, high performance, and continuous learning.

Operational & Financial Excellence
  
  

* Identify and deploy resources to projects; ensure consistent day-to-day engagement and productivity.
* Forecast demand, manage delivery capacity, and enable efficiency through a balanced onshore–offshore model.
* Ensure strict adherence to the firm’s quality standards, risk management protocols, and compliance requirements.

**Process Transformation & Innovation**

* Architect scalable operating models that support business growth while reducing complexity & operational risk
* Champion automation & digital transformation leveraging RPA, AI/ML, and intelligent workflow solutions
* Establish PPE governance frameworks with clear ownership, controls, & performance metrics
* Drive standardisation & harmonisation of processes across regions & business units

**Operational Excellence & Quality Management**

* Support audit readiness through robust documentation, testing protocols, & evidence management
* Drive remediation of audit findings & regulatory observations with sustainable solutions

**Governance**

* Reports directly to Head of Operational Excellence who drives the Strategy, operating model changes & strategic initiatives across GPLs.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* GCFO COO MT
* Relevant GPL
* PPE Team
* Global Op Ex team
* ARIS GPT
* SAP Signavio
* ProHance team
* Relevant Technology teams
* Infrastructure & Security Teams

* Expert in process mapping, analysis, and redesign using tools like ARIS, Signavio, or Celonis
* Proficient in data analytics and visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx)
* Strong knowledge of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) and finance technology ecosystem
* Experience with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid approaches)
* Advanced Excel and data manipulation capabilities for complex analysis

****Qualifications****
**Education**

* MBA, Master's in Finance, or equivalent advanced degree
* 12-15+ years in finance operations, with 5+ years leading operational excellence or transformation programs
* Proven track record delivering large-scale process transformation in banking or financial services

**Training**

* Deep domain expertise across multiple finance functions (Accounting, Financial Reporting, FP&A, Treasury, Tax)
* Hands-on experience with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping)
* Demonstrated success implementing automation solutions (RPA, workflow tools, AI-enabled platforms)
* Strong understanding of regulatory environment and compliance requirements in banking

**Licenses**

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification required; Master Black Belt preferred

**Certifications**

* Professional certifications (CA, CPA, CFA, CIMA, or equivalent) highly valued

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
****What We Offer****

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.
