We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. . You can also explore

**About the Role**

We are looking for a senior technology leader to lead Zeta’s digital transformation across its Enterprise Applications, Software Solutions, Integration, AI, IT Infrastructure, and Operations landscape.

The primary charter is to connect and optimize the existing technology ecosystem — integrating SaaS, on-premise, cloud, legacy, and internally developed applications; building bridge systems and software solutions where required; and selectively applying AI and automation to improve workflows, data movement, operational efficiency, and user experience.

* Identify gaps between existing platforms and oversee the development of bridge applications, middleware, APIs, and integration services to connect disparate systems.

**AI & Intelligent Automation**

**IT Infrastructure Strategy & Operations**

* Provide strategic and operational oversight of the organization's IT infrastructure, including networks, endpoints, cloud services, collaboration platforms, Microsoft 365, identity, and core technology platforms.
* Ensure infrastructure is scalable, resilient, secure, and capable of supporting the organization's application and digital transformation roadmap.
* Partner with infrastructure and engineering teams to design and maintain reliable application and infrastructure environments.
* Oversee infrastructure modernization, cloud adoption, capacity planning, lifecycle management, and technology resilience.
* Ensure infrastructure architecture supports the organization's integration, software, data, and AI initiatives.

**IT Operations, Service Management & Reliability**

The Associate Director will help manage inbound and outbound client risks, produce senior-ready MI and insights, and support the ISAE reporting programme (e.g., ISAE 3402 / relevant assurance reporting).
* A core element of the role is building a modern, data-led risk insight capability—leveraging analytics and AI-enabled approaches (where appropriate) to improve early warning, trend detection, MI automation and control/evidence readiness, with suitable governance and sustainable BAU controls.
* Client Risk Management (Inbound & Outbound) – Post-Sales Servicing Focus; Support the framework to manage inbound client risks, including: client queries, escalations and service disruptions impacting clients; breaches, complaints, operational errors and remediation actions; identification of recurring issues, themes and root causes; governance of client commitments and tracking to closure
* Support the framework to manage outbound client risks, including: governance of client communications/notifications where risk is material (e.g., incidents, key disclosures, change notifications); ensuring agreed approvals, documentation and record-keeping standards are met; tracking and coordinating responses to client-driven assurance requests
* Help embed consistent playbooks for post-sales servicing risks (triage, severity assessment, escalation triggers, communications governance, decisioning and risk acceptance where appropriate).

* Improve MI quality, efficiency and timeliness through trend, outlier and segmentation analytics, actionable insights, standardised dashboards, automated reporting and data controls covering reconciliation, lineage, definitions and ownership; apply AI where appropriate to identify emerging risks through clustering/common-cause analysis, automate packs and commentary with human review and approval, and index/retrieve assurance evidence, supported by documentation, testing, access controls, monitoring and applicable governance.
* Support the end-to-end ISAE reporting lifecycle through audit-ready evidence and documentation, stakeholder input and audit-query coordination, and findings/remediation tracking to closure; use outcomes to prevent repeat observations and improve control clarity, evidence quality and client confidence.
* Support product and client risk management through Risk & Control Assessments (RCA) of client-facing servicing processes and obligations, incident/issue triage, escalation, remediation tracking and lessons learned, client-impact and conduct reviews, and risk appetite monitoring of service stability, issue ageing and communication timeliness/quality.
* Drive continuous process and control improvement through control rationalisation, simplification and standardisation, governance/MI automation, stronger action tracking and shorter identification-to-remediation-to-closure cycles; partner with operations/change teams to embed improvements into BAU with clear ownership and measurable benefits.
* GCB3 SSv NFR Governance & Client Risks Lead (direct manager); SSv Client Coverage/Relationship Management, Product, Operations, Change/Transformation and Control Owners; 2LoD Risk and Compliance (as required); Internal Audit/external assurance (ISAE coordination).

:

**Job Summary**
---------------

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
  
• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**  
• Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  
• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**  
• **Analytics:** Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.

* **Strategy:** Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.

* **Framework & Governance:** Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits. Lead regulatory submissions and challenge returns, oversee MAT and risk appetite reviews, maintain IRRBB policies, support disclosures and audits, escalate emerging topics and drive regulatory engagement and interpretation.

* **Modelling & Methodology** : Apply and maintain IRRBB models per regulatory requirements, including PTR and CASA assumptions. Review and update IRRBB and structural hedging policies, maintain standards, and perform annual forecasts of NII, EBE, and P2A. Conduct policy effectiveness, self-assessment, gap and impact analyses, harmonize models with group, and run simulations and scenario analyses to support regulatory and corporate planning.

* **Structural Hedging:** Support the structural hedging in planning, executing, and monitoring hedges, including P&L sign-off and capacity management. Support group IRBB hedging programs, assess available instruments, forecast and quantify hedge requirements, run analytics and simulations, and provide MI for GALCO discussions to drive informed hedging decisions.

* **Stress Testing:** Support IRRBB stress testing including ICAAP and Pillar 2 assessments, NMD parameter stress, country/cluster ICAP, and reverse stress testing. Conduct basis risk evaluations, Pillar 2 charge reviews, and prepare Pillar 3 disclosures. Support IRBB-related GIA and audit reviews, ensuring all stress testing aligns with ORF requirements and regulatory expectations.

* **IRRBB Technology Journey:** Support delivery of new system rollouts, enhancements and data fixes by providing requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring data accuracy. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes efficiently, maintain alignment with IRRBB policy and reporting standards, and drive continuous improvement of systems and processes.

**People & Talent**  
• Be part of a diverse team of skilled and experienced professionals in India.
  
• Collaborate within Treasury and with key partners in Finance, CPM, Technology, and Change in India and the clusters.
  
• Lead by example in reinforcing the appropriate culture and values of the function.
  
• Contribute to ongoing training and development of team members.

**Risk Management**  
• Oversee enterprise-wide interest rate risk in the banking book ensuring alignment with risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Monitor, measure and manage exposures, set limits, and perform scenario analysis and stress testing. Maintain robust frameworks, policies and governance, validate models, provide insights for strategic planning and support senior management, GALCO/ALCO and regulators on risk mitigation, reporting and capital optimisation.

**Governance**  
• Assess the effectiveness arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the IRRBB frameworks and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas
  
• Understand the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Professionals in M&A group offer both advisory and deployment services that provide clients with comprehensive solutions to help them better manage the critical business functions.

We accomplish this mission through continued development of people in our Strategy, Risk and Transactions - M&A: Deal Transformation and Post Merger Integration

**Organization readiness in a post deal integration:**

**Carve-out and separation:**

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer - India
jobs.description:
**Location & work modality: India , Mumbai**

**About Submer**  
  
**At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.**

**Your impact**

Submer India is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead and build the Finance function in India. This is a growth- and investment-oriented role with particular responsibility for capital strategy, fundraising and the financial architecture supporting enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion.

The CFO will own the India capital agenda within approved mandates, working with India and Group leadership to secure financing and lead transactions through financial closure. The role requires an accomplished senior finance leader with demonstrated CFO-level responsibility and a proven record of personally leading and closing capital-raising transactions, preferably within technology, infrastructure, digital infrastructure, datacentres, engineering, energy or other high-growth and capital-intensive businesses.

The successful candidate will combine capital-raising capability with strong financial stewardship, governance and compliance. The CFO must understand the complete business lifecycle, from establishment and capitalisation through growth, scaling, restructuring and potential strategic transactions and/or potential exit, and be able to operate in an entrepreneurial technology and infrastructure environment.

**What you'll do**

**1. Strategic Financial Leadership**
=====================================

* Act as a key member of the India leadership team and provide strategic financial leadership to support Submer's growth and long-term enterprise value.
* Develop and execute the financial and capital strategy for the India business, linking enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion to appropriate sources of funding.
* Partner with business and operational leadership on investments, expansion plans and commercial opportunities, providing financial insight, strategic decisions and constructive challenge.
* Build scalable financial structures, processes, controls and planning capabilities suitable for a high growth organisation
* Build long term business planning and value creation.

**2. Investment, Fundraising and Capital Raising**
==================================================

* Lead the development and execution of capital-raising strategies for Submer's India business and strategic initiatives, aligned with approved plans and funding mandates.
* Build and maintain relationships with institutional, private equity, venture capital, infrastructure and strategic investors/partners, banks, financial institutions and structured-finance providers, as relevant.
* Lead India investor and lender engagement, financial presentations and, 'fund-sourcing to fund-raising to investment' plans and subsequent discussions; *(coordinate with Group finance and support Group-led transactions under the agreed mandate.)*
* Distinguish corporate capital for enterprise growth, including growth equity, strategic investment and corporate debt, from project or asset capital, including JV/SPV equity, infrastructure debt, construction finance and project finance.
* Develop financial models, investment cases and business plans; evaluate funding structures, financing costs, dilution, security requirements and investment returns.
* Lead financial due diligence readiness, strategic investment, financial structuring and financing negotiations through financial closure, coordinating legal, tax, business and technical inputs and obtaining required approvals.
* Agree capital-raising milestones with leadership and report on funding secured, transaction progress, financing terms and deployment of proceeds; maintain appropriate investor and lender reporting.

**3. Business Lifecycle and Growth Strategy**
=============================================

Guide the business through its financial lifecycle and ensure that funding structures and financial capabilities evolve with its stage of development. This includes:

* Business establishment, entity structuring, financial planning and initial capitalisation.
* Early-stage growth, scaling, fundraising and infrastructure or project expansion.
* Financial governance, commercial growth, profitability and long-term value creation.
* Mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, restructuring and business transformation.
* Transaction readiness and potential exit planning.

Align corporate growth capital, project or asset financing and subsequent refinancing or strategic transactions with business needs, risk appetite and approved return objectives.

**4. Financial Planning, Analysis and Performance Management**
==============================================================

* Lead annual budgeting, long-term financial planning, forecasts and scenario modelling.
* Monitor financial and operational performance against approved plans
* Analyze profitability, cash flow, capital requirements and investment returns.
* Track business and project performance against approved investment cases, identify variances and recommend corrective action.
* Develop management reports and financial dashboards for senior leadership, identifying risks and opportunities and enabling informed decisions.

**5. Corporate Finance and Strategic Transactions**
===================================================

* Evaluate investment and strategic opportunities through valuation, financial analysis and assessment of returns and risks.
* Lead financial due diligence and financial transaction structuring for India-led transactions; *(support Group-led transactions within the agreed mandate.)*
* Structure and financially govern joint ventures and special purpose vehicles (JVs/SPVs), including shareholder funding, debt/equity arrangements, inter-company transactions and project returns.
* Develop and oversee cash waterfalls, distributions, dividend or repatriation arrangements and investor reporting in accordance with approved agreements and applicable requirements.
* Contribute to mergers, acquisitions and strategic partnerships, working with legal, tax, banking and external advisory partners
* Support exit readiness and strategic transaction planning.

**6. Finance Operations, Governance and Compliance**
====================================================

* Establish and maintain robust financial controls, policies and governance, including oversight of capital deployment and entity-level reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian accounting, taxation, corporate and regulatory requirements
* Oversee financial, accounting and statutory compliance reporting.
* Ensure timely and accurate financial management and statutory filings.
* Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors and external consultants; *(coordinating with Group finance as appropriate.)*
* Identify and mitigate financial and business risks, including financing covenant compliance and related-party exposures.

**7. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management**
===============================================

* Lead cash flow, liquidity and working capital planning and management.
* Align liquidity and financing requirements with business growth, capital expenditure and project or JV/SPV funding commitments.
* Manage banking relationships and financing facilities
* Monitor funding availability, drawdown conditions and covenant headroom.
* Monitor capital expenditure and investment commitments and optimise the use of capital across approved business, for infrastructure- and project-based requirements.

**8. Technology and Infrastructure Business Understanding**

**We're Hiring | Head of People Transformation & Enterprise Process Excellence**

**Role Purpose**

The Head of People Transformation & Enterprise Process Excellence will establish and lead a scalable, business-focused approach to transformation, process management and continuous improvement across a growing international organisation.

Reporting directly to the Chief People Officer (CPO) and operating as a senior member of the Human Resources leadership team, the Head will initially focus on transforming HR processes and the end-to-end employee experience. The role will establish the HR process architecture, assess current practices, design future-state processes, clarify process ownership and decision rights, and introduce meaningful KPIs, SLAs and governance frameworks.

The Chief People Officer retains accountability for the HR strategy, HR operating model and HR organisational structure. The Head will provide process-based insight to inform operating-model decisions and translate the agreed model into end-to-end processes, governance, roles, controls, measures and implementation plans.

The Head will also establish an enterprise process-excellence framework and practical methodology that can be adopted by other business functions. Working across organisational and geographic boundaries, the role will enable leaders and process owners to improve the performance, consistency, control and experience of their processes while retaining accountability within the relevant function.

The position combines strategic design with hands-on transformation delivery. It will ensure that organisational processes support continued international growth while reinforcing culture, values, regulatory obligations and commitment to fair, inclusive and high-quality employee experiences.

The role may commence as an individual contributor during the initial diagnostic and mobilisation period. Delivery of the broader enterprise mandate will require the timely establishment of a dedicated People Transformation and Enterprise Process Excellence team, supported by nominated process owners, subject-matter experts and enabling functions. The Head will define the required capability and phased resourcing model with the Chief People Officer. Scope, sequencing and delivery commitments will remain aligned with approved capacity and resources.

**Key Accountabilities**

1. Transformation Strategy & Leadership

* Partner with the Chief People Officer to define and deliver the People Transformation and Enterprise Process Excellence strategy.
* Translate business and growth priorities into a practical, prioritised and measurable transformation roadmap.
* Act as a trusted adviser to senior leadership on process, governance, transformation and organisational-effectiveness matters.
* Build senior stakeholder alignment around transformation priorities and develop evidence-based recommendations and business cases.
* Establish governance for transformation initiatives, including decision forums, escalation paths, risk management and benefits tracking.
* Provide transparent reporting on progress, outcomes and key decisions.

2. Alignment with the HR Operating Model

* Clarify responsibilities through accountability frameworks and RACI models.
* Define effective process interfaces between HR, leaders, employees and enabling functions such as Finance, Technology, Compliance, Legal, Risk and Operations.
* Support the implementation of approved operating-model changes.

* Establish a Group-wide HR process architecture covering the complete employee lifecycle.
* Lead discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, maturity assessments and diagnostic reviews.
* Conduct gap analyses and identify inefficiencies, duplication, unclear ownership and control weaknesses.
* Design scalable, employee-focused and measurable future-state processes.
* Ensure processes are considered end-to-end, including workflows, systems, controls, decision points and employee touchpoints.
* Translate future-state designs into policies, procedures, controls, templates and implementation actions.
* Prioritise transformation initiatives according to business value, risk, employee impact and implementation feasibility.

Indicative HR Process Portfolio

Subject to agreed priorities, the portfolio may include:

* Position creation and requisition approval
* End-to-end recruitment and hiring
* Onboarding
* Performance management
* Learning, development and talent management
* Compensation, promotion, recognition and internal mobility
* Employee engagement
* Leave administration
* Offboarding, exit management and knowledge transfer

4. Process Governance, Documentation & Ownership

* Establish standards for process design, documentation, approval, ownership and change control.
* Create and maintain an accessible process repository.
* Establish regular process review and assurance cycles.
* Coordinate risk-based process health checks and conformance reviews.
* Partner with Internal Audit, Risk and Compliance functions to ensure appropriate control frameworks are embedded.
* Balance standardisation with local regulatory requirements.

5. Performance Excellence, KPIs & Service Levels

* Define KPIs, SLAs, targets, ownership and reporting frameworks.
* Introduce process-performance dashboards and review cadences.
* Use data and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain a continuous-improvement pipeline and benefits tracking methodology.
* Ensure measures drive end-to-end performance and employee experience.

6. Culture, Engagement, Equity & Inclusion

* Embed organisational values and leadership behaviours into people processes.
* Ensure fair, transparent and inclusive decision-making practices.
* Review people processes for potential barriers, bias and inconsistent application.
* Translate employee feedback into practical process and organisational improvements.
* Partner with HR leadership to strengthen accountability for employee experience outcomes.

7. Enterprise Process Excellence Capability

* Establish a practical enterprise process-excellence framework and methodology.
* Support business functions in defining process ownership, governance, KPIs and improvement priorities.
* Facilitate cross-functional transformation initiatives.
* Coach leaders and process owners on process management and continuous improvement.
* Develop a community of process owners and champions.
* Maintain clear accountability within business functions while providing specialist process expertise.

8. Technology, Data & Automation Enablement

* Assess current process-management, workflow and collaboration tools.
* Establish interim process-repository and governance solutions where required.
* Define business requirements for scalable BPM and process-management capabilities.
* Evaluate existing platforms and recommend fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to implement appropriate tools and workflows.
* Identify automation opportunities and improve data quality.
* Ensure technology decisions are driven by future-state process requirements and user needs.

9. Implementation, Adoption & Capability Building

* Translate approved designs into implementation plans with clear milestones and ownership.
* Develop communication, training and change-adoption strategies.
* Monitor adoption and address implementation challenges.
* Build internal process-management and continuous-improvement capability.

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

* Drive governance, delivery strategy, program execution, dependency management, and risk mitigation across complex multi-workstream initiatives.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, Information Security, Risk, and Commercial teams to ensure successful delivery against client commitments.
* Establish executive steering committees and governance forums, providing clear visibility into program progress, milestones, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.
* Navigate complex organizational environments to align stakeholders, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain momentum across large-scale transformation programs.
* Champion implementation excellence while ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, and accelerated time-to-value.
* Support clients through change management, platform adoption, and operational readiness as they transition onto Pismo's cloud-native infrastructure.
* Capture lessons learned and implementation best practices to continuously strengthen Visa and Pismo's delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

  

* Over 15 years of experience in technology-driven financial services, with a strong focus on leading large-scale implementation and transformation projects for global fintech's and banks.
* Detailed technical knowledge of payments ecosystem in GCC countries, more specifically implementation and certification of Jaywan and AEP Switch in UAE
* Technical knowledge of payments and banking platforms operating in the cloud in a microservice architecture, with REST/JSON API’s and data streaming.
* Educational background in solutions architecture and software engineering. Cloud certifications are a plus.
* Having completed a core banking, payments transformation implementation from contract signature to production live.
* Expertise in building and scaling high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style that emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, and a culture of accountability.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-market projects on time and within scope, leveraging advanced project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, and hybrid models) and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
* Recognized for forging strong, trust-based relationships with C-level executives, clients, and cross-functional partners, ensuring alignment and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Adept at translating business strategy into actionable plans, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision-making and KPI management.
* Russian speaker is highly desirable

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

jobs.title: GCC Sales Leader
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
  
  
*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**About The Role**
We are looking for an accomplished
**GCC Sales Leader**
to drive strategic account growth and customer success across Fortune 500 organizations and Global Capability Centers (GCCs).
  
  
This is a high-impact sales leadership role for someone who understands the GCC ecosystem, can build trusted relationships with senior enterprise stakeholders, and has a proven track record of selling
**Data, Analytics, AI and digital transformation solutions**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a self-starter who combines strategic account management with strong commercial acumen. You should be comfortable identifying new opportunities within large enterprises, shaping solutions with internal capability teams, driving complex sales cycles, and building long-term account growth strategies.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own and drive growth strategy for strategic GCC and Fortune 500 accounts, with a strong focus on revenue expansion and customer success.
* Develop and execute account strategies to identify new business, cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing and prospective accounts.
* Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers across client organizations.
* Identify client business priorities and position relevant Data, Analytics, AI and transformation solutions to address them.
* Drive complex enterprise sales opportunities from identification and solutioning through commercial discussions and closure.
* Partner closely with Fractal's business, capability, delivery and strategy teams to develop compelling solutions for clients.
* Evaluate account growth potential and build clear roadmaps for expanding Fractal's footprint across strategic client organizations.
* Influence client and internal senior leadership through new ideas, solutions and strategic recommendations.
* Provide strategic direction and coordination to Program Directors as accounts scale.
* Initiate and drive strategic programs and new go-to-market opportunities with a strong focus on execution and change leadership.
* Maintain strong commercial discipline across accounts while creating sustainable, long-term client partnerships.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 10+ years of experience in enterprise sales, business development, strategic account management or client-partner roles.
* Proven experience selling Data, Analytics, AI, Data Science, Big Data or related digital transformation solutions to large enterprises.
* Strong exposure to the Global Capability Center (GCC) ecosystem, preferably with experience working with or selling into Fortune 500 organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to drive account growth, revenue expansion, cross-selling and new opportunity creation.
* Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles and engaging multiple stakeholders across business and technology functions.
* Strong ability to engage and influence CXO and senior leadership stakeholders.
* Ability to translate client business challenges into compelling technology and transformation opportunities.
* Strong consultative selling, negotiation, communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across sales, consulting, capability, delivery and leadership teams.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate independently, create opportunities and drive initiatives from concept to execution.

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience in Analytics, Data Science, AI/ML, Big Data, Cloud/Data Transformation or Digital Transformation.
* Experience managing and expanding large strategic enterprise or GCC accounts.
* Demonstrated success in creating and closing complex, high-value transformation opportunities.
* Existing relationships within the Indian GCC ecosystem would be an advantage.

What We Look For
  
  
We are looking for a
**commercially driven, consultative and entrepreneurial sales leader**
who can navigate complex enterprise environments, build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, identify opportunities others may miss, and bring together the right capabilities to create meaningful business impact for our clients.
  
  
If you have built and grown strategic GCC relationships and are passionate about helping global enterprises unlock value through
**Data and AI**
, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
  
  
Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking
*Introduce Yourself*
in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

jobs.title: Value Stream Leader - Connectivity & Systems
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**    

Job Description At Schneider Electric, the Installed Base (IB) Data organization ensures Installed Base data is accurate, trusted, and actionable to drive business growth, customer value, and digital transformation. Within the Installed Base Domain organization, we are looking for a Value Stream Leader - Connectivity Systems to define and drive the strategic vision, roadmap, and execution of the Connectivity Systems value stream. This role plays a critical leadership position in connecting business objectives, digital capabilities, product connectivity, and data management to provide end-to-end visibility of the Installed Base lifecycle. As the leader of the Connectivity Systems value stream, you will collaborate across Lines of Business, Digital teams, Services LoB, and Data organizations to ensure the connectivity status and lifecycle of products and systems are accurately tracked, governed, and leveraged to create business value. The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, digital and data expertise, strategic leadership, and program management capabilities to align stakeholders around a common vision and successfully deliver transformational initiatives.

  
   
  **Responsibilities**    

* Connectivity Strategy Vision: Define and drive the global strategy for tracking product and system connectivity status across all Lines of Business and divisions. Establish and maintain end-to-end visibility of the Installed Base from manufacturing through customer deployment and operation. Ensure connectivity data becomes a trusted business asset supporting customer value creation, service excellence, and digital growth initiatives.
* Systems Lifecycle Management: Establish a comprehensive framework for tracking systems throughout their entire lifecycle from a customer-centric perspective. Define business capabilities, data requirements, and governance needed to support visibility and lifecycle management across connected products and systems. Partner with business and digital stakeholders to identify opportunities for lifecycle optimization and enhanced customer experience.
* Value Stream Ownership: Collaborate closely with Domain Experts, Data Architects, Enterprise Architects, and Digital teams to define target-state processes, data models, and integration requirements. Ensure alignment between business priorities, architecture strategies, and technology investments.
* Business Requirements Solution Delivery: Lead definition and prioritization of business requirements for Connectivity Systems initiatives. Partner with Data Experts, Data Architects, E2E Business Architects, and IB Digital teams to translate business needs into actionable delivery plans. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and deployment activities in collaboration with Project Managers, Deployment Teams, and Delivery Leaders. Ensure solutions deliver measurable business value and meet stakeholder expectations.
* Strategic Roadmap Management: Co-create and maintain the annual Connectivity Systems roadmap in alignment with business objectives and digital transformation priorities. Balance short-term business needs with long-term strategic goals and architecture direction. Monitor emerging technologies, connectivity trends, and digital capabilities to continuously evolve the roadmap.
* Value Stream Governance Execution: Lead monthly value stream operating reviews and governance forums. Drive execution transparency through KPI tracking, risk management, dependency management, and stakeholder communication. Facilitate cross-functional decision-making and remove obstacles to delivery. Ensure initiatives are delivered according to agreed priorities, timelines, and expected outcomes.

  
   
  **Key Skills Experience**    

* Domain Expertise: Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least two of the following three domains: Product Domain; Tools Data Domain; Services Domain.
* Product Domain: Deep understanding of Schneider Electric product portfolios, connected products, software ecosystems, and digital offerings. Experience with connectivity technologies, Edge-to-Cloud architectures and software centric design.
* Tools Data Domain: Solid understanding of enterprise systems and digital platforms supporting the Installed Base ecosystem (ERP, M2C, DATE, bFS, ALM, SDH, IB360, and related systems). Strong knowledge of data architecture, data governance, system integration, and business data flows.
* Services Domain: Strong understanding of Installed Base management, service delivery processes, and customer lifecycle management. Knowledge of how connectivity and digital services create value throughout the customer journey.

  
   
  **Core Competencies**    

* Strategic Leadership
* Program Portfolio Management
* Business Digital Acumen
* Stakeholder Management Communication
* Problem Solving Decision Making

  
  
Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

jobs.title: Solution Advisor
jobs.description:
**Solution Advisor – Bluecopa**

**Wanted: a finance whisperer who can turn spreadsheets into stories 📊**

Somewhere right now, a CFO is staring at 14 ERPs, 60 entities, and a month-end close that eats two weeks of everyone's life. They don't need another software demo. They need someone who gets it: someone who can say "intercompany eliminations" without flinching, sketch the fix on a whiteboard, and leave the room with the CFO nodding.

That someone could be you.

**Team**
: Solution Advisory

**Company**
: Bluecopa

**Travel**
: Yes, and you'll like it ✈️

**Who We Are**

**Bluecopa**
builds AI-powered finance operations software for global enterprises, the ones with many entities, many systems, and many reasons the numbers don't tie out on the first try. We help finance teams automate reconciliations, close, cash application, and the messy work in between.

The Solution Advisory team is where problems meet possibilities. We sit between the prospect's pain and Bluecopa's platform, and we own the story that connects them, working side by side with sales, product, and partners like the Big 4 and Global System Integrators.

**What You'll Do:**

Own the Story from "Hello" to "Signed"

You run the full solutioning cycle. Not a slice of it. All of it.

* Discovery: Ask the questions nobody else asked. Map the entities, ERPs, hidden spreadsheets, and the people who keep it all running.
* Problem framing: Turn "our close is painful" into a crisp problem statement with numbers: days lost, manual touches, risk exposure.
* Deep dive: Get into the weeds of R2R, intercompany, reconciliations, accruals, and cash application until you know it better than the slide deck does.
* Solution design: Work out exactly where Bluecopa fits, and be honest about where it doesn't.
* Demo & storytelling: Build demos that look like their world, not a generic sandbox.
* Scoping: Define what's in, what's out, the phases, and the success measures.
* Proposals: Write proposals a controller can read on a Friday evening and still understand.
* Everything in between: Follow-ups, objection handling, partner syncs, and the "one more question" emails that close deals.

**Who You'll Be Talking To**

Finance leaders at large, multi-entity, multi-system global enterprises. Sharp, busy, and allergic to fluff.

* CFOs: care about speed, control, visibility, and ROI. They need the big picture in five minutes.
* Chief Accounting Officers: care about accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness. They need proof the controls hold up.
* Controllers: want a faster, cleaner close. They need a solution that fits how the team really works.
* VPs of Finance: want scale without adding headcount. They need a clear path from pilot to rollout.
* Partners (Deloitte, EY, PwC): focus on client outcomes and delivery. They need a credible co-solutioning partner.

**Your First 90 Days**

**Days 1–30: Soak it in**

* Learn the Bluecopa platform inside out and run your first internal demo
* Shadow live deals and partner calls
* Learn our playbooks, use cases, and the competition

**Days 31–60: Co-pilot**

* Co-lead discovery and demos with prospects
* Draft your first scoping document and proposal
* Build one reusable demo story for a key use case

**Days 61–90: Take the wheel**

* Own deals end to end, from discovery to proposal
* Work directly with partner teams on joint opportunities
* Share what you learn so the whole team gets better

**Always**

* Use AI tools to work faster: research, demo prep, proposals, analysis
* Travel to meet prospects when it moves the deal forward
* Keep CRM, notes, and handoffs clean so nothing gets lost

**You Might Be Our Person If…**

* You have
  **4–5+**
  years of experience in client-facing roles
* **You speak fluent finance**
  . Accruals, reconciliations, consolidation, intercompany, the close calendar are words you use, not words you Google
* **You've sat across from finance leaders (CFOs, controllers, finance teams)**
  and held your own
* **You know business processes**
  , not just accounting. You can trace how an order turns into cash and where it gets stuck
* **You're a storyteller**
  who makes complex problems simple
* **You persuade with substance:**
  logic, numbers, and empathy, not buzzwords
* **You're AI-curious and AI-handy**
  , always trying the next tool
* **You learn fast and ship faster.**
  New feature Monday? Demoing it by Thursday
* A messy, multi-system, 40-entity
  **problem excites you**
  more than it scares you
* **Your suitcase is half-packed.**
  You know some deals are won in person

**Nice to have:**

Finance transformation or consulting experience (Big 4 a plus), pre-sales or solution consulting for enterprise SaaS, or hands-on time with ERPs like SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite.

**What Bluecopa Gives You Back**

* **A front-row seat to enterprise finance:**
  see how global finance functions really run, and help reshape them
* **Big-league exposure:**
  work alongside Deloitte, EY, and PwC on enterprise deals
* **Real ownership:**
  your deals, your stories, your proposals, from early on
* **AI as your co-pilot:**
  access to the latest tools and freedom to experiment
* **Fast learnin**
  g: structured onboarding, live deal shadowing, and product deep dives
* **A clear growth path:**
  toward strategic accounts, partner programs, or your own solution team
* **People who care:**
  a team that celebrates wins, learns from losses, and keeps it fun

Ready to Make CFOs Say "
**Finally**
"?

👉 If you read this and thought "that's me," we'd love to hear from you.

#Hiring #SolutionConsulting #PreSales #FinanceTransformation #CFO #FinTech #SaaS #Bluecopa

jobs.title: Professor Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)
jobs.description:
**PROFESSOR COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING (CSE)**

**Specialization:** Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms & Graph Theory

**Department:** Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)  
 **Location:** Hyderabad  
 **Reporting To:** Head of the Department / Principal  
 **Position:** Professor

**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To provide academic leadership and deliver quality teaching and research in Computer Science & Engineering, with specialization in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory.

The Professor will be responsible for teaching undergraduate and postgraduate students, guiding research scholars, mentoring faculty members, promoting research and innovation, and contributing to the academic and research development of the department.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Teaching & Academic Responsibilities**

* Teach Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory to undergraduate and postgraduate engineering students.
* Prepare course plans, lecture materials, assignments, tutorials and assessment methodologies.
* Teach machine learning concepts, supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, model evaluation and predictive modelling.
* Explain data collection, preprocessing, statistical analysis, data visualization and analytical techniques.
* Teach algorithm design techniques, computational complexity, optimization and problem-solving methods.
* Explain graph structures, graph algorithms, network analysis and graph-based applications.
* Conduct laboratory sessions, programming assignments, technical demonstrations and project-based learning activities wherever applicable.
* Evaluate student performance and provide academic guidance and mentoring.
* Implement Outcome-Based Education (OBE), including Course Outcomes (COs), assessment and attainment analysis.
* Contribute to curriculum improvement and the development of effective teaching and learning practices.

**B. Research & Development**

* Conduct research in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Algorithm Design, Graph Theory and related emerging technologies.
* Publish quality research papers in reputed peer-reviewed journals and international conferences.
* Apply for funded research projects, grants and consultancy opportunities from government agencies and industry.
* Guide Ph.D. research scholars, postgraduate dissertations and undergraduate research projects, subject to university recognition and eligibility.
* Encourage interdisciplinary research, innovation, patents and industry collaboration.
* Establish research collaborations with reputed academic institutions and research organizations.
* Contribute to the development of research laboratories and departmental research activities.

**C. Academic Leadership & Departmental Responsibilities**

* Mentor junior faculty members and support their teaching, research and professional development.
* Contribute to curriculum development, academic planning and continuous improvement.
* Participate in Board of Studies, academic committees and institutional development activities.
* Coordinate workshops, seminars, conferences, technical events and Faculty Development Programmes (FDPs).
* Support NBA, NAAC, AICTE and other accreditation and quality assurance activities.
* Contribute to departmental academic administration, research planning and institutional development.
* Promote industry-academia collaboration and student skill development initiatives.

**3. REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS**

**A. Machine Learning**

* Supervised and Unsupervised Learning
* Regression, Classification and Clustering
* Feature Engineering and Feature Selection
* Neural Networks and Deep Learning Fundamentals
* Model Training, Validation, Testing and Evaluation
* Ensemble Learning Techniques
* Predictive Modelling and Performance Optimization
* Python and Machine Learning Libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch

**B. Data Analytics**

* Data Collection, Cleaning and Preprocessing
* Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
* Statistical Analysis and Hypothesis Testing
* Data Visualization and Interpretation
* Python / R Programming
* SQL and Database Management
* Data Analytics Libraries such as Pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib
* Business Intelligence Tools such as Power BI, Tableau or equivalent
* Predictive Analytics and Data-Driven Decision-Making

**C. Design and Analysis of Algorithms**

* Data Structures and Algorithm Design
* Time and Space Complexity Analysis
* Asymptotic Notations
* Sorting and Searching Algorithms
* Divide and Conquer Techniques
* Greedy Algorithms
* Dynamic Programming
* Backtracking and Branch and Bound
* Graph Algorithms
* NP-Completeness and Computational Complexity
* Algorithm Optimization and Performance Analysis

**D. Graph Theory**

* Graph Structures and Representations
* Directed and Undirected Graphs
* Graph Traversal Algorithms (BFS and DFS)
* Connectivity, Trees and Spanning Trees
* Shortest Path Algorithms
* Minimum Spanning Tree Algorithms
* Graph Coloring and Matching
* Network Flow and Graph Optimization
* Graph-Based Modelling and Network Analysis
* Applications of Graph Theory in Computer Science

**4. REQUIRED EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS**

**Undergraduate Qualification**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology or an equivalent relevant discipline.

**Postgraduate Qualification**

* M.E. / M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or an equivalent relevant discipline.

**Doctoral Qualification**

* Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Science or a relevant allied discipline.

**Preferred Teaching and Research Specializations**

* Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence
* Data Analytics and Data Science
* Design and Analysis of Algorithms
* Graph Theory and Graph Algorithms
* Computational Complexity and Optimization
* Applied Machine Learning and Predictive Analytics

*Educational qualifications and eligibility shall be subject to applicable AICTE, UGC, Osmania University and institutional recruitment norms.*

**5. EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Teaching, research and professional experience as prescribed under applicable AICTE/UGC and university norms for appointment to the position of Professor.
* Proven teaching experience in undergraduate and postgraduate Computer Science & Engineering programmes.
* Demonstrated ability to independently handle Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Design and Analysis of Algorithms, and Graph Theory.
* Experience in guiding postgraduate dissertations and Ph.D. research scholars, as permitted under university regulations.
* Strong research publication record in reputed peer-reviewed journals and conferences.
* Experience in academic leadership, curriculum development and faculty mentoring.
* Experience in funded research projects, consultancy, industry collaboration and institutional development will be preferred.

**6. REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Strong knowledge of core Computer Science & Engineering subjects.
* Expertise in Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Algorithm Design and Graph Theory.
* Strong programming and analytical skills using Python, R, SQL and relevant development tools.
* Ability to develop and demonstrate machine learning models and data analytics applications.
* Strong understanding of algorithm design, complexity analysis and graph-based problem-solving.
* Excellent teaching, communication, mentoring and academic leadership skills.
* Strong research, analytical and technical problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to guide research scholars and contribute to funded research and consultancy activities.
* Ability to independently handle all four identified subjects.
* Ability to mentor faculty members and contribute to departmental academic and research development.

**7. SELECTION PREFERENCE**

Preference will be given to candidates

jobs.title: Temenos - SME Business analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced T24 Technical Lead / Solution Architect to drive the end-to-end technical delivery of a core banking implementation. The role will be responsible for owning T24 application development, solution design, customisation, configuration, integration, and production readiness.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Temenos T24 application development, core banking architecture, system integrations, and end-to-end implementation delivery, including at least one full implementation from design through go-live. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, system integrators, and technology teams to ensure the solution aligns with banking requirements, regulatory standards, and approved architectural principles.

Key Responsibilities

1. Application and Development Ownership

* Take ownership of the T24 application build and customisation from project commencement until production go-live.
* Lead and govern the T24 design and development teams, interface teams, and system integrator developers, ensuring alignment with programme scope, plans, milestones, deliverables, risks, and testing from a technology standpoint.
* Establish quality standards for IRDs, IDDs, and FSD documents covering the incumbent bank's products, services, and configurations.
* Own end-to-end delivery governance across all phases and report progress to senior management and steering committees.

2. Solution Design and Architecture

* Coordinate and participate in detailed functional and technical deep-dive sessions with system integrators to validate architecture, scope, IRDs, IDDs, and FSDs against the bank's requirements.
* Lead design discussions with solution designers and bank stakeholders to ensure proposed solutions follow event-driven architecture principles and approved architectural patterns.
* Drive Low-Level Design (LLD) discussions covering T24 Chart of Accounts, customer and account structures, product setup, accounting entries, interfaces with SAS systems, and operational workflows.
* Conduct operational workshops with Finance, Compliance, Risk, Fraud, and Operations teams to finalise process flows and technology integrations.

3. Implementation and Configuration

* Oversee T24 environment setup, parameterisation, configuration, and development of standard and customised functionalities.
* Govern bank-specific configurations and Egypt-specific customisations, ensuring they are justified, documented, and upgrade-safe.
* Oversee DIT, SIT, UAT, performance testing, and Close of Business (COB) readiness.
* Drive cutover activities and ensure production readiness.

4. Integration and Middleware

* Own the T24 integration design with other system integrators and downstream applications, including DMS, Kafka, Camunda, Kong, CRM, AML/KYC, Sanctions, FRM, and Data Lake.
* Oversee Kafka event streaming and real-time messaging of T24 customer, account, and transaction events to SAS systems.
* Govern Camunda workflow orchestration for non-STP case handling, ensuring case outcomes are appropriately posted back to T24.
* Oversee Kong API Gateway integration, including API security and traffic management for T24 APIs.
* Ensure CRM integration supports non-STP workflows and customer interactions.
* Govern SAS system integrations covering customer and account data feeds, transaction screening, fraud checks, and posting of approved outcomes, including restrictions, blocks, and status changes, into T24 following Risk and Compliance clearance.

5. Regulatory and Compliance Alignment

* Ensure T24 configuration, General Ledger, and regulatory reporting meet Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) regulations.
* Ensure compliance with Egyptian AML/CFT requirements, data residency, and information security expectations.
* Apply relevant GCC and international banking compliance practices, including FATF recommendations and OFAC/EU sanctions requirements, while adapting them to the Egyptian regulatory context.
* Support regulatory inspections, audits, and technology-related evidence requests.

6. Stakeholder Management

* Engage and align senior business and technology stakeholders as required.
* Present project status, risks, dependencies, and action points clearly to executive leadership and steering committees.

Role Requirements and Qualifications

* Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in Temenos T24 application development, including at least one complete implementation from design to production go-live.
* Strong technical knowledge of T24 modules, architecture, configuration, customisation, Chart of Accounts, General Ledger, multi-currency processing, and core banking operations.
* Hands-on experience with T24 development tools and frameworks, including OFS, IRIS, REST/SOAP APIs, event and message frameworks, MQ, local routines, enquiries, COB configuration, and TAFJ.
* Strong understanding of core banking processes covering customers, accounts, deposits, payments, accounting, and day-end operations.
* Knowledge of banking integrations involving Kafka, Camunda, Kong, DMS, CRM, AML/KYC, Sanctions, FRM, and Data Lake.
* Understanding of AML/CFT, transaction monitoring, customer risk assessment, CDD/EDD, sanctions screening, and fraud management.
* Familiarity with Egyptian banking regulations, CBE reporting requirements, and data residency expectations.
* Experience in technical delivery governance, system integrator coordination, and stakeholder management.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in large-scale core banking transformation programmes.
* Exposure to Egyptian banking implementations and CBE regulatory requirements.
* Knowledge of GCC banking compliance frameworks and regulatory expectations.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Enterprise Transformation
jobs.description:
Osfin.ai is a fast-growing transaction intelligence platform for Financial Services firms globally. Osfin.ai helps Financial Services firms automate payments and ledger reconciliation, disputes and chargebacks management, payouts automation, and more. Osfin.ai's customers have been able to transform their 100+ complex and resource-intensive FinOps processes smoothly.

  

**Who Is an Ideal Fit for Us?**

As Osfin scales, we are building a bench of enterprise-level subject-matter experts who can lead transformation and modernisation for large organisations and help us enter new finance domains. This is a high-ownership, client-facing role for someone who combines deep domain authority with a strong instinct for AI & automation and the commercial sense to turn expertise into product and growth.

  

**What Will You Get to Work On?**

As Director, Enterprise Transformation at Osfin.ai, you will look after:

* Transformation Roadmap: Define and own the enterprise transformation roadmap across finance, operations and technology.
* Process & Operating Model Redesign: Redesign end-to-end processes (Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash) and the operating model to improve speed, scale and control.
* ERP & Platform Modernisation: Lead ERP and enterprise platform modernisation (SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite or similar).
* Automation & AI: Identify and deliver automation and AI opportunities across accounting and finance operations.
* Programme Governance: Set up programme governance, KPIs and value-realisation tracking, and report progress to executive leadership.
* Investment & Delivery Management: Prioritise investments and manage budgets, capacity and cross-functional delivery.
* Controls & Compliance: Strengthen internal controls, audit readiness and compliance (SOX, Ind AS/IFRS).
* Executive Partnership: Partner with the CFO, CTO, Legal, Risk and Procurement to align strategy with execution.
* Team Leadership: Build, mentor and lead high-performing teams.
* Executive relationship leader partnering with COO, CTO, business executives, Legal, Risk, Technology, and Operations to develop transformation strategies, modernize operating models, and deliver enterprise technology, AI, and process optimization initiatives aligned to firm priorities.
* Lead enterprise portfolios spanning digital transformation, business process management (BPM), risk & compliance, automation, AI enablement, contracting, and operational transformation, driving investment prioritization, executive decision-making, and measurable business outcomes across global teams.
* Build trusted partnerships across Executive Leadership, Engineering, Tech, Governance, Procurement, Legal, and business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into scalable technology roadmaps and cross-functional delivery plans.
* Responsible for driving governance, portfolio management, and executive reporting for complex, multi-million-dollar transformation initiatives, establishing KPIs, value realization metrics, and leading capacity management to improve transparency and accelerate decision-making.
* Serve as the liaison between front-line professionals, operations, and technology organizations, aligning AI, automation, and digital capabilities with operational priorities to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enable sustainable organizational change.

  

**What Do We Expect From You?**

**Must-Have**

* Core Experience: 10+ years in enterprise transformation, finance/accounting transformation or ERP modernisation.
* Consulting Leadership: Leadership experience at a Big 4 or leading consulting firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG, Accenture, etc.).
* Delivery Track Record: Track record of delivering large transformation or automation programmes with measurable results (cost savings, cycle-time reduction).
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Strong executive stakeholder management and portfolio governance.
* Accounting Knowledge: Working knowledge of accounting processes, controls and standards.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru.

  

**Good-to-Have**

* Qualifications: CA / CPA / CISA / MBA.
* Regulated Exposure: Exposure to GRC, SOX, and regulated industries.
* AI Transformation: Experience with AI/GenAI-led process transformation.
* Workflow Tools: Familiarity with BPM and workflow tools (e.g., ServiceNow).

  

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* A clear transformation roadmap approved by leadership.
* Two to three high-impact automation or modernisation programmes delivered.
* Governance and KPI framework running with regular executive reporting.
* Visible gains in cycle time, cost, or control quality.

  

**Why Join Us?**

* Shape how Osfin works and scales, alongside the founders and senior leadership.
* Work with a high-calibre team of industry experts and solve complex problems at scale.
* Build capabilities that serve leading customers across banking, fintech, e-commerce, and other industries.
* Drive the next phase of platform and operational development, with significant ownership and impact.
* Competitive compensation and ESOPs aligned with your contribution and impact.
* A collaborative environment that encourages innovation, learning, and meaningful ownership.

  

**Interested? We'd love to hear from you.**

Reach out to us at careers@osfin.ai.

The Lead – People Business Partner, People & Administration will act as the strategic people partner to Titan’s **People Function and Administration teams**, enabling them to build future-ready capabilities, strengthen organisation effectiveness, and deliver a differentiated employee experience.

The role will work closely with functional leadership to translate business and functional priorities into a focused people agenda, covering **organisation design, workforce planning, talent and succession, capability building, performance, engagement, culture and change**.

Given the unique mandate of partnering the People Function itself, the role will also be expected to bring an **outside-in perspective, challenge existing practices constructively, and help the function role-model the people practices and employee experience it seeks to create across Titan**.

  
Key Responsibilities

* **Strategic People Partnering:** Partner with People Function and Administration leadership to translate functional priorities into an integrated people strategy and actionable people plans.
* **Organisation & Workforce Planning:** Support organisation design, role architecture, workforce planning and capability decisions to ensure structures and skills remain aligned with evolving business and functional requirements.
* **Talent & Succession:** Drive talent reviews, succession planning, career development and leadership pipeline interventions for critical roles across People & Administration.
* **Capability Building:** Identify current and future capability requirements and partner with relevant COEs to build functional, leadership, digital and future-of-work capabilities.
* **Performance & Productivity:** Enable robust goal setting, performance conversations, differentiation and development planning while helping leaders strengthen overall organisational effectiveness and productivity.
* **Employee Experience & Engagement:** Own the employee experience agenda for People & Administration, leveraging engagement insights, employee listening and feedback to strengthen culture, inclusion, retention and employee advocacy.
* **People Function Transformation:** Act as a key change partner for transformation initiatives across the People Function, helping embed new operating models, processes, technology and ways of working.
* **Leadership Advisory:** Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders on organisation, talent, capability, change and complex people matters, bringing an objective perspective and constructively challenging where required.
* **People Analytics & Insights:** Use workforce data, talent metrics, engagement insights and other people indicators to identify trends, anticipate risks and enable evidence-based decisions.
* **Employee Relations & Governance:** Ensure sound people governance and consistent application of policies and processes while managing sensitive employee matters with fairness, confidentiality and sound judgement.
* **Culture & Change:** Enable leaders to build a high-performance, collaborative and inclusive culture and support teams through organisation and operating-model changes.

* **Transformation & Change:** Navigates ambiguity and enables adoption during structural, process and technology-led change.

Speaks up with conviction, challenges constructively and is willing to push back with rationale, supported by strong functional expertise.

Responds quickly to stakeholder needs while maintaining a forward-looking perspective; demonstrates a solution-oriented mindset and adapts effectively to evolving priorities.

Anticipates how the People Function needs to evolve, challenges conventional approaches and translates future possibilities into meaningful organisation and people interventions.

jobs.title: Senior SAP & ERP Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
**Senior SAP & ERP Transformation Lead**

**Experience:** 1012+ Years  
 **Qualification:** B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent  
 **Preferred Expertise:** SAP, ERP Architecture, ERP Migration, Process Re-engineering and System Integration

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced SAP & ERP Transformation professional with deep end-to-end knowledge of SAP's technical and functional architecture, who can assess, rationalise and eventually lead the migration of the organisation's existing SAP ecosystem to an alternative ERP platform.

The individual will be responsible for understanding the existing SAP landscape across modules, mapping interdependencies between processes, identifying redundancies and recommending an appropriate future-state ERP architecture.

The role requires a strong combination of technical programming capabilities, functional SAP expertise, business process understanding and ERP migration experience. The individual should be capable of evaluating how a change in one module, process or configuration impacts other interconnected business functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End SAP Architecture & Expertise**

* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the existing SAP landscape, including its modules, configurations, customisations, workflows and integrations.
* Demonstrate strong techno-functional knowledge across SAP modules such as:

+ SAP MM – Materials Management
+ SAP PP – Production Planning
+ SAP SD – Sales & Distribution
+ SAP FI/CO – Finance & Controlling
+ SAP QM – Quality Management
+ SAP PM – Plant Maintenance
+ SAP WM/EWM – Warehouse Management
+ SAP HCM – Human Capital Management

* Understand the interdependencies between modules and assess the downstream and upstream impact of system-level changes.
* Review existing custom developments, ABAP code, interfaces, reports and system configurations.

**2. ERP Migration & Transformation**

* Lead the assessment and migration strategy for transitioning from the existing SAP environment to an alternative ERP platform.
* Evaluate suitable ERP solutions such as Oracle ERP, ERPNext or other enterprise platforms based on business requirements.
* Develop a comprehensive migration roadmap covering data, processes, applications, integrations and infrastructure.
* Identify functionalities that can be migrated, redesigned, consolidated or eliminated.
* Ensure data integrity, business continuity and minimal operational disruption during migration.
* Lead migration planning, testing, validation, deployment and post-implementation stabilisation.

**3. Business Process Re-engineering**

* Map and document existing end-to-end business processes across departments.
* Identify redundant, overlapping, outdated or inefficient processes.
* Design, restructure, consolidate or eliminate processes wherever required.
* Develop future-state workflows aligned with business requirements and operational efficiency.
* Ensure that changes in one business process are evaluated for their impact on other interconnected functions.

**4. Technical & Development Expertise**

* Possess strong understanding of SAP technical architecture, ABAP programming, debugging and custom code development.
* Understand APIs, database architecture, data structures, integrations and middleware.
* Assess the feasibility of replicating or redesigning existing SAP functionalities in the new ERP environment.
* Work with technical teams to develop customised solutions, interfaces and automation wherever required.

**5. Stakeholder Management & ERP Governance**

* Work closely with Finance, HR, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Sales, Projects and other business functions.
* Conduct functional assessments and gather business requirements from stakeholders.
* Establish centralised control over ERP-related projects, changes and process improvements.
* Develop system documentation, process maps, impact assessments and migration governance mechanisms.
* Coordinate with implementation partners, consultants and internal IT teams.

  

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 10–12+ years of relevant experience in SAP consulting, ERP architecture, ERP transformation or large-scale ERP migration.
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, IT or a related engineering discipline preferred.
* Strong techno-functional expertise across multiple SAP modules.
* Hands-on experience with ABAP programming, debugging, system configuration and integration.
* Demonstrated experience in ERP migration, preferably from SAP to Oracle, ERPNext or other enterprise ERP platforms.
* Strong understanding of cross-functional business processes and system interdependencies.
* Experience in process mapping, process redesign and business process re-engineering.
* Ability to independently assess existing systems and recommend appropriate technology and process solutions.
* Strong project management, analytical and stakeholder management capabilities.

  

**Key Expectations from the Role**

The successful candidate should be able to:

1. Understand the existing SAP ecosystem end-to-end without depending entirely on external consultants.
2. Map all existing modules, processes, customisations and system interdependencies.
3. Identify what needs to be retained, modified, consolidated or discontinued.
4. Assess the impact of any proposed change across the entire ERP ecosystem.
5. Recommend the most suitable alternative ERP platform and migration approach.
6. Develop and execute a structured migration roadmap with minimal business disruption.
7. Establish a centralised ERP architecture and governance framework for the organisation.

  

**The ultimate objective is to move from a fragmented and heavily dependent SAP environment towards a streamlined, integrated and scalable ERP ecosystem.**

* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions with both technical and non-technical/business stakeholders.
* Solid experience working with data and database management systems, including both legacy and modern/emerging database technologies.

* Demonstrated experience designing and building highly available, customer-facing applications in a global delivery/shared-services (GCC) model.
* Experience designing and building cloud-native applications and RESTful/GraphQL APIs.
* Demonstrated experience designing highly available, resilient architectures, including automation and performance-optimization initiatives.
* Proven experience transforming monolithic architectures into modern, decoupled microservices-based systems.
* Working experience in at least two to three of the following domains: Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, Application Development, Database Technologies, or Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

**Desired / Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in the banking or financial services domain, including an understanding of consumer and custodial banking operations and experience handling sensitive financial data.

* Working knowledge of multiple programming languages and at least one modern front-end framework (Angular, React, or Vue), such as Python, Java, JavaScript, Ruby, Golang, C, or C++.
* UI/UX design exposure, including familiarity with web/application branding and design-system practices.
* Cloud architecture certification(s) — AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect.
* Enterprise architecture framework knowledge (e.g., TOGAF) or equivalent certification.
* Experience working in Agile/SAFe delivery environments across distributed, global teams and time zones.

**Core Competencies**

* Technical Depth — Ability to go deep on architecture, code, and infrastructure when needed
* Strategic Thinking — Connects technical decisions to business and enterprise outcomes
* Communication — Translates complex technical concepts for varied audiences
* Collaboration — Works effectively across globally distributed, cross-functional teams
* Risk & Compliance Awareness — Understands the regulatory weight of decisions in a banking environment
