𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸𝗱𝗮𝘆'𝘀 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀
  
  
𝗦𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲: 𝗥𝘀 𝟯𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 - 𝗥𝘀 𝟱𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 (𝗶𝗲 𝗜𝗡𝗥 𝟯𝟬-𝟱𝟬 𝗟𝗣𝗔)
  
  
Experience: 14+ yrs
  
  
Location: Pune
  
  
As a National Head Contact Center IT, you will be responsible for steering the strategic vision and operational execution of the enterprise-wide contact center technology ecosystem. You will lead the design, deployment, and optimization of Asterisk‑based telephony solutions, ensuring seamless integration with CRM, workforce management, and analytics platforms. This role demands a blend of technical acumen, project management expertise, and industry best practices to elevate service quality, scalability, and regulatory compliance. By collaborating with cross‑functional stakeholders, you will drive innovation, maintain cost efficiency, and uphold the highest standards of customer experience across all touchpoints.
  
  
**Requirements**
𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀
  
  

* Define and execute the contact center technology roadmap aligned with business objectives and market trends
* Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of Asterisk PBX systems and associated telephony infrastructure
* Lead end‑to‑end project management for major upgrades, migrations, and new feature rollouts using PMP methodology
* Ensure ITIL processes (service strategy, design, transition, operation, continual improvement) are embedded throughout the contact center IT lifecycle
* Collaborate with CRM and analytics teams to integrate call data, performance metrics, and customer insights
* Establish governance frameworks for change, incident, problem, and configuration management
* Mentor and develop a high‑performing IT team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional growth
* Manage vendor relationships, SLAs, and procurement to secure best value and service quality
* Monitor and report on KPIs, capacity planning, and cost optimization initiatives
* Champion cybersecurity and data privacy standards specific to telecommunication and customer information

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗮 𝗚𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁 𝗙𝗶𝘁
  
  

* 14+ years of progressive experience in contact center technology leadership
* Deep expertise in Asterisk and open‑source telephony platforms
* PMP certification with a proven track record of delivering large‑scale IT projects on time and within budget
* ITIL foundation (preferably practitioner or masters) and practical implementation experience
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills across executive, technical, and operational audiences
* Proven ability to build and lead cross‑functional teams in a dynamic, high‑volume environment
* Experience managing vendor portfolios and negotiating enterprise‑level contracts
* Demonstrated commitment to quality, security, and compliance in telecommunications environments
* Passion for continuous improvement and innovation in customer service technology

jobs.title: Vice President - Engineering Lead - Investment & Operations
jobs.description:
**About M&G India**
We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
  
  
Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
  
  
Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.
  
  
**About M&G**
Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  
  
Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.
  
  
Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
  
  
***Key Qualifications:***

* Inspire the teams to deliver exceptional performance by helping them to connect the purpose of their work, beyond the impact to the bottom line
* Lead by example in demonstrating the organization's values and principles
* Support direct reports to make effective decisions, collaborate across silos, speak up and take personal accountability
* Encourage Investment Platform team to solve business problems creatively and collaboratively and question the status quo
* Be curious and insightful about customer’s needs and support Investment Platform team to adapt to the changing environment
* Simplify complexity and reduce unnecessary bureaucracy

**Key Accountabilities And Responsibilities**

* Defines the technology roadmap for the portfolio or portfolios in line with the organisational objectives
* Being aware of the technology budget for the portfolio and be accountable for the operational costs of the platform including Azure
* Ensures implementation of best practices in software development, including coding standards, code reviews, and testing across squads
* Drive tech initatives including modernisation, and cost optimisation through a community of Lead Engineers
* Continuously assess and improve engineering processes to enhance efficiency and productivity
* Identify potential risks in projects and operations, and develop mitigation strategies
* Ensure compliance with security and regulatory requirements
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of engineering initiatives
* Regularly report on the performance and progress of engineering activities
* Provide guidance and mentorship to the engineering squads
* Be a role model and lead by example in demonstrating the organization's values and principles
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization
* Deliver business prioritised changes
* Demonstrate a solid understanding of the technology, and domain knowledge
* Oversee the quality of engineering of the squads
* Ensuring any solutions being designed within the squad meet M&G standards
* Fostering strong relationships with the other key stakeholders - outcome delivery managers, engineering lead, enterprise architecture, technology partners, SRE, and other platforms
* Playing an active role in engineering community for learning and sharing
* Assist with end-to-end solutions and see it through until it reaches the end customer.
* Leads tech improvements within the squad
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to the squad members
* Build and maintain strong relationships with all members of the team
* Contribute actively in the Lead Engineering Team and lead initiatives within the squad
* Partnering with and assisting the Investment Plaform’s change and run teams to deliver their objectives
* Work across multiple disciplines across the Investment Platform and opportunities to connect and improve working practices
* Consistently identify improvement opportunities within the team and implements processes, ways of working or facilitate training to address improvement opportunities
* Works within established frameworks and procedures, with the freedom to interpret them to solve a range of problems
* Build and maintain strong relationships with all key stakeholders in the Front Office, Sustainability focused teams, Transformation & Innovation or the engineering community

**Key Stakeholder Management**
**Internal**
M&G Investments
  
  
**External**
N/A
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills, Experience & Educational Qualification**
**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS (KEY):**

* Advanced software engineering skills paired with expertise in some of the following programming languages: C#, Java, Python, Javascript, HTML/CSS or equivalent
* Strong understanding of DevOps principles and experience in building CI/CD pipelines
* Strong experience working with data on Azure including Azure Data Lake, ADLA, Cosmos DB, SQL, and Datafactory
* Demonstrates Architectural Excellence by developing solutions using the guiding tenets of Azure Well-Architected Framework covering reliability, security, cost optimisation, operational excellence and performance efficiency
* Has strong Azure experience on PaaS services such as App Service, Function App, Logic App, Data Factory, Service Bus and Key Vault
* Has deep understanding of Azure AD, Service Principals and Managed Identities to configure role based access for web applications
* Is able to investigate complex application issues by using telemetry and Application Insights information
* Has a good experience with REST APIs and Microservices and API management on Apigee
* Follows best coding practices using SOLID principles, design patterns and other industry standards
* Proactive self-starter who can manage their own workload and can juggle multiple priorities at the same time
* Experience working in an agile environment and good understanding of integrating testing withing the SDLC
* Applying a “solutions” mentality for any outcome that you are assigned to and ensure proper solutions design is considered
* Great interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both written and orally, within a project team
* Ability to identify problems and have the drive to follow them through to resolution
* Excellent attention to detail, and ability to prioritize and work efficiently to project deadlines
* Has people management skills and able to develop high performing teams

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS (DESIRABLE):**

* Relevant experience developing back or frontend solutions (e.g. On Azure Cloud, Angular, React, Node.js software frameworks)
* Exposure to financial markets & asset management processes and understand analysis into a wide variety of asset classes and associated analytics (e.g. Equity, Fixed Income, Private Assets etc)
* Exposure to data visualisation tools - Power BI or equivalent

**EXPERIENCE:**

* 18 + years of total experience in software engineering
* 5 + years of experience in a core engineering role in the cloud

**EDUCATION, QUALIFICATIONS NECESSARY:**

* Graduate in any discipline

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

jobs.title: GM - Business Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Business Transformation Lead to drive strategic transformation initiatives across Business service domains, translating enterprise transformation strategy into executable product and service roadmaps. Reporting to the Head of Transformation – Business, this role partners with business leaders, technology teams, markets, Finance, GTM teams and strategic partners to deliver measurable business outcomes, operational efficiency, service excellence and sustainable value realisation. The role combines transformation leadership, business architecture, programme delivery, AI-enabled innovation and stakeholder management to help VOIS achieve its long-term growth and performance ambitions.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the development and execution of transformation roadmaps aligned to business strategy and customer priorities
* Own end-to-end transformation planning, design and delivery across assigned products, services and business domains
* Translate complex and ambiguous business challenges into clear opportunities, hypotheses and actionable transformation plans
* Drive revenue growth, operational efficiency, service performance improvements and value realisation through transformation initiatives
* Manage programme governance, risks, dependencies, milestones and cross-functional delivery across multiple portfolios
* Design target-state business architectures aligned with strategic objectives, operating models, processes, data and technology capabilities
* Ensure alignment between business and technology architecture, identifying gaps and enabling scalable, sustainable solutions
* Partner with business leaders, local markets, Finance, GTM teams, Accenture and technology stakeholders to support adoption and business case delivery
* Utilise AI and GenAI tools to improve analysis, documentation, automation, decision-making and delivery effectiveness
* Establish measurement frameworks and governance mechanisms to track benefits realisation and transformation outcomes
* Influence senior stakeholders through insight-led communication, structured problem solving and strategic recommendations
* Support enterprise-wide transformation programmes while ensuring customer, employee and partner experience objectives are achieved

**Who You Are**

* Strong expertise in business transformation, programme leadership and operational improvement within complex environments
* Deep understanding of business service domains, operating models and the impact of transformational change on service performance
* Proven ability to build and execute strategic roadmaps while managing dependencies across multiple teams and functions
* Skilled in business architecture, future-state design, value realisation and performance measurement
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to influence senior leaders using structured, data-driven narratives
* Experience applying Agile, Lean and systems-thinking methodologies to transformation programmes
* Commercially aware with the ability to balance customer outcomes, operational effectiveness and business value
* Experience working with AI-enabled tools and supporting AI-led transformation initiatives
* Telecoms and/or cross-sector experience highly desirable

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to lead large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives with significant business impact
* Exposure to senior leaders across global markets, business functions and technology organisations
* Ability to shape future operating models, services and business architecture across a leading international organisation
* Opportunity to influence AI-enabled transformation strategies and emerging technology adoption
* Collaboration with diverse global teams and strategic partners on high-profile transformation programmes

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced enterprise transformation and strategic planning capabilities
* AI and GenAI application within business transformation and operational environments
* End-to-end business architecture and target operating model design
* Value realisation frameworks and benefits tracking methodologies
* Global stakeholder leadership, executive influencing and large-scale programme governance
* Data-driven decision-making and transformation performance measurement

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.

jobs.title: Senior Manager / Service Delivery Leader, AI-Led Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
**About Aligned Automation**

At Aligned Automation, we live by our "Better Together" philosophy to build a better world. We digitally enable business strategy by connecting processes, technologies and people to unlock value and drive critical business outcomes. Our culture is rooted in our 4Cs – Care, Courage, Curiosity and Collaboration – so every employee is empowered to grow, innovate and thrive in an inclusive workplace.

**Job Description – Senior Manager / Service Delivery Leader, AI-Led Digital Transformation**

**Experience: 12–15 Years | AI-Led Digital Transformation | Data, AI, Cloud & Enterprise Technology | Hi-Tech / Manufacturing / Oil & Gas**

**1. Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly motivated
**Service Delivery Leader - AI-Led Digital Transformation**
to lead large-scale digital transformation programs, drive customer success, and deliver business outcomes through Data, AI, Automation, Analytics, Cloud, and Enterprise Platforms.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong combination of consulting, program delivery, technology leadership, customer engagement, and people management experience. This role will be responsible for owning end-to-end service delivery, transformation roadmaps, solution execution, operational excellence, stakeholder management, and continuous innovation initiatives.

The leader will work closely with customers to identify transformation opportunities, define target operating models, implement AI-enabled solutions, and drive measurable business value through modern technology platforms and intelligent automation.

**2. Key Technical Skills & Competencies**

**AI-Led Digital Transformation**

* Strong understanding of digital transformation strategies, operating models, and enterprise modernization initiatives.
* Experience driving transformation programs leveraging AI, GenAI, Agentic AI, Data Platforms, Analytics, Process Automation, and Cloud technologies.
* Ability to identify business problems and translate them into scalable technology solutions.
* Experience defining transformation roadmaps, value realization plans, and adoption strategies.

**Data, AI & Analytics**

* Strong understanding of enterprise data ecosystems including Data Lakes, Lakehouse architectures, Data Warehousing, and Analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, IOMETE, Hadoop, Azure, AWS, and GCP.
* Understanding of AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI, Intelligent Automation, and Enterprise AI deployment models.
* Ability to evaluate AI use cases, business value, implementation feasibility, governance, and risk considerations.

**Service Delivery & Program Leadership**

* Proven experience managing complex multi-stream technology programs and customer engagements.
* Strong governance, risk management, financial management, and service delivery leadership capabilities.
* Experience defining KPIs, SLAs, operational metrics, and transformation success measures.
* Ability to lead geographically distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Consulting & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong customer-facing consulting skills.
* Experience conducting discovery workshops and business assessments.
* Ability to influence senior executives and navigate complex organizational structures.
* Expertise in requirement gathering, solution articulation, executive presentations, and business case development.

**3. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Define and drive AI-led digital transformation strategies aligned with customer business objectives.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to create transformation roadmaps and execution plans.
* Establish governance structures for transformation initiatives.

**Service Delivery Ownership**

* Own end-to-end delivery of transformation programs ensuring quality, budget, timeline, and customer satisfaction targets are achieved.
* Manage multiple projects, delivery teams, partners, and vendor relationships.
* Drive operational excellence through standardized delivery frameworks and best practices.

**AI & Innovation Enablement**

* Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI, Intelligent Automation, and advanced analytics.
* Lead AI transformation initiatives from ideation through implementation and adoption.
* Establish AI governance, responsible AI practices, and value realization frameworks.

**Customer Engagement**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to customer executives and business leaders.
* Conduct transformation assessments and maturity evaluations.
* Facilitate workshops to identify optimization and innovation opportunities.

**Team Leadership**

* Build, mentor, and lead high-performing consulting, data, AI, and technology teams.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Operational Excellence**

* Establish service management frameworks, delivery KPIs, and performance dashboards.
* Drive risk management, issue resolution, escalation handling, and stakeholder communications.
* Ensure compliance with security, governance, and regulatory requirements.

**4. Expected Deliverables**

**Transformation Strategy & Consulting**

* Digital transformation roadmap
* Business capability assessments
* Current-state and future-state operating models
* Executive business cases and value realization plans

**Solution & Program Governance**

* Strategic program plans
* Resource and capacity plans
* Executive steering committee reports
* RAID logs and governance reviews

**AI & Digital Innovation**

* AI opportunity assessments
* Agentic AI and automation use cases
* Proof of concept (POC) plans and outcomes
* AI adoption and scale-up recommendations

**Service Delivery**

* Delivery dashboards and KPI reviews
* SLA and operational performance reports
* Customer success plans
* Continuous improvement initiatives

**Team & Capability Building**

* Workforce capability plans
* Skills development roadmaps
* Succession and talent management plans
* Performance and competency frameworks

**5. Preferred Domain Experience**

Experience leading digital transformation programs within one or more of the following sectors:

**Hi-Tech**

* Product engineering
* SaaS platforms
* Technology services
* Customer and operational analytics

**Manufacturing**

* Smart manufacturing
* Industry 4.0 initiatives
* Supply chain transformation
* Quality and operations optimization

**Oil & Gas**

* Asset performance management
* Predictive maintenance
* Operations optimization
* Enterprise data transformation

**Domain Preference:**
Experience in Hi-Tech, Manufacturing, Energy, Utilities, Industrial, and Engineering Services environments is preferred. Banking, Insurance, and Financial Services experience is not the primary hiring focus.

**6. Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 12–15 years of experience leading complex technology and digital transformation programs.
* Proven experience owning service delivery, customer success, and business outcomes.
* Strong background in AI, Data, Analytics, Cloud, and Enterprise Technology transformation.
* Consulting experience with the ability to engage C-level stakeholders.
* Excellent program management, governance, financial management, and delivery leadership skills.
* Demonstrated success in building and leading high-performing teams.
* Experience defining and executing AI adoption and innovation strategies.
* Strong communication, executive presence, and stakeholder management capabilities.

**7. Selection & Evaluation Criteria**

**Transformation Leadership**

* Ability to define and execute enterprise digital transformation strategies.

**Customer & Consulting Excellence**

* Executive stakeholder engagement, business consulting, and value realization.

**Service Delivery Leadership**

* Ownership of scope, budget, quality, governance, SLAs, and business outcomes.

**Technology & AI Expertise**

* Practical

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Applied AI
jobs.description:
**The role**
------------

You own a set of enterprise accounts once they go live, and your job is to grow them. That means making sure delivery lands, the client sees results in their own numbers, and each account has a clear plan for what we do next with them.

You work with the client's business leaders on one side and our forward deployed engineers (FDEs) on the other. You run discovery with the client, turn their business logic into a call flow, and hand the FDE a clear spec for the workflow. When the FDE is deep in a complex build, you write the agent prompt yourself.

This is not a sales role. You grow accounts by delivering value the client can measure, and by spotting where else in their business we can do the same.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run discovery. Understand the use case and the client's process, find the real pain point, and agree the north star metric with the client so everyone knows what outcome the agent has to deliver.
* Design the call flow. Translate business logic into a call flow and conversation design, then brief the FDE on the workflow to build.
* Build agents. Write and iterate production prompts, especially when the FDE is busy on a complex workflow.
* Do RCA. When results dip, listen to the conversations, work out why they failed (prompt, data, flow or telephony) and drive the fix.
* Own the client relationship. Be the person the client calls first. Run governance calls, reviews and escalations, and build trust with stakeholders from operations teams up to business heads.
* Make delivery happen. Plan and run the project with the FDEs: scope, timelines, dependencies on the client's tech and data teams, go-lives. Unblock things before they slip.
* Run on numbers. Own the account's metrics (connect rate, conversion, collections, cost per outcome). Build the analysis, explain what moved and why, and turn it into the next change to the agent.
* Build the account roadmap. For every account, write a strategic plan for expansion: new use cases, new teams, more volume. Size each one, build the business case and take it to the client.
* Sell through value. Pitch upsell and cross-sell with evidence from your own account's results, working with sales and leadership on commercials.
* Test and improve. Run A/B tests on agents, prompts and voices, and read them out.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

Two backgrounds have worked best for this role:

* A growth product manager, ideally with about 2 years of consulting before moving into product, or
* A consultant with 3 to 4 years at a top-tier consulting firm.

Either way, you have:

* Strong client handling. You're comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders and can manage difficult conversations.
* Sharp analytics. You can pull and work the data yourself (SQL, spreadsheets) and turn it into a recommendation.
* Project management discipline across several workstreams and people you don't manage.
* Commercial instinct: you can see where an account can grow and make the case for it.
* Clear, short writing.
* Prompt engineering experience. We don't mean using ChatGPT or Claude day to day; we mean you have built agents that carry out a specific task and have run at scale with real users.
* Conversation design sense. You can read a transcript, see where it went wrong, and fix the flow or the prompt.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a voice or conversational AI company, or deploying AI for enterprise clients.
* BFSI background: lending, collections or insurance operations.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or a South Indian language.

  
**Benefits**  

* You own real revenue accounts from day one and work directly with the partner who runs them.
* You'll learn what makes AI agents work in production at scale.
* There's a clear path to running a portfolio of accounts as the team grows.

jobs.title: Head of Operations (Lounges)
jobs.description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. **About The Role**
At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

You'll own end-to-end lounge operations, ensuring each location delivers an exceptional customer experience while maximising commercial performance and operational efficiency.
  
  
We're looking for an entrepreneurial leader with expertise in airport lounges and building scalable operations across markets.
  
  
Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Leading end-to-end operational readiness and launch of new airport lounges globally, coordinating with airport partners, operators, construction, design, and internal teams
* Owning day-to-day operational performance across the lounge network, ensuring consistently high standards of service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency
* Maximising lounge profitability by driving revenue growth, optimising capacity utilisation, developing ancillary revenue opportunities, and managing operating costs
* Selecting, onboarding, and managing third-party lounge operators, establishing strict SLAs, performance targets, and governance mechanisms
* Defining and continuously improving premium hospitality standards across F&B, staffing, facilities, and customer experience

* A track record of building operational processes, infrastructure, and teams from scratch and scaling them across multiple locations

Our Restructuring and Liability Management Advisory practice advises companies, shareholders, lenders, sovereign-related entities and other stakeholders on complex capital structure challenges, balance sheet optimisation, distressed situations, recapitalisations and strategic alternatives. The successful candidate will work directly with senior bankers and clients, leading transaction execution while helping to develop and grow Jefferies' restructuring advisory presence across the region.

* Strong understanding of debt products, capital structures, credit markets and restructuring solutions.

* Experience interacting with senior management teams, boards, lenders and investors.
* Exceptional presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

We believe in transformation – embracing agile and new ways of working together, which helps us to truly ‘think client’ and serve millions of our affluent and emerging affluent clients, across the world. Our clients include individuals and small businesses, and we support them with a range of traditional banking services, including investment, credit and wealth planning solutions.

Our client continuum spans from Mass Retail to Affluent, including high-net worth clients served by our Private Bank. We leverage digital banking channels with a human touch to provide clients with differentiated products and services such as deposits, payments, financing, wealth management and personalised advice. We also support small business clients with their business banking needs.

To become a strategic professional within our team, while utilizing your experience in building and managing client relationships, across the region. Your focus will be on developing new relationships, to onboard new clients while maintaining and servicing a portfolio, through excellent communication, negotiation and customer service.

jobs.title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**
----------------------------------------

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**
------------

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**
---------------------------

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**
---------------

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

jobs.description:

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

**The Role**

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning:** Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.
* **Drive business performance:** Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. * **Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda:** Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. * **Lead high-impact strategic initiatives:** Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.
* **Lead and develop high-performing teams:** Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.
* **Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions:** Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business's most important strategic priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.
* Strong influencer and relationship builder, able to bring senior and cross-functional stakeholders on the journey, communicate in a way that resonates with different audiences and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.
* Proven end-to-end execution capability, including mobilising the right teams and resources, securing investment or headcount where needed, removing blockers and driving complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
* Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set clear direction, develop high-performing teams, coach managers and build the capabilities and ways of working needed for teams to scale effectively.
* Strong data literacy and comfort using analytical and AI tools to accelerate analysis, problem-solving and decision-making; experience with tools such as Looker, Cursor, Claude or similar is an advantage.

**Benefits and Diversity**

* Annual Holiday Leave
* Annual flight allowance
* Free Deliveroo Plus - Free delivery and access to special offers
* Enhanced Maternity & Paternity benefits
* End of year parties & regular social events
* An extremely fun team to work alongside!

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
